name: Family monthly financial review and budget meeting
description: On the evening of February 28, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming used the family budgeting app in the living room to check this month's income and expenses. She recorded this month's salary deposit, care card expenses, children's education costs, and reiterated the plan to save 8000 Hong Kong dollars per month. The couple confirmed the achievable savings goal for next month and discussed the family emergency fund. Zhang Weiming expressed support, but mentioned that changes in the repair and maintenance industry might affect income stability, and the two decided to reassess the size of the emergency fund next quarter.

subevent.name: Preparing for the financial meeting.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming prepared the family budgeting app on their phones and a notebook in the living room at home, turned on the desk lamp, and after sitting down, began the monthly financial meeting.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - living room at home in Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Check this month's income and expenses
subevent.description: Using the family budgeting app, Yu Xiaowei checked the February income and expense details item by item, including recording her salary deposits, nursing card spending, and the education expenses of her two children (tuition and interest classes). Zhang Weiming confirmed the accuracy of the information beside her.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - living room at home in Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Confirm the savings plan.
subevent.description: The couple, based on this month's income and expense balance, reaffirmed their family goal of saving 8,000 Hong Kong dollars per month, jointly confirmed the specific savings amount achievable next month, and recorded the plan and amount in a notebook.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - living room at home in Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Discuss emergency fund adjustments.
subevent.description: Zhang Weiming mentioned that recent changes in the air-conditioning repair and maintenance industry might affect the stability of his income. Yu Xiaowei discussed with her husband strategies for dealing with this using the family emergency fund, and they finally decided to reassess the size of the emergency fund next quarter and make corresponding budget adjustments.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - living room at home in Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Summarize and record the meeting conclusions
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei summarized the results of the meeting discussion, recording next month's savings target, the emergency fund assessment plan, and budget adjustments for various expenses in the family finance notebook. After confirming everything with Zhang Weiming, she ended the meeting.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - living room at home in Kowloon City District

name: Took the initiative to meet with her superior Liang Zhenhua to learn about management experience.
description: At noon on June 18, Yu Xiaowei used her lunch break to go to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua's office and frankly reported the difficulties in team management, where new employees shifted responsibility and delegation was not working effectively. Liang Zhenhua advised her to hold a 15-minute one-on-one conversation with each team member every week and to clearly define delivery standards and deadlines when assigning tasks. Yu Xiaowei felt she had found a treasure. That evening she organized a management checklist in her notes and planned to implement it starting next month.

subevent.name: Schedule a conversation with Liang Zhenhua.
subevent.description: That morning, Yu Xiaowei sent a message through the company's internal messaging software to her direct supervisor, Liang Zhenhua, to ask for a brief meeting in his office during the lunch break to seek advice on management experience. After confirming that Liang Zhenhua would be free at noon, they agreed on a time.
subevent.location: AIA Tower, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Go to Liang Zhenhua's office
subevent.description: At 12:30 pm, Yu Xiaowei put down the work at hand, walked from her workstation to the private office of her supervisor Liang Zhenhua on the same floor, knocked on the door, and entered.
subevent.location: AIA Tower, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Discuss management difficulties and suggestions with Liang Zhenhua
subevent.description: In Liang Zhenhua's office, Yu Xiaowei frankly reported the difficulties in team management: new hires shirking responsibility and delegation not being effective. After listening carefully, Liang Zhenhua suggested she hold a 15-minute one-on-one conversation with each team member every week, and clarify delivery standards and deadlines when assigning tasks. The two talked for about 20 minutes in a harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: AIA Tower, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Organize the management checklist.
subevent.description: That evening, Yu Xiaowei went to her home study, took out her notebook, and, based on Liang Zhenhua's suggestions combined with her own ideas, put together a detailed management checklist, including one-on-one communication arrangements, task assignment templates, and checkpoints, planning to start implementing it next month.

The total was about 8,000 Hong Kong dollars more than the previous month. After reviewing it, she transferred 5,000 Hong Kong dollars into the family savings account and used the rest to supplement the monthly household budget.

subevent.description: At the AIA Hong Kong company office in Wan Chai District, Yu Xiaowei received her June payslip through the company's internal payroll system. She carefully checked the base salary adjustment after her promotion and the renewal performance bonus for May, calculated that the total had increased by about 8,000 Hong Kong dollars compared with the previous month, and confirmed it was correct.

subevent.name: Allocate bonus to savings and household expenses

Yu Xiaowei confided her frustration about new team members shirking responsibilities, and Su Lishan shared her early experience mentoring newcomers, suggesting she establish clear reward and punishment mechanisms. The lunch not only gave Yu Xiaowei practical advice but also deepened trust and friendship between the colleagues.

The two talked deeply while eating for about an hour.

After the movie, they strolled through the nearby mall. Yu Xiaowei shared her recent work pressure and thoughts about promotion; Zhang Weiming encouraged her and suggested planning their family finances together on the weekend. The date was short but warm, letting the couple rediscover the joy of being alone together amid their busy lives.

They strolled while chatting about work and family matters, enjoying a rare time together.

The two agreed to meet up again next time.

name: Video conference with Shenzhen client Wang Qiming to gather cross-border case materials.
description: To enrich the content of the March sharing session, Yu Xiaowei arranged an online meeting with her Shenzhen client Wang Qiming. On the evening of February 18, the two talked for nearly an hour via video link. Wang Qiming described the new pain points in medical and accident coverage for employees of his tech company across Shenzhen and Hong Kong, and provided specific data. Yu Xiaowei took notes with sharp observation and identified a potential demand for customized cross-border group insurance. The two initially agreed to explore the idea further.

subevent.name: Preparing for the video conference.
subevent.description: During the day on February 18, Yu Xiaowei sorted through the cross-border insurance materials she had recently collected in her home study, and set up her computer and video conferencing software, preparing for an online meeting with Shenzhen client Wang Qiming. She connected the camera and microphone to her laptop, ensured a stable internet connection, and prepared paper and pen for recording key information.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Video conference with Wang Qiming in progress
subevent.description: On the evening of February 18, Yu Xiaowei connected with Shenzhen client Wang Qiming via video software from the study of her Hong Kong home. The meeting lasted about an hour. Wang Qiming joined from his home or office in Shenzhen, and the two discussed the challenges around medical and accident insurance for employees of his technology company based in both Shenzhen and Hong Kong. Wang Qiming provided specific data and cases. Yu Xiaowei recorded key points keenly, discovered a potential need for customized cross-border group insurance, and the two parties initially reached an intention to explore further.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Organizing meeting minutes and archiving case files after the meeting.
subevent.description: After the video conference ended, Yu Xiaowei immediately organized the client pain points, data, and cooperation intentions collected during the meeting in her study, entered them into an electronic document, and marked them as material for the cross-border case at the March sharing session. She also drafted a preliminary outline for a customized group cross-border insurance plan in response to Wang Qiming's company needs, preparing for the formal proposal later.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

name: During a break from caring for my mother-in-law, I video-called a client who had requested to cancel an order and persuaded them to stay; it succeeded but left me feeling drained and questioning myself.
description: On the afternoon of April 16, Yu Xiaowei was helping her mother-in-law take medicine by her bed when she received a call from a high-net-worth client, Mrs. Wang. Anxious about market fluctuations, Mrs. Wang asked to withdraw a large savings insurance policy. After quickly calming her mother-in-law, Yu Xiaowei went to the balcony, set up her phone, and held a video meeting with Mrs. Wang. She calmly analyzed Mrs. Wang's long-term retirement needs, reorganized the defensive value of her asset allocation, and finally succeeded in persuading her. Before hanging up, Mrs. Wang praised her, 'Awei, I trust the way you handle things.' But after the call, Yu Xiaowei looked out the window, a strong wave of fatigue washed over her, and she questioned inwardly, 'What am I working so hard for after all?' feeling a momentary disgust toward the meaning of her work.

subevent.name: Answered a client call and comforted my mother-in-law.
subevent.description: While Yu Xiaowei was helping her mother-in-law take medication, she received a call from Mrs. Wang, a high-net-worth client. Anxious about market fluctuations, the client asked to withdraw a large savings insurance policy. Yu Xiaowei quickly reassured her mother-in-law, asked her to rest for a moment, and indicated that she needed to handle urgent work.
subevent.location: At mother-in-law's home in Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Had a video meeting with the client and successfully persuaded them to cancel the order.
subevent.description: After comforting her mother-in-law, Yu Xiaowei got up and walked to the balcony, set up her phone, and had a video meeting with Mrs. Wang. She calmly analyzed Mrs. Wang's long-term retirement needs, reorganized the defensive value of the asset allocation, and finally succeeded in persuading the client to keep the policy. During the call, Mrs. Wang praised her, saying, “Awei, I trust the way you handle things.”
subevent.location: Balcony at the grandmother's home in Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.description: After the video call ended, Yu Xiaowei hung up and looked out the window, a strong sense of exhaustion washing over her. She began to question inwardly what she was working so hard for, felt a momentary disgust at the meaning of work, and slipped into brief self-reflection.
subevent.location: Balcony at the grandmother's home in Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Her mother picked out a silk scarf for Yu Xiaowei as a holiday gift, and Yu Xiaowei gave her mother a pair of pure gold earrings in return. The mother and daughter expressed their love by exchanging gifts.

name: Home fire insurance renewal: the premium rose slightly, but she renewed it anyway.
description: During her lunch break on March 31, 2025, Yu Xiaowei received a text message at the AIA Insurance office reminding her that her bank fire insurance was expiring. She immediately logged into online banking to check the policy and found that the premium had risen slightly from 2800 yuan to 2950 yuan. She called her account manager Li Guodong to confirm that the terms had not changed. Since there was no better option, she renewed on the spot and set up an automatic deduction reminder for next year. As an insurance professional, she regards this kind of routine protection as the bottom line of family financial security, and cannot afford to neglect it no matter how busy she is.

subevent.name: Received a fire insurance expiration reminder.
subevent.description: During the lunch break on March 31, 2025, Yu Xiaowei received a text message alert from the bank in her office saying that her home fire insurance was about to expire, reminding her that the original policy would soon lapse and that she needed to renew it as soon as possible. She immediately took out her phone to check the details.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - AIA Insurance office

subevent.name: Log in to online banking to check the insurance policy
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei used her office computer to log in to the HSBC online banking system, found the home fire insurance policy details page, carefully checked the existing coverage, sum insured, and expiry date, and found that the premium had risen slightly from 2800 yuan last year to 2950 yuan.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - AIA Insurance office

subevent.name: Called the account manager to confirm the terms
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei called her bank account manager Li Guodong to quickly ask why the insurance premium had increased and whether any policy terms had changed. Li Guodong confirmed that apart from a slight adjustment in the rate due to market factors, core terms such as coverage, sum insured, and deductible remained unchanged, and stated that there was currently no more favorable alternative plan.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - AIA Insurance office

subevent.name: Completed the renewal process.
subevent.description: After confirming that there was no better plan, Yu Xiaowei directly asked Li Guodong on the phone to help complete the renewal. She then confirmed payment through online banking and successfully renewed the home fire insurance with a premium of 2950 yuan, which took effect immediately.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - AIA Insurance office

subevent.name: Set up next year's automatic payment reminder
subevent.description: After completing the renewal, Yu Xiaowei set up reminders in her phone calendar for the automatic payment and policy expiration on March 31 next year, ensuring this routine protection is not missed amid a busy schedule. As an insurance professional, she knows well the importance of a family's financial safety net.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - AIA Insurance office

description: During the day on March 28, Yu Xiaowei organized the family's March income and expenditure details at home; that evening, she held a financial meeting with her husband Zhang Weiming to review income and expenses, confirm savings, and decide on April budget adjustments and increasing the emergency fund; the next day, Yu Xiaowei updated the April budget plan according to the decisions and sent it to her husband for confirmation.

subevent.name: Organized the March family financial accounts.
subevent.description: During the day, Yu Xiaowei used her free time in the home study to organize the detailed household income and expenses for March into a table, including insurance commissions of 28,000 yuan, her husband Zhang Weiming’s salary of 12,000 yuan, a mortgage of 15,000 yuan, extracurricular class fees, daily expenses, and so on, preparing materials for the evening family financial meeting.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Held the monthly family financial meeting with her husband.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 28, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming held a family finance meeting in the living room at home. The two reviewed the March income and expenditure details, confirmed that 5,000 yuan had been deposited into the savings account, and discussed April budget adjustments: planning to enroll their daughter in a drawing class, cutting entertainment spending, and, because income in the maintenance industry might decrease in the off-season, decided to increase the emergency fund from 60,000 yuan to 80,000 yuan.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Update April budget plan and financial records
subevent.description: The day after the meeting, Yu Xiaowei updated the April budget spreadsheet according to the family financial meeting resolutions, entered the new painting class expense item, lowered the entertainment budget amount, and set a reminder for increasing the emergency fund. At the same time, she sent the adjusted budget plan to her husband Zhang Weiming via WhatsApp for confirmation.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late at night, her daughter gave her a drawing to encourage her; the mother-daughter hug eased her fatigue somewhat.
description: Late at night on April 21, while Yu Xiaowei was revising a client proposal in the study, her daughter Zhang Yuxin made a crayon drawing in the living room. It showed a big flower and a smiling mother, and she wrote 'Mom, keep going!' on it. The daughter then quietly pushed open the study door and offered the drawing to her mother with both hands. Yu Xiaowei was so moved that she choked up, hugged her daughter tightly, and the fatigue of the past few days was eased by the warmth of family love.

subevent.name: Late-night overtime revising client proposals
subevent.description: On the evening of April 21, 2025, from about 10 to 11 p.m., Yu Xiaowei was focused on revising a client's insurance proposal at her desk in her home study. The computer screen was on, with documents and notes scattered across the desk. She looked somewhat tired from the pressure of consecutive days of work, but she persisted in refining the details of the proposal.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Home study on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Daughter Xinxin is getting a crayon drawing ready.
subevent.description: On the evening of April 21, five-year-old Zhang Yuxin used small crayons to draw a big flower and a smiling mother on drawing paper in the living room, and below the drawing she wrote the words “Mom, keep going” in a crooked scrawl. When she finished, she carefully held the drawing and walked to the study.
subevent.location: Living room at home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Daughter gave her mother a painting to encourage her, and the mother and daughter hugged warmly.
subevent.description: Around 11 p.m. late on April 21, Yu Xiaowei was buried in revising a proposal in her study when her daughter Zhang Yuxin quietly pushed open the door and handed her a crayon drawing she had drawn herself. The moment Yu Xiaowei saw the words and pattern on the drawing, she choked up and held her daughter tightly in her arms. The two embraced for a while, and the fatigue and grievances accumulated over the past days were relieved by the warmth of family affection.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Home study on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District

name: Friday facial treatment and stress relief with Su Lishan
description: To ease work and family pressure, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan renewed the monthly care card they had jointly purchased last month, planning to go to a beauty salon in Causeway Bay for facial treatments after work every Friday. This month, because of conflicts with the birthday family dinner on March 14 and the best friends' gathering on March 21, they only had treatments on March 7 and 28. During these sessions, the two exchanged work experiences and parenting worries, making them an important emotional outlet.

subevent.name: Facial treatment with Su Lishan at a beauty salon in Causeway Bay (March 7)
subevent.description: After work on Friday, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan went together to the beauty salon they often visit in Causeway Bay, using the monthly card they co-purchased last month for a relaxing facial treatment. During the treatment, they exchanged thoughts on the week's work and parenting worries, and after the treatment, each went home.
subevent.location: Beauty salon in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.

subevent.name: Had a facial treatment with Su Lishan at a beauty salon in Causeway Bay (March 28)
subevent.description: After work on Friday, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan went to the beauty salon in Causeway Bay again and used their monthly membership card for the final facial treatment of the month. Because the previous two weeks had been taken up by a birthday family dinner and a gathering with close friends, this was only the second facial treatment this month. As they chatted and shared recent updates during the treatment, their friendship grew closer.
subevent.location: Beauty salon in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.

name: Organize February sales performance and formulate and submit the March sprint plan
description: On the afternoon of February 28, Yu Xiaowei spent two hours in the office organizing February sales data, including metrics such as number of new policies, premium income, and client referral rate. She compared this with the goals set at the beginning of the year, found that performance was slightly behind, and immediately made a sprint plan for March, focusing on visiting three potential high-net-worth clients and following up on Wang Qiming's cross-border group insurance needs. She sent the plan to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua and asked for guidance.

subevent.name: Organize February sales performance data.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 28, 2025, Yu Xiaowei, in her office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, logged into the company's insurance sales system, retrieved her personal sales data for February, checked core indicators one by one such as the number of new policies, premium income, and client referral rate, compared them with the goals set at the beginning of the year, found that performance was slightly behind, and recorded the specific gaps.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Building Office

subevent.name: Develop a sales sprint plan for March
subevent.description: Based on the identified performance gaps, Yu Xiaowei formulated a detailed sprint plan for March in her office, highlighting visit plans for three potential high-net-worth clients (including a tech company founder, Wang Qiming), as well as follow-up strategies for Wang Qiming's company's cross-border group insurance needs, clarifying weekly action goals and expected premium contributions, and producing a written plan.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Building Office

subevent.name: Submitting the plan and asking supervisor for guidance
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei sent the finalized March sales sprint plan to her direct supervisor, regional sales director Liang Zhenhua, via the company's internal communication software, and attached a brief explanation in the message, asking Liang Zhenhua to provide guidance on the customer priorities and follow-up strategies in the plan in order to optimize execution.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Building Office

name: Weekend long-run training and trail running exploration with Shen Peiwen
description: On January 11, Yu Xiaowei confirmed the next morning's run plan with her running partner Shen Peiwen. On the morning of the 12th, after preparing her gear, she went to the Shing Mun River in Sha Tin and completed a 15 km easy run with Shen Peiwen. Along the way they discussed Chinese New Year plans and she received trail-running advice. After returning home, she searched online for routes such as the MacLehose Trail and considered adding them to her training plan.

subevent.name: Confirm the morning run meetup arrangement
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei communicated via WeChat with running partner Shen Peiwen, confirming to meet at 7 a.m. on January 12 at the entrance of the Shing Mun Riverbank Park in Sha Tin, and agreed to bring water and energy gels.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - home (Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District)

subevent.name: Preparation before morning run
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei got up early in the morning, put on her running gear (running clothes and running shoes), put her phone, keys, water, and energy gels into her waist pack, fed her pet cat, and then set off.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - home (Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District)

subevent.name: 15 km easy run along the Shing Mun River in Sha Tin
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei met Shen Peiwen by the Shing Mun River in Sha Tin, and the two completed a 15-kilometer run at an easy pace. While running, they chatted about the upcoming Spring Festival family plans and parenting trivialities. Shen Peiwen suggested trying trail running routes such as the MacLehose Trail in Hong Kong, and Yu Xiaowei expressed interest.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Sha Tin District - Shing Mun River

subevent.name: After returning home, searched for trail running information
subevent.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei used her phone to search online for the trail-running routes recommended by Shen Peiwen (such as Section 1 of the MacLehose Trail), learning about the route conditions, lengths, and transportation options, and considered incorporating them into the next phase of her training plan.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - home (Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District)

name: Husband cleaning the air conditioner; the couple working together in a display of family teamwork.
description: On the morning of Saturday, May 17, her husband Zhang Weiming used his day off to disassemble and clean the outdoor units of the two split-type air conditioners at home. Their son curiously handed him tools from the side. Yu Xiaowei prepared herbal tea and took photos to tease him. After cleaning, the air conditioners became more efficient, and Yu Xiaowei praised her husband's professional skills and sense of family responsibility. Through these daily chores, the couple strengthened their mutual understanding and warmth.

subevent.name: Dismantle and wash the air conditioner outdoor unit.
subevent.description: From 9:30 to 10:30 a.m., Zhang Weiming stood on a ladder and skillfully removed the protective cover of the outdoor air-conditioning unit, rinsing the condenser fins and fan with clean water and a dedicated cleaning agent. His son Zhang Zixuan handed up screwdrivers and cloths from below, while Yu Xiaowei stood by watching and occasionally passed up rags and tools. The family of three worked together in perfect coordination.
subevent.location: Home balcony at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

subevent.name: Prepared herbal tea and took a photo to joke about it.
subevent.description: Around 10 a.m., Yu Xiaowei returned to the kitchen, made two cups of Hong Kong-style herbal tea for her husband and son, and then went back to the balcony. Seeing her husband sweating profusely and carefully cleaning the air conditioner, she took out her phone, snapped two photos, and joked, 'Ming, looking like this you could go on a home guru show.' Zhang Weiming smiled and replied, 'Then remember to sign me up.'
subevent.location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Finished laundry and received praise
subevent.description: At 11 a.m., Zhang Weiming finished cleaning the two outdoor air-conditioning units, reinstalled the protective covers, and put the tools back in place. Yu Xiaowei handed him herbal tea and praised her husband for being professional and family-oriented, saying that the cooling effect of the air conditioners had obviously improved after cleaning. The couple smiled at each other, and their son imitated his mother and gave a thumbs-up. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Romantic dinner date with her husband
description: On the evening of January 16, Yu Xiaowei entrusted the children to her mother and went alone with her husband Zhang Weiming to a Thai restaurant in Tsim Sha Tsui for dinner. As they ate, they talked about their recent stresses and gains. Zhang Weiming encouraged her goal of being promoted to deputy manager, while Yu Xiaowei asked about his air-conditioning repair work. After dinner, the couple strolled along the Avenue of Stars, revisiting the romance of their dating days.

subevent.name: Arrange for the children to be cared for by her mother.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 16, Yu Xiaowei contacted her mother Chen Meiling in advance to confirm that her mother would help take care of her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin that evening. She picked up the children from school and took them home, prepared their dinner and bedtime routines, and briefed her mother on the children's homework and daily schedule, ensuring there were no worries for the evening date.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.

subevent.name: Set off with her husband for the Thai restaurant in Tsim Sha Tsui
subevent.description: In the early evening, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming left their home in Kowloon City and headed to Tsim Sha Tsui by MTR or by car. On the way, they chatted about daily work matters and planned their upcoming dinner date, in a relaxed and cheerful mood.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - On the way from home in Kowloon City District to Tsim Sha Tsui

subevent.name: Enjoying dinner at a Thai restaurant and exchanging updates
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming arrived at a Thai restaurant in Tsim Sha Tsui. After being seated, they ordered their favorite dishes, such as tom yum soup and Thai fried rice noodles. During the meal, they chatted about their recent work pressures and life gains: Zhang Weiming encouraged Yu Xiaowei to push toward her goal of promotion to deputy manager, while Yu Xiaowei expressed concern about the hardship and safety of her husband's air-conditioning repair work. The two shared amusing stories about their children's growth, and their bond deepened further.
subevent.location: A Thai restaurant in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: After dinner, took a walk on the Avenue of Stars and had a heart-to-heart talk
subevent.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming paid the bill, left the restaurant, and walked to the nearby Avenue of Stars. The two of them strolled side by side along the Victoria Harbour waterfront, enjoying the night view and reliving the romantic moments of their courtship. During this time, they talked about future family plans, such as the children's education and goals for traveling to Japan, and agreed to set aside regular time for dates alone to keep their marriage fresh.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Tsim Sha Tsui Avenue of Stars

subevent.name: Returned home to pick up the children and ended the date.
subevent.description: After strolling on the Avenue of Stars with her husband for about an hour, Yu Xiaowei returned home together with him to Kowloon City District. After arriving home, Yu Xiaowei thanked her mother Chen Meiling and looked in on the children, who had already fallen asleep. The couple tidied up briefly, then continued talking softly in the bedroom, savoring the date that evening, and then went to rest.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.

name: Attended the first in-person class of the CFP foundation course
description: On the evening of March 20, Yu Xiaowei set off from home for HKU SPACE to attend the first face-to-face class of the CFP certification basic course. The course covered financial planning fundamentals and professional ethics, and the instructor emphasized the importance of compliance through real cases. She took careful notes, exchanged contact information with several classmates after class, and planned to form a study group before returning home. The class gave her a real sense of the depth of professional certification and boosted her confidence for the exam.

subevent.name: Set off for the HKU School of Professional and Continuing Education
subevent.description: On the evening of March 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowei set out from her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, and took the MTR or a taxi to the HKU School of Professional and Continuing Education in Admiralty, Hong Kong Island, to prepare for attending the first in-person class of the CFP foundation course.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - HKU School of Professional and Continuing Education

subevent.name: Attend the CFP basic course in-person class.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at the classroom on time in the evening to attend the first in-person class of the CFP certification basic course. The course content covered the fundamentals of financial planning and professional ethics. The instructor emphasized the importance of compliance through real cases. Yu Xiaowei listened attentively and took detailed notes. She felt the depth of the professional certification and gained more confidence in preparing for the exam.
subevent.location: Hong Kong – classroom at HKU School of Professional and Continuing Education

subevent.name: After class, talked with classmates and formed a study group.
subevent.description: After the class, Yu Xiaowei proactively talks with several classmates around her, exchanges contact information, and they plan together to form a study group for mutual discussion and encouragement during subsequent exam preparation. The exchange lasts about 20 minutes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - corridor outside the classroom, HKU SPACE

subevent.name: Returning home
subevent.description: After finishing the after-class discussion, Yu Xiaowei returned to her home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, by MTR or taxi. On the way, she reviewed her course notes and felt full of anticipation for future learning.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home

name: Conduct the annual policy review for long-term client Chen Meiling and follow up on service
description: On February 19, Yu Xiaowei confirmed the visit time for the next afternoon with client Chen Meiling in advance, and sorted out the existing policy records of her entire family, preparing materials for children's education fund insurance. On the afternoon of February 20, she went to Chen Meiling's home in Taikoo Shing as agreed to review the family's medical and savings policies for Mrs. Chen. Based on the fact that her son was about to enter secondary school, she suggested adding education fund insurance and answered questions about dividend rates. That night, she organized and filed the key review points and recorded referral leads. On February 21, she proactively contacted the referred client Mrs. Lin and scheduled a meeting, while sharing the service results with her supervisor Liang Zhenhua.

subevent.name: Confirm the appointment in advance and prepare the policy documents.
subevent.description: The day before the visit, Yu Xiaowei confirmed the afternoon visit time for February 20 with the client Chen Meiling through WeChat, and looked up the company system to organize the existing policy records of Chen Meiling's family (including medical and savings policies). She also reviewed education information related to Chen Meiling's son's upcoming transition to secondary school, and prepared the product brochure and dividend rate illustration for a children's education insurance.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Go to Taikoo Shing to visit Chen Meiling for a policy review
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 20, Yu Xiaowei arrived as scheduled at Chen Meiling's home in Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, Hong Kong, and conducted a face-to-face annual review of the family's medical and savings insurance policies with Mrs. Chen. She carefully reviewed each policy's coverage, premium payments, and investment performance. In light of the fact that Mrs. Chen's son was about to enter secondary school, she recommended adding a children's education endowment insurance. She also patiently answered Mrs. Chen's questions about the dividend rate, further strengthening the client's trust.
subevent.location: Chen Meiling's home, Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Sort and archive the review records
subevent.description: After the visit, Yu Xiaowei recorded the key points of this review on her phone on the way home, including policy adjustment suggestions, Mrs. Chen's interest in education fund insurance, the dividend rate details she explained, and new client leads from referrals. That evening, she organized the review report into an electronic document on her home computer and updated the remarks in the client file system for future service reference.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Follow up on new client referral leads.
subevent.description: Based on the referral lead provided by Chen Meiling (Mrs. Chen's friend Mrs. Lin had insurance needs), Yu Xiaowei proactively added Mrs. Lin on WeChat and scheduled a phone call. At the same time, she shared the smooth policy review process and client feedback with her supervisor Liang Zhenhua to gain follow-up business support, and recorded it in the customer relationship management system.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

name: Made a family photo wall with her children on Mother's Day
description: On Mother's Day, Yu Xiaowei took her children to a print shop in the morning to develop family photos and bought materials such as corkboard. In the afternoon, she arranged the photos in chronological order with her children in the living room and together they made a warm family photo wall.

subevent.name: Go out to print family photos and buy materials
subevent.description: On the morning of Mother's Day, Yu Xiaowei took her children Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin to a print shop in Kowloon City District to develop and print dozens of carefully selected family photos. Then they went to a nearby stationery store to buy a cork board, push pins, tape, decorative stickers, and other materials for making a photo wall, preparing for the afternoon craft activity.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Printing and Stationery Shop

subevent.name: Make a family photo wall by hand
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei spread a cork board on the dining table in the living room and, together with her children, arranged the printed photos in chronological order—from the 2010 wedding photos to the birth of her eldest son in 2015, the birth of her daughter in 2018, and then photos of recent family trips. The children were responsible for taping down one corner of each photo, and Yu Xiaowei finished by decorating with stickers, together creating a warm memory wall.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

name: Spring Festival family reunion; younger brother shared mainland insurance technology
description: On February 1, 2025 (the fourth day of the first lunar month), Yu Xiaowei's younger brother Yu Xiaofeng brought his wife and children back to Hong Kong from the mainland for a family reunion. During the meal, Yu Xiaofeng enthusiastically introduced the latest developments in mainland insurance technology, such as trends like smart underwriting and online claims. Yu Xiaowei was inspired and began seriously considering the possibility of cross-border business, planting a seed in her mind to explore the Shenzhen market.

subevent.name: Preparing for family dinner
subevent.description: On the morning of February 1, 2025, Yu Xiaowei, together with her husband Zhang Weiming and her mother Chen Meiling, went to the Kowloon City street market to buy fresh ingredients and traditional Chinese New Year goods, preparing to welcome her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng's family back to Hong Kong from Shenzhen for a reunion. Yu Xiaowei also specially prepared the children's favorite fruits and snacks, and decorated the home with Spring Festival decorations.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home at 328 Prince Edward Road West and nearby street market

subevent.name: Family gathering and meal
subevent.description: At noon on February 1, 2025, Yu Xiaofeng arrived at Yu Xiaowei's home in Hong Kong from Shenzhen with his wife and two children, and the two families enjoyed a hearty lunch together. During the meal, they chatted about family matters; the elders asked about the younger generation's recent lives, and the children played together. After lunch, Yu Xiaofeng brought up the development of insurtech in mainland China, introducing Yu Xiaowei to innovative trends such as intelligent underwriting and online claims. Yu Xiaowei listened carefully and began to think about the possibility of cross-border business.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home living room and dining room at 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: While having a beauty treatment with a colleague, she learned that a client might be poached but did not become alert.
description: After work on Wednesday, July 23, Yu Xiaowei went to a beauty salon with her colleague Su Lishan. While wearing a face mask, Su Lishan said with her eyes closed, "Recently I feel something is off with the team. It seems like someone is poaching your clients, especially the high-end ones... but I can't say for sure, there's no real evidence." Yu Xiaowei smiled, thought Su Lishan was being paranoid, and reassured her not to overthink it, then continued to rest with her eyes closed. She did not connect these words to Zhou Minyi's recent enthusiasm, and the seed of vigilance had not yet sprouted.

subevent.name: Agreed to go to the beauty salon after work
subevent.description: On Wednesday afternoon, July 23, 2025, near the end of the workday, Yu Xiaowei contacted her colleague Su Lishan via WeChat at the Wan Chai office of AIA Hong Kong. The two agreed to go together after work to their usual beauty salon in Kowloon City District for facial treatments to relieve work fatigue.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Hong Kong Tower

subevent.name: Arrived at the beauty salon and started applying a face mask.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan left the office together and took the MTR to a beauty salon in Kowloon City District. Upon arrival, they were led by the beautician into a double treatment room, where they lay down, put on face masks, and began to relax.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - a beauty salon

subevent.name: While applying a face mask, Su Lishan mentioned her concern that a client might be poached.
subevent.description: While wearing a face mask at the beauty salon, Su Lishan closed her eyes and whispered to Yu Xiaowei that she felt something was off with the team recently, as if someone was secretly poaching Yu Xiaowei's high-end clients, but she had no actual evidence. Yu Xiaowei laughed after hearing this, thought Su Lishan was being paranoid, and instead comforted her not to overthink it. The two then continued to rest with their eyes closed and did not discuss it further.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - treatment room of a beauty salon

subevent.name: After the beauty treatment, everyone went home separately.
subevent.description: After the face mask and follow-up skincare routine, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan settled the bill at the beauty salon front desk and said goodbye, then each took transportation home. Back at her home on Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City District, Yu Xiaowei chatted briefly with her family and rested. She did not connect Su Lishan's reminder with Zhou Minyi's recent unusual enthusiasm.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - a beauty salon and their respective residences

name: Pre-holiday preparations, post-holiday restructuring meeting, and promotion bid
description: Following last month's rumors of organizational restructuring, Yu Xiaowei spent the evening of February 4 at home organizing performance data and a strategy for the talk, preparing for the next day's meeting and her push for promotion. On February 5, the first workday after the holiday, Liang Zhenhua held an emergency meeting to formally announce the regional structure optimization plan, which involved team restructuring and reporting line adjustments. After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei proactively asked to see Liang Zhenhua and honestly expressed her wish to be promoted to deputy manager, presenting her past performance and management approach, but received no clear commitment and was only told to 'wait for the overall arrangements.' That evening, she drew up an action plan to improve her performance, determined to prove herself with stronger results.

subevent.name: Prepare meeting materials and talking points in advance
subevent.description: On the evening of February 4, Yu Xiaowei organized recent sales data and team management records in her home study, reviewed last month's rumors of structural adjustment, and thought through the key demands and performance evidence for tomorrow's conversation with Liang Zhenhua after the meeting, fully preparing for the meeting and the push for promotion.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Attend emergency meeting on regional organizational structure optimization
subevent.description: On the morning of February 5, the first working day after the holiday, Yu Xiaowei attended an emergency meeting led by regional sales director Liang Zhenhua in the conference room at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong. Liang Zhenhua officially announced the regional structure optimization plan, involving team restructuring and reporting line adjustments, and answered questions from the floor. Yu Xiaowei carefully noted the key points and noticed that her own team might be affected.
subevent.location: Meeting room, AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: After the meeting, proactively request a meeting with Liang Zhenhua to seek a promotion.
subevent.description: After the urgent meeting ended, Yu Xiaowei privately met her superior in Liang Zhenhua's office that afternoon and candidly expressed her desire to be promoted to deputy manager. She detailed her performance data, customer satisfaction, and future management approach over the past few years. Liang Zhenhua gave no clear commitment after listening, only replying, "We'll see the overall arrangements." Yu Xiaowei thus sensed uncertainty in the promotion competition.
subevent.location: Office of Liang Zhenhua, AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Develop a follow-up action plan for performance improvement.
subevent.description: Returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowei re-examined her client files and sales targets in her study and made a high-intensity client visit and product recommendation plan for the next two weeks, determined to prove her value through stronger performance to increase her chances of promotion. She also briefly shared the day's work with her husband Zhang Weiming.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Inquired about and enrolled her daughter in a ballet class.
description: On January 4, Yu Xiaowei called the dance school to ask about and book a trial class for January 11. On January 11, she took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to the dance studio for the introductory ballet trial class. Her daughter said she loved it very much, so she enrolled and paid on the spot, receiving practice clothes and dance shoes. After returning home, she shared the good news with her family and helped her daughter prepare for class. Her daughter's enthusiasm for dance made Yu Xiaowei feel gratified, and the mother and daughter built a new weekend routine together.

subevent.name: Phoned to inquire and book a trial class.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei called the shortlisted dance schools to ask about the details and trial class arrangements for beginner ballet classes suitable for a 5-year-old girl, and finally booked a free trial class at one of the dance studios with a good reputation for the morning of January 11.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Take my daughter to a trial ballet class
subevent.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to the dance studio in Kowloon Tong for a 45-minute introductory ballet trial class. Yu Xiaowei waited outside, and after the class spoke with the teacher about her daughter's performance. Her daughter said she liked it very much.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Dance Studio

subevent.name: Officially registered and paid the fee
subevent.description: After the trial class, Yu Xiaowei decided to enroll. She filled out the enrollment form at the dance studio front desk on the spot, paid the first month's tuition and costume fee, and signed the course agreement. She confirmed the fixed class time of Saturday mornings 9:00-9:45, and received ballet practice clothes and dance shoes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Dance Studio

subevent.name: After returning home, organized and informed the family.
subevent.description: After taking her daughter home, Yu Xiaowei told her husband Zhang Weiming and her mother Chen Meiling the good news about the successful enrollment, took out the newly bought dance shoes for her daughter to try on, and shared photos in the family WeChat group. In the evening, she helped her daughter prepare the supply bag needed for next Saturday's class.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

name: Received February salary and transferred it into a savings account.
description: On February 25, after Yu Xiaowei received her February salary of about HK$25,000, she immediately transferred HK$20,000 via online banking into a current savings account, and used the remaining HK$5,000 for daily expenses, following the principle of "dividing the salary as soon as it arrives."

subevent.name: Received notification of February salary deposit
subevent.description: On February 25, at her home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, Yu Xiaowei received a February salary transfer notification from AIA Hong Kong via the mobile banking app, confirming that about 25000 Hong Kong dollars had arrived. After checking the salary details and finding no errors, she prepared to execute the fund allocation operation.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Transfer salary to a savings account
subevent.description: On February 25, after receiving notification that her salary had arrived, Yu Xiaowei immediately transferred 20,000 Hong Kong dollars from her salary account to a current savings account via online banking, while keeping another 5,000 Hong Kong dollars in the salary account for daily household expenses. This operation followed the principle of 'split the salary as soon as it lands' established last month, ensuring the family savings goal would be steadily achieved.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Mapping the Shenzhen client relationship network and devising a balanced strategy
description: On Friday, August 29, Yu Xiaowei used her lunch break at the AIA Insurance office to sort through the Shenzhen and Hong Kong client lists, marked the Hong Kong clients who had been neglected recently, and formulated a key visit plan for the last two days of August and early September.

subevent.name: Retrieve the customer list and tools.
subevent.description: At her workstation in the AIA insurance office, Yu Xiaowei took out the Shenzhen and Hong Kong client lists from a folder and prepared stationery such as pens and sticky notes, preparing to sort out her work during the lunch break.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - AIA Insurance office

subevent.name: Sorted through and marked the client list
subevent.description: During her lunch break, Yu Xiaowei went through the Shenzhen and Hong Kong client lists one by one at her desk, highlighting the Hong Kong clients who had not been contacted recently and had been neglected. She wrote notes next to their names (such as last visit time and follow-up items).
subevent.location: Hong Kong - AIA Insurance office

subevent.name: Formulate a priority visit plan
subevent.description: Based on the compiled results, Yu Xiaowei planned out in her notebook the order and schedule of client visits for the last two days of August and early September, prioritized them, ensured a balanced allocation of service effort between Shenzhen and Hong Kong clients, and listed the visit objectives and required materials for each client.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - AIA Insurance office

name: Weekend morning run for recovery training
description: On Saturday morning, May 10, after dropping her daughter off at ballet class, Yu Xiaowei went for a 30-minute jog in Kowloon Tsai Park at a pace of about 6:30 per kilometer. This was her first recovery run since suspending systematic training in April. She felt her cardiorespiratory fitness had declined somewhat, but after the run she felt mentally refreshed and decided to gradually resume her weekend morning running habit to build a foundation for the fall half marathon.

subevent.name: Taking her daughter to ballet class
subevent.description: At around 8:30 a.m. on May 10, Yu Xiaowei drove her 5-year-old daughter Zhang Yuxin to a ballet school in Kowloon Tong for class. On the way, she told her daughter to wait for her after class. She planned to use the 1 hour while her daughter was in class to do a recovery run.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon Tong - Ballet School

subevent.name: Went to Kowloon Tsai Park
subevent.description: After dropping off her daughter, Yu Xiaowei drove about 5 minutes to the Kowloon Tsai Park car park, changed into her running shoes, opened the running app on her phone to prepare positioning and recording, and did a simple warm-up stretch.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon Tsai Park Car Park

subevent.name: 30-minute jogging session
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei started jogging from the park entrance and ran at a steady pace along the inner loop, with a pace of about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer and a total distance of about 4.6 kilometers. Along the way, she felt that her cardiovascular fitness had declined compared with before she paused in April, but her overall condition was good and she felt happy. She gradually sped up during the last kilometer.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon Tsai Park running track

subevent.name: Post-run stretching and recovery
subevent.description: After the jog, Yu Xiaowei did about 10 minutes of static stretching on the park lawn, focusing on relaxing the front and back thighs and calf muscles. She also drank water to rehydrate and used her phone to record and review the running data.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon Tsai Park lawn.

name: While shopping with her best friend, she learned about the friend's interview and the friend declined the insurance suggestion.
description: On Saturday afternoon, July 19, Yu Xiaowei and Lin Jiaxin went shopping in Causeway Bay. Lin Jiaxin mentioned that last Monday she had impulsively gone to an interview for an administrative assistant position, but had not heard back yet. Yu Xiaowei again suggested she consider getting an insurance license, saying she could bring her into the industry. Lin Jiaxin shook her head and said softly, "I don't want to rely on you to introduce me to everything. I want to see if I can make it on my own." Yu Xiaowei tactfully changed the subject, but knew in her heart that her best friend was trying hard to stop being dependent, and their relationship was beginning to become more equal.

subevent.name: Appointment and departure for Causeway Bay.
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, July 19, Yu Xiaowei and her close friend Lin Jiaxin agreed via WeChat to meet and shop in Causeway Bay. Yu Xiaowei set out from her home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, took the MTR to Causeway Bay station, and arrived at the meeting place—the entrance of Hysan Place in Causeway Bay—at about 2 p.m.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Hysan Place, Causeway Bay

subevent.name: While shopping, Lin Jiaxin mentioned her interview experience.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and Lin Jiaxin went shopping at Hysan Place, visiting several clothing and cosmetics stores. As they browsed and chatted, Lin Jiaxin mentioned that last Monday (July 14) she had gone to an interview for an administrative assistant position on a whim but hadn't yet received an offer. Yu Xiaowei expressed concern and asked about the interview details.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Hysan Place, Causeway Bay

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowei's suggestion to take the insurance licensing exam was rejected.
subevent.description: During a break from shopping, Yu Xiaowei once again suggested that Lin Jiaxin consider getting an insurance license, saying she could bring her into the industry and that Lin Jiaxin's warmth would make her good at insurance sales. Lin Jiaxin shook her head and replied softly, "I don't want to rely on you for everything; I want to try whether I can make it on my own." Yu Xiaowei sensed that her best friend wanted to be independent and tactfully changed the subject.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Hysan Place, Causeway Bay

subevent.name: Continuing shopping and ending the trip
subevent.description: After Yu Xiaowei changed the subject, the two continued shopping in Causeway Bay and went to a dessert shop near Times Square for afternoon tea, chatting about light topics outside work. Around 5:30 p.m., they said goodbye at Causeway Bay MTR station. Yu Xiaowei took a car home, while Lin Jiaxin returned to her residence in Sham Shui Po.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Times Square, Causeway Bay

name: Best friend Lin Jiaxin's birthday party, where career worries surfaced.
description: On Friday evening, March 21, Yu Xiaowei and Huang Wenhui celebrated the birthday of their close friend Lin Jiaxin. The three met at an izakaya in Causeway Bay. During the meal, after drinking a little sake, Lin Jiaxin suddenly sighed and mentioned that due to declining student enrollment, the school might reduce staff benefits next semester and even cut administrative positions. Since she was on the logistics support staff, she was very worried. Yu Xiaowei and Huang Wenhui comforted her and told her not to be too anxious, but at the time they did not realize how serious the problem was, and this set the stage for Lin Jiaxin's road to independence.

subevent.name: Prepare a birthday gift for Lin Jiaxin
subevent.description: That afternoon, Yu Xiaowei went to a shopping mall in Causeway Bay to pick out a birthday gift for her close friend Lin Jiaxin. She ended up choosing an exquisite pearl bracelet as a birthday surprise and wrapped it carefully.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Causeway Bay - Shopping Mall

subevent.name: Going to an izakaya for a birthday party
subevent.description: At 6:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei left home with the gift she had prepared, took the MTR to Causeway Bay, and agreed to meet Huang Wenhui at the entrance of the izakaya to celebrate Lin Jiaxin's birthday together.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Causeway Bay - MTR station and izakaya entrance

subevent.name: Shared career worries at Lin Jiaxin's birthday party
subevent.description: From 7 to 9 PM, Yu Xiaowei, Huang Wenhui, and Lin Jiaxin gathered at an izakaya in Causeway Bay to celebrate a birthday. During the meal, Lin Jiaxin became a bit down after drinking some sake and mentioned that the school, due to declining student enrollment, might reduce staff benefits or even cut administrative and logistics positions next semester. Since she was on the logistics staff, she was very worried. Yu Xiaowei and Huang Wenhui comforted her, telling her not to be too nervous, and encouraged her to look for other opportunities, but at the time the two did not realize how serious the problem was. The three chatted while eating, and the mood gradually became relaxed again.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Causeway Bay - Izakaya

subevent.name: After the gathering, everyone went home separately.
subevent.description: At 9:30 p.m., the three ended their gathering and said goodbye to each other at the entrance of the izakaya. Yu Xiaowei took the MTR back to her home in Kowloon City District, and after arriving, sent a message in the best friends' group chat to report she was safe, checked on Lin Jiaxin's mood again, and arranged to talk more on the weekend.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

name: Night run along the waterfront with running buddy Shen Peiwen: friendship and release
description: On the evening of February 27, Yu Xiaowei met her running buddy Shen Peiwen at Kwun Tong Promenade for a five-kilometer jog. After the run, the two had hot soy milk and wonton noodles at a nearby Hong Kong-style diner, chatting about recent life: Shen Peiwen shared her experience taking students to a recitation competition, while Yu Xiaowei talked about her busy February and her husband's concerns about the industry. The release of exercise and the warmth of friendship helped her regain a sense of balance, and their friendship grew stronger.

subevent.name: Evening preparations and departure
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei changed into her sportswear at home in Kowloon City District, brought her water bottle and phone, and checked that her running shoes were suitable. She then drove her family car from home to the Kwun Tong Promenade, about 20 minutes away by car. She had confirmed the meeting time with Shen Peiwen in advance via WeChat.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: 5 km jog along the waterfront promenade with Shen Peiwen
subevent.description: At 6 p.m., Yu Xiaowei met Shen Peiwen at the entrance to the Kwun Tong Promenade. They jogged five kilometers along the promenade at a pace of about seven minutes per kilometer. As they ran, they chatted about their recent lives: Shen Peiwen shared funny stories about taking students to a recitation contest, and Yu Xiaowei talked about her busy February and her husband's concerns about the industry outlook.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kwun Tong District - Kwun Tong Promenade

subevent.name: Post-run late-night supper and chat at a cha chaan teng
subevent.description: After the jog, Yu Xiaowei and Shen Peiwen went to a Hong Kong-style tea restaurant near the waterfront promenade. Each ordered a steaming bowl of wonton noodles and a cup of hot soy milk, and sat in a booth eating and chatting. The conversation shifted from how the run felt to their respective work and family updates. Shen Peiwen encouraged Yu Xiaowei to keep up her exercise routine to relieve work pressure. The two chatted for about forty minutes, and their friendship grew stronger amid laughter.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kwun Tong District - cha chaan teng

name: Fatty suddenly developed hairball disease and was taken to the vet
description: On the evening of Tuesday, August 26, 2025, Yu Xiaowei came home from work and found Feizai vomiting and listless. She immediately took him to a 24-hour pet hospital. He was diagnosed with hairball disease with mild gastroenteritis and needed to stay overnight for observation. After completing the procedures, she went home alone; without the cat's footsteps, the house felt cold and empty. The next evening she picked up Feizai and, following the doctor's advice, began feeding him hairball paste every day. This small incident made her manage Feizai's diet and grooming more carefully.

subevent.name: Discovered Feizai vomiting and listless
subevent.description: In the evening of August 26, 2025, Yu Xiaowei returned home from work to No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, and found her pet cat Feizai showing vomiting symptoms and listlessness. She immediately checked Feizai's condition, judged it abnormal, and decided to rush him to the vet.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Rushed to hospital, diagnosed, and admitted for observation
subevent.description: That evening, Yu Xiaowei quickly took Fatty to a nearby 24-hour pet hospital. After an examination, the veterinarian confirmed that Fatty had hairball disease with mild gastroenteritis and needed to stay overnight for observation. After learning about the condition and the estimated cost, Yu Xiaowei completed the hospitalization procedures, left her contact information, and left alone.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - 24-hour Pet Hospital

subevent.name: Returning home alone felt lonely and empty.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei returned alone from the pet hospital to her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West. Because Feizai was not home, she felt the house was especially quiet and empty, and her mood was low. She had a simple dinner, sent her husband Zhang Weiming a message to explain the situation, and then went to bed early.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Picked up Fatty and learned the doctor's orders
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 27, 2025, Yu Xiaowei went to the pet hospital again to pick up Feizai after treatment. The doctor explained in detail the follow-up care points: she needed to feed him hairball gel daily for a week and watch his bowel movements. Yu Xiaowei carefully noted the instructions, paid the remaining fee, and took Feizai home.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - 24-hour Pet Hospital

name: Year-Start Work Kickoff Day: Preparation, Meetings, and Discussions
description: On January 2, Yu Xiaowei spent the morning at home in her study organizing client development cases and preparing sharing materials, then went to the AIA Building to attend the New Year business kickoff meeting. Regional Director Liang Zhenhua outlined quarterly targets and emphasized cross-border insurance cooperation opportunities in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Yu Xiaowei shared her experience and received recognition. After the meeting, she discussed the New Year client maintenance plan with colleague Su Lishan in the rest area and finalized the follow-up strategy for high-net-worth clients.

subevent.name: Preparing sharing materials before the meeting
subevent.description: Before the meeting, Yu Xiaowei organized successful cases and data from past client development in her home study, prepared the PPT outline and key talking points for sharing, to ensure she could clearly and convincingly present her experience at the morning business kickoff meeting.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home study

subevent.name: Attend the New Year business kickoff meeting
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei went to the company meeting room to attend AIA's 2025 New Year business kickoff meeting. Regional director Liang Zhenhua laid out the first-quarter sales targets, emphasized cross-border insurance cooperation opportunities in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and organized team discussions. As arranged, Yu Xiaowei went on stage to share her experience in customer development and received recognition from colleagues.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR, Wan Chai District - AIA Building Meeting Room

subevent.name: Discussed customer maintenance plans after the meeting.
subevent.description: After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan had a detailed discussion in the lounge about the New Year client retention plan. They analyzed the existing client list, identified the high-net-worth clients to prioritize in the first quarter and the follow-up visit strategy, and agreed on future collaboration arrangements.
subevent.location: Rest area, AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Called my younger brother Yu Xiaofeng to discuss our father's attitude problem.
description: On the evening of June 16, Yu Xiaowei proactively made a video call to her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen, pouring out her feelings about her father's distrustful attitude at the Father's Day dim sum breakfast. Her brother admitted that their father had also tested him in a similar way. The two analyzed their father's worries, and her brother suggested taking their father for a physical checkup or a trip to ease the relationship. Yu Xiaowei felt relieved, and the siblings agreed to contact each other again on the weekend.

subevent.name: Take the initiative to contact her younger brother
subevent.description: On the evening of June 16, 2025, after finishing the family dinner, Yu Xiaowei felt wronged and confused when she recalled her father's distrustful attitude at the Father's Day morning tea toward her having concealed her career transition. She decided to confide in her close younger brother, Yu Xiaofeng, and ask for his advice. Yu Xiaowei picked up her phone and made a WeChat video call to her brother, who was far away in Shenzhen. She sat on the sofa in the living room of her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, waiting for her brother to answer.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - living room at home

subevent.name: Had a video call with her younger brother to discuss their father's attitude.
subevent.description: After the video call connected, Yu Xiaowei told her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng in detail about her conversation with their father over Father's Day morning tea, expressing her disappointment that their father did not trust her career choice. Yu Xiaofeng answered from his home in Shenzhen. He frankly said that their father had recently made similar probing remarks to him as well. The two analyzed together what their father might be worried about—that his children might be unstable in their finances or careers. Yu Xiaofeng suggested that his sister take their father for a checkup next time or arrange a short family trip to improve understanding and ease the relationship. Yu Xiaowei felt that her brother's rational analysis put her somewhat at ease, and the siblings agreed to get in touch again next weekend. The call lasted about 40 minutes, and after it ended Yu Xiaowei felt better.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - living room at home

name: Conduct the monthly financial review and budget adjustment with her husband
description: On the evening of April 21, after their daughter fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming reviewed the family's monthly income and expenses in the study. They discussed the impulse-purchased designer bag and the extra medical expenses from her mother-in-law's accidental sprain, and readjusted the May budget, cutting non-essential spending by 10% while increasing the monthly allocation to the emergency reserve fund. The two agreed to set a family financial goal: save an additional 20,000 Hong Kong dollars before the end of the year as a family travel fund.

subevent.name: Prepare financial materials.
subevent.description: After their daughter fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei took out April's spending receipts and bank statements from her personal handbag, and Zhang Weiming took the family ledger and calculator from the study drawer. The two sat down together at the small desk in the study to begin the monthly financial review.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Review this month's household income and expenditures
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming checked April's household income and expenditure items one by one, focusing on two unusual expenses: a designer bag that Yu Xiaowei bought for herself (an impulse purchase) and the additional medical expenses from Zhang Weiming's mother's accidental sprain. The two analyzed the impact of these expenses on the month's budget and confirmed that total spending exceeded the budget by about 3,000 Hong Kong dollars.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Adjust the May budget plan
subevent.description: Based on the overspending in April, Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming jointly redrew the May family budget. They decided to reduce non-essential expenses (such as entertainment, shopping, and dining out) by 10%, and increase the monthly allocation to the emergency reserve from HK$2,000 to HK$3,000, to cope with possible unexpected expenses in the future. The two recorded the adjusted budget figures in the account book.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Set a Family Travel Fund Goal
subevent.description: After adjusting the budget, Yu Xiaowei proposed setting up an annual family travel fund, with the goal of saving an additional 20,000 Hong Kong dollars by the end of 2025. Zhang Weiming expressed support. The two discussed a specific savings approach: starting in May, deposit 4,000 Hong Kong dollars each month from the family surplus into a dedicated savings account, and agreed to review the progress every quarter. Yu Xiaowei wrote down the goal in her accounting notebook and signed to confirm.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Organize meeting minutes and wrap up
subevent.description: Before the meeting ended, Yu Xiaowei organized the key points of this financial review, the May budget adjustment plan, and the travel fund plan into written minutes and took a photo with her phone to save them. Zhang Weiming put the ledger and calculator back in the drawer. The two tidied up the desk together and, after confirming they had reached a consensus, Yu Xiaowei set a reminder for next month's review in her phone's memo app before going to bed.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

name: Recommended an education savings rider to a regular client and successfully closed the sale.
description: On January 7, Yu Xiaowei organized the education savings rider materials and called long-time client Mrs. Chan to confirm the next day's visit. On January 8, she visited Mrs. Chan as scheduled, gave a professional explanation based on the educational needs of Mrs. Chan's children, won her trust, assisted in completing the insurance application and signing, and returned to the company to enter the policy into the system, successfully achieving the first policy of the “good start” campaign.

subevent.name: Preparing education savings rider materials and confirming the visit
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei organized materials for the education savings rider, including product brochures, benefit illustration tables, and application forms, in her home study and company office, and called her long-time client Chen Meiling (Mrs. Chen) to confirm the visit at her home in Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, Hong Kong, at 10:00 a.m. on January 8.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong - home study; Eastern District, Hong Kong - Taikoo Shing

subevent.name: Visited Mrs. Chen for product introduction and needs communication.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei went to Mrs. Chen's residence at King's Court, Taikoo Shing as agreed. In response to the future education planning needs of her two children, she introduced in detail the savings growth of the education savings rider, the education fund withdrawal plan, and the additional protection functions. Through professional explanations and case comparisons, she resolved the client's concerns and earned Mrs. Chen's trust and recognition.
subevent.location: Mrs. Chen's home, Goldinfine Terrace, Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Complete the contract signing and subsequent data entry.
subevent.description: After Mrs. Chen decided to take out the policy, Yu Xiaowei helped her fill in the application form, verify her personal information and coverage terms, complete the electronic signing, and issue a receipt for the first premium on the spot. After leaving, Yu Xiaowei returned to her office at the AIA Building in Wan Chai, entered the policy information into the system, and completed the policy activation process, bringing the first deal of the 2025 New Year sales campaign to a successful close.
subevent.location: Eastern District, Hong Kong - Mrs. Chan's home, Kin Tien Terrace, Taikoo Shing; Wan Chai District, Hong Kong - AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road.

name: Gave her husband a tool kit on Valentine's Day to ease his anxiety about his career transition.
