description: On the day before Valentine's Day (February 13), Yu Xiaowei made a special trip to a hardware tool store in Mong Kok to buy her husband Zhang Weiming a German-brand ratchet wrench set that he had been mentioning for a long time. On the evening of February 14, Valentine's Day, the two came to an old-style cafe in Mong Kok to relive the warmth of their dating days. During the meal, Yu Xiaowei gave him the gift. Her husband's eyes grew slightly moist as he confided his worries about the industry transformation. Yu Xiaowei held his hand and gently comforted him, “We'll face it together.” The couple's relationship deepened through understanding.

subevent.name: Buy Valentine's Day gift
subevent.description: To prepare a Valentine's Day surprise for her husband Zhang Weiming, Yu Xiaowei went out of her way to a reputable hardware store in Mong Kok and bought the German-brand ratchet wrench set her husband had been talking about for a long time. She carefully checked the completeness and quality of the set and asked the store clerk to wrap it nicely, planning to give it to him at the Valentine's Day dinner the next day.
subevent.location: Mong Kok, Hong Kong - Hardware Store

subevent.name: Going to a cha chaan teng for dinner together
subevent.description: On Valentine's Day evening, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming went to the old-style cha chaan teng in Mong Kok they used to frequent when they were young. They ordered the signature pineapple bun with butter and silk-stocking milk tea, reliving the warm atmosphere of their dating days. They chatted about everyday life while eating, in a relaxed and pleasant mood.
subevent.location: Mong Kok, Hong Kong – Old-style tea restaurant

subevent.name: Giving a gift and listening to her husband's concerns.
subevent.description: During the meal at the cha chaan teng, Yu Xiaowei handed her husband Zhang Weiming a German-brand ratchet wrench set she had prepared earlier. After opening the gift, Zhang Weiming's eyes grew slightly moist, and he then confided his anxiety about the industry's transformation and his worries about their family's future. Yu Xiaowei held his hand and said gently but firmly, 'We'll face it together.' The couple's relationship deepened through their mutual understanding.
subevent.location: Mong Kok, Hong Kong – Old-style tea restaurant

subevent.name: Walked home in a relaxed mood
subevent.description: After finishing dinner and pouring out their worries, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming took a walk hand in hand on the streets of Mong Kok, letting the evening breeze soothe their emotions. They talked about future plans and coping strategies, and became even more determined to face difficulties together, then walked home together.
subevent.location: Mong Kok, Hong Kong - street

name: Yu Xiaowei shared her homemade coffee; Su Lishan proactively shared the training workload and confirmed the division of responsibilities.
description: On the morning of May 20, Yu Xiaowei carefully made homemade coffee at home and brought it to the office. At the team morning meeting that day, she shared the coffee with her colleagues, and the atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious. During the meeting, senior team member Su Lishan proactively offered to share part of the new-hire training work so that Yu Xiaowei could focus on maintaining key clients. After the morning meeting, the two further confirmed the specifics of the training division in the pantry and reached an agreement on the handover method and schedule.

subevent.name: Preparing homemade coffee to bring to the office.
subevent.description: Before leaving home that morning, Yu Xiaowei used the premium coffee beans and coffee machine she had purchased to make enough coffee to share with the whole team in her home kitchen, poured it into a thermos, and carried it out with her briefcase, ready to share with colleagues at the morning meeting.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region — home kitchen on Prince Edward Road West.

subevent.name: Shared coffee at the team morning meeting; Su Lishan proactively shared the workload.
subevent.description: The team morning meeting that day was held in the meeting room of the AIA Hong Kong office in Wan Chai District. Yu Xiaowei poured homemade coffee into paper cups and distributed it to the attending colleagues, and the atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious. During the meeting, senior team member Su Lishan raised her hand and volunteered to take on some of the new-hire training work so that Yu Xiaowei could focus more on maintaining key clients. Yu Xiaowei expressed her thanks and announced the preliminary arrangement on the spot.
subevent.location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: After the meeting, confirmed the details of the training task division with Su Lishan.
subevent.description: After the morning meeting, Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to approach Su Lishan. The two continued to discuss the specific content, scheduling, and handover method for new-hire training in the break room. Yu Xiaowei sincerely thanked Su Lishan for proactively sharing the workload and promised to recognize her contribution in the quarterly performance review. The two reached an agreement on the follow-up collaboration process.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District, AIA Tower, 138 Gloucester Road, pantry

name: Completed online registration and payment for the Tokyo Marathon.
description: On August 15, Yu Xiaowei opened the Tokyo Marathon official website in her home study, filled in personal information, entered credit card information, successfully paid the registration fee, received a confirmation email, and completed registration for the 2026 Tokyo Marathon.

subevent.name: Completed online registration and payment for the Tokyo Marathon.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei opened the official Tokyo Marathon website, filled in her personal information (name, age, nationality, contact details, etc.), selected the full marathon event, entered her credit card information, successfully paid the registration fee, and received a confirmation email.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home study

name: The family of four collaborated to renovate the children's room
description: On June 27, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming went to a hardware store to buy materials such as light blue eco-friendly latex paint, protective tape, small rollers, and star stickers. On June 28, the family of four carried out a children's room renovation project: the husband mixed the paint, Yu Xiaowei applied protective tape, and the son and daughter excitedly painted the lower walls with small rollers. Although quite a bit was spilled along the way, it was full of laughter. After finishing, the children put up star stickers and the room looked brand new. This family DIY not only saved money but also became an unforgettable team activity.

subevent.name: Buy materials for renovating the children's room
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming went together to a hardware store in Kowloon City to buy materials for renovating the children's room: light blue eco-friendly latex paint, protective tape, a small roller, brushes, and star stickers, and talked with the staff about tips for the renovation.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Hardware Store

subevent.name: Clean the children's room and cover the furniture.
subevent.description: That morning, the family of four worked together to move the movable furniture from the children's room to the living room, covered the bed and desk that could not be moved with old sheets, and swept the dust from the floor to prepare for the renovation.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - 328 Prince Edward Road West - Children's Room

subevent.name: Applying protective tape and mixing paint
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei carefully applied protective tape along the wall edges, door and window frames, and the edges of the baseboards to prevent paint drips; meanwhile, Zhang Weiming stirred the light blue eco-friendly latex paint thoroughly on the balcony with a stirring stick and poured it into a small roller tray.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - 328 Prince Edward Road West - Children's Room

subevent.name: Whole family working together to paint
subevent.description: Zhang Weiming used a large roller to paint the upper walls, Yu Xiaowei used a brush to touch up the corners, and Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin excitedly painted the lower walls with small rollers. Although a lot of paint was dripped and splattered in the process, the family was full of laughter and the atmosphere was joyful.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - 328 Prince Edward Road West - Children's Room

subevent.name: Applied star stickers and cleaned up the area.
subevent.description: After painting was finished, the children volunteered to stick star stickers on the dried walls as decoration, and Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming helped fix the positions. Then the family cleaned up the tools, washed the brushes, and moved the furniture back into place. The children's room looked brand new.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - 328 Prince Edward Road West - Children's Room

name: The couple conducted a joint review of household finances and adjusted the budget.
description: On the evening of July 27, 2025, after signing the car replacement contract, Yu Xiaowei and her husband opened their accounting ledger and reviewed the family's income and expenses for the first half of the year. She found that her personal spending on yoga classes and Cantonese embroidery materials had slightly exceeded the plan, and her husband also had expenses on study materials. Based on possible education expenses and marathon race fees in the second half of the year, they readjusted the budgets for each item and decided to set up a flexible fund every month to cope with emergencies.

subevent.name: Prepare bookkeeping materials.
subevent.description: At around 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowei took out the family account book for the first half of 2025, along with various receipts and electronic bills, from the drawer in the study. She called her husband Zhang Weiming to join her in the living room, turned on the lamp on the coffee table, and prepared to start reviewing the family finances.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Home living room

subevent.name: Reviewing the family's income and expenses for the first half of the year
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming sat side by side on the sofa, flipping through the account book page by page, carefully checking the income, fixed expenses (mortgage, utilities, insurance, children's education, etc.) and various variable expenses from January to June 2025. Her husband used a phone calculator to help with the tally, while Yu Xiaowei recorded key figures on paper with a pen.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Home living room

subevent.name: Discuss personal overspending items
subevent.description: During the review, Yu Xiaowei pointed out that she had exceeded her budget this year by about 3,000 Hong Kong dollars on yoga class fees and Cantonese embroidery materials. Her husband Zhang Weiming also admitted that he had exceeded his personal allowance because of the cost of air-conditioner repair study materials and certification exam fees. The two had an honest conversation about the reasons for the overspending, understood each other, and agreed to exercise stricter self-control in the future.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Home living room

subevent.name: Adjust the family budget for the second half of the year.
subevent.description: Based on possible extra expenses in the second half of the year, including her son Zhang Zixuan's tutoring class fees, her daughter Zhang Yuxin's kindergarten activity fees, and the entry fee and equipment costs for her own participation in the November half marathon, Yu Xiaowei discussed item by item with her husband, readjusted the budget allocation for each item, and wrote them into the remarks column of the expense ledger.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Home living room

subevent.name: Set up a monthly flexible fund and record the results.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei proposed and set up a flexible fund of HK$1,500 per month for the family, specifically for unexpected small expenses (such as temporary medical needs, home repairs, gifts), managed jointly by the couple. Finally, Yu Xiaowei summarized the conclusions of this financial review and budget adjustment into a one-page summary, tucked it into the first page of the ledger, and ended the discussion after confirming agreement with her husband.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Home living room

name: Team lunch and exchange with colleagues Su Lishan and Guo Junwei
description: During the lunch break on March 10, Yu Xiaowei invited her colleague Su Lishan and Guo Junwei, who had come from Guangzhou to attend a meeting at the Hong Kong branch office, to a cha chaan teng near the company for lunch. During the meal, they talked about cross-team collaboration plans, product innovation, and industry trends. Su Lishan shared recent client cases, while Guo Junwei offered suggestions from an actuarial perspective. Yu Xiaowei took the opportunity to ask Guo Junwei to help review the study materials for the CFP course. The three agreed to communicate regularly in the future to strengthen team rapport.

subevent.name: Invite and confirm lunch arrangements
subevent.description: On the morning of March 10, Yu Xiaowei contacted colleague Su Lishan and Guo Junwei, who had come from Guangzhou to Hong Kong for a branch meeting, through the company's internal communication software, confirming a lunch gathering at 12:30 at a Hong Kong-style café near the office. The three agreed on the time and place.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Hong Kong office

subevent.name: Three-person lunch exchange at a cha chaan teng
subevent.description: During the lunch break on March 10, 12:30-13:30, Yu Xiaowei, Su Lishan, and Guo Junwei had a meal at Tsui Wah Restaurant near the company. Over the meal, they discussed cross-team collaboration plans, product innovation, and industry trends. Su Lishan shared recent client cases, and Guo Junwei gave professional advice from an actuarial perspective.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - tea restaurant near the office

subevent.name: Ask Guo Junwei to review the CFP study materials.
subevent.description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei took out her CFP (Certified Financial Planner) course study materials inside the cha chaan teng and asked Guo Junwei to review the sections on insurance products from an actuarial professional perspective. Guo Junwei agreed and arranged to discuss the details later by email.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - tea restaurant near the office

subevent.name: Agreed on a plan for regular follow-up communication.
subevent.description: After the three of them talked, they all felt that cross-team collaboration was beneficial and agreed to hold a brief online meeting every two weeks going forward, with Su Lishan and Guo Junwei representing the sales and product teams respectively, and Yu Xiaowei coordinating communication to strengthen team rapport.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - tea restaurant near the office

name: Weekend online mock exam for the CFP Foundation Course.
description: May 18 (Sunday) morning, Yu Xiaowei took an online mock exam held by the CFP Association at home to test the results of her early-morning study sessions since April. The mock exam covered modules including insurance, taxation, and retirement planning, with a total score of 100. She scored 72 points and found her tax calculation section weak, then made a targeted review plan.

subevent.name: Mock exam preparation and equipment testing
subevent.description: On the morning of Sunday, May 18, Yu Xiaowei prepared in the study of her home in Kowloon City, Hong Kong, the laptop, charger, scratch paper, and pen needed for the CFP online mock exam, and tested the network connection and the exam platform login function to ensure the equipment was working properly. She also put her phone on silent to avoid interruptions.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home study

subevent.name: Take the CFP online mock exam.
subevent.description: On May 18 from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM, Yu Xiaowei took the basic course mock exam through the CFP Association's online examination system in her home study. The exam covered modules including insurance, taxation, and retirement planning, lasted 3 hours in total, and had a maximum score of 100 points. She answered carefully and scored 72, paying particular attention to the tax calculation questions during the process.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home study

subevent.name: Post-exam score analysis and revision plan development
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 18, in the study of her home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, Yu Xiaowei compared her mock exam scores with the answer explanations, focusing on analyzing the reasons for lost points in the tax calculation section, and found that she had weaknesses in that module. She then used a notebook to make a targeted review plan, planning to use early-morning time over the next two weeks to strengthen tax calculation knowledge points, and to arrange a special practice session once a week.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home study

name: The whole family watched the ballet "Swan Lake"
description: On January 15, Yu Xiaowei purchased four tickets in advance for the Russian Ballet's "Swan Lake" and communicated with her husband about the arrangements. On the evening of January 18, the whole family went to the Hong Kong Cultural Centre to watch the performance. Her daughter Xinxin was focused throughout, and during intermission excitedly imitated the dance moves. Yu Xiaowei was deeply moved. After the performance, they returned home, and her daughter continued to imitate the dance. Yu Xiaowei made a pact with her daughter to watch more performances in the future and also came up with the idea of taking the family on trips to see the world.

subevent.name: Buy tickets in advance and preparation
subevent.description: Three days in advance, Yu Xiaowei purchased four tickets for the Russian Ballet Troupe's Swan Lake performance through the Hong Kong Cultural Centre official website or a ticket agent, and confirmed the performance time, seats, and transportation route. At the same time, she communicated with her husband Zhang Weiming about the evening arrangements to ensure the whole family kept the evening of the 18th free.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - home study

subevent.name: Watched the ballet Swan Lake
subevent.description: From 7:30 to 10 PM, Yu Xiaowei's family watched the classic ballet Swan Lake performed by a Russian ballet company at the Grand Theatre of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre. During the performance, her daughter Xinxin was attentive throughout and excitedly imitated the dance moves during intermission; her husband Zhang Weiming accompanied them attentively. Yu Xiaowei was moved by the graceful dancing and music, and deeply touched inside.
subevent.location: Grand Theatre, Hong Kong Cultural Centre, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Returned home after the performance and family interaction
subevent.description: After the performance, Yu Xiaowei took the whole family by taxi back to their home in Kowloon City District. Once home, her daughter Xinxin was still immersed in it and imitated the movements of a white swan in the living room. Yu Xiaowei and her daughter agreed to watch more performances together in the future, and she felt a desire to take the family on trips to see the world. Her husband Zhang Weiming also expressed support, and the family had a pleasant evening.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Home living room

name: Regular family pool day on Sunday afternoons
description: On Sunday, July 20, the weather was hot. Yu Xiaowei spontaneously took the kids to the nearby community swimming pool to cool off. The children played in the water while she sat under a beach umbrella by the poolside, briefly zoning out for the first time amid her busy life. After that, this arrangement became fixed — every Sunday afternoon until the end of the month, unless it was pouring rain, she would bring the kids to swim. She just sat quietly, occasionally flipping through a few pages of a book, making it the most purposeless moment of the week. This new ritual also allowed her husband Zhang Weiming to handle some of his own affairs at home or take a short rest, becoming a new rhythm for family life.

subevent.name: For the first time, spontaneously took the children to the community swimming pool to cool off
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Sunday, July 20, the weather was hot. On a whim, Yu Xiaowei decided to take her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin to the community swimming pool in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to cool off. She quickly packed swimsuits, towels, sunscreen, and snacks, then drove off with the children. After arriving, she handled the admission procedures for them, and the children excitedly jumped into the water to play. Yu Xiaowei sat under a beach umbrella by the poolside, for the first time in her busy life enjoying a brief moment of idleness, occasionally flipping through a couple of pages of the book she had brought, savoring a purposeless moment. This spur-of-the-moment decision became the start of a new family habit.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Community Swimming Pool

subevent.name: Regularly take the children to the community swimming pool on Sunday afternoons.
subevent.description: On Sunday, July 27, the weather was still hot. Following the family routine established after a spontaneous decision last week, Yu Xiaowei again took her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin to the community swimming pool in Kowloon City. She came fully prepared and went through the formalities as usual. The children played in the water to their hearts' content, while she quietly watched from under a poolside umbrella, read a book, or briefly zoned out. This ritual allowed her husband Zhang Weiming to take care of things at home or rest, becoming a new rhythm for the family.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Community Swimming Pool

name: Lin Jiaxin agreed to try working as a part-time insurance consultant but insisted on obtaining the license independently.
description: On Thursday afternoon, August 14, Lin Jiaxin took the initiative to meet Yu Xiaowei at a coffee shop in Wan Chai and finally relented, agreeing to try working as a part-time insurance consultant. However, she repeatedly stressed that she wanted to "earn her license on her own" and did not want to use any back doors. Yu Xiaowei handed her the insurance intermediary qualification exam materials that she had prepared in advance, and restrained her past impulse to oversee every detail, just offering a few words of encouragement. The two looked at each other, both feeling that their relationship was moving toward a more equal footing.

subevent.name: Organize insurance qualification exam materials
subevent.description: On the morning of August 14, 2025, in her study at home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, Yu Xiaowei took out from her file cabinet the study materials, past exam papers, and registration guide she had prepared earlier for the Hong Kong Insurance Intermediaries Qualifying Examination, and checked the completeness of the materials again. She deliberately placed them in a clean document folder and attached a sticky note with encouraging words, thinking about how to support Lin Jiaxin when they meet without seeming overly intrusive.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Met Lin Jiaxin at a café and handed over the materials.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 14, 2025, Yu Xiaowei arrived at the Starbucks in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong as promised to meet her close friend Lin Jiaxin. Lin Jiaxin proactively said she was willing to try being a part-time insurance consultant, but insisted on independently obtaining the insurance intermediary qualification on her own and did not want any special treatment. Yu Xiaowei handed her the exam materials she had prepared and only said a few brief words of encouragement, restraining her previous impulse to look after every detail. As the two chatted over coffee, Yu Xiaowei felt that their relationship was moving in a more equal and respectful direction.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - Starbucks Coffee Shop

name: The whole family makes zongzi for the Dragon Boat Festival.
description: On the evening of May 30, Yu Xiaowei, her mother Chen Meiling, her husband Zhang Weiming, and the two children made zongzi at home. Her mother prepared glutinous rice, red beans, salted egg yolks, and pork fillings in advance. Yu Xiaowei taught her daughter Zhang Yuxin how to fold the bamboo leaves, while her son Zhang Zixuan curiously tried tying the strings. Although her father Yu Guoqiang did not join because he was in a bad mood, everyone else was happily engaged. Yu Xiaowei took photos to record this traditional moment and felt the warmth of family togetherness.

subevent.name: Mother is preparing the filling for zongzi.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei's mother, Chen Meiling, in the kitchen of their home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, prepared in advance the fillings for making zongzi for the Dragon Boat Festival: glutinous rice, red beans, salted egg yolks, and pork. She soaked the glutinous rice, boiled the red beans, and cut and marinated the pork, making all the preparations for the evening's zongzi-making activity.
subevent.location: Kitchen at home, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowei teaches her daughter to fold bamboo leaves for zongzi.
subevent.description: At home in the living room at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Yu Xiaowei hands-on taught her daughter Zhang Yuxin how to overlap two zongzi leaves and fold them into a funnel shape, patiently explaining each step. Zhang Yuxin earnestly imitated her. The mother-daughter interaction was warm.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Son Zhang Zixuan tries tying zongzi strings
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei's son Zhang Zixuan, in the living room of their home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, curiously picked up cotton string and tried to tie up the wrapped zongzi. His movements were clumsy but enthusiastic, while his mother Yu Xiaowei and maternal grandmother Chen Meiling encouraged and guided him from the side, and the whole family was filled with laughter.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowei took photos to record the traditional moment.
subevent.description: As the family zongzi-making activity was drawing to a close, Yu Xiaowei took out her phone in the living room of her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, and filmed the heartwarming scene of her mother Chen Meiling, husband Zhang Weiming, son Zhang Zixuan, and daughter Zhang Yuxin sitting together making zongzi. She also deliberately filmed close-ups of several wrapped zongzi, to record the family bonding moment of the traditional festival.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Process April commission income and pay the ballet renewal fee
description: On April 15, Yu Xiaowei checked and confirmed at the office that the first batch of April insurance sales commissions had arrived, totaling about 35,000 Hong Kong dollars. She deposited the income into the family savings account. That evening at home, she discussed with her husband Zhang Weiming how to use the money, and they decided to prioritize paying the renewal fee for their daughter Zhang Yuxin's ballet class. On April 16, she paid about 4,000 Hong Kong dollars for the renewal via online banking, and the rest was used for daily household expenses.

subevent.name: View commission details and confirm receipt.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei checked the detailed statement of the first batch of insurance sales commissions in April on AIA's office system or mobile app, verified the commission amounts for renewals from existing clients and new policies, and confirmed that a total of about 35,000 Hong Kong dollars had arrived.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Building Office

subevent.name: Discuss the use of the funds with her husband.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming discussed in the living room how to use the newly deposited commission. They finally decided to use it first to renew their daughter Zhang Yuxin's ballet classes (about 4,000 HKD), and use the rest for daily household expenses, such as buying groceries and daily necessities.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home living room

subevent.name: Pay the renewal fee for daughter's ballet class
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei pays the tuition for her daughter Zhang Yuxin's ballet classes for the next quarter, about 4,000 Hong Kong dollars, using the family savings account via online banking or by visiting the ballet training institution.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home study (or ballet institution)

name: Family annual financial planning and savings adjustments
description: On the evening of January 13, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming held their annual family financial planning meeting in their home study. She compiled the income and expenditure details for 2024 and found that the household savings rate was lower than expected. The two decided to increase the monthly fixed savings amount from HK$5,000 to HK$8,000, and to adjust the insurance product portfolio to optimize protection and returns. Yu Xiaowei also planned to visit HSBC in early February to consult about low-risk wealth management products, so as to improve the utilization efficiency of idle funds.

subevent.name: Prepare family financial data
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 13, Yu Xiaowei organized the family income and expenditure details for the whole year of 2024 in her home study, including salary income, daily expenses, insurance premiums, savings records, etc., and created a spreadsheet to summarize the data, preparing for the evening's financial planning meeting.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

subevent.name: Annual financial planning meeting for the couple.
subevent.description: On the evening of January 13, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming held their annual household financial planning meeting in the home study. Yu Xiaowei presented the 2024 income and expenditure summary. After analysis, they found that the household savings rate was below the annual target. After discussion, the couple decided to increase the monthly fixed savings amount from HK$5,000 to HK$8,000, and planned to adjust the insurance product mix to optimize protection and returns. During the meeting, Yu Xiaowei also proposed visiting HSBC in early February to consult about low-risk wealth management products, and her husband agreed.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

subevent.name: Formulate an implementation plan for savings adjustments
subevent.description: After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei recorded the meeting resolutions in the study, created a new monthly savings plan table, and set out that starting from February 2025, an automatic transfer savings of 8,000 Hong Kong dollars per month would be carried out. She also listed the products she needed to consult the bank about (such as time deposits and money market funds). At the same time, she noted the need to adjust insurance products in her to-do items and planned to communicate with her insurance colleagues later.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

subevent.name: Confirm the insurance adjustment approach with her husband.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming had an in-depth discussion in the study about the coverage gaps in existing insurance products. They made a preliminary assessment of current policies and decided to prioritize adjusting the premium payment term of the education savings insurance, and to consider adding a term life insurance policy to cover the mortgage risk. The two reached an agreement on the adjustment budget and agreed to organize the specific policy documents together next Monday.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Complete a small Cantonese embroidery piece alone at home
description: On the evening of July 10, after the children had fallen asleep, Yu Xiaowei sat alone in the living room, turned on the desk lamp, and took out her embroidery frame to continue her unfinished Cantonese embroidery work — a pair of twin lotus flowers. She focused on every stitch and thread, gradually immersing herself in the tranquility of handcraft and forgetting the busyness of the day. About two hours later, she finished the last few petals, looked at the work with satisfaction, and felt her soul soothed.

subevent.name: Focusing on embroidering the twin lotus petals
subevent.description: Under the lamp, Yu Xiaowei secured the embroidery frame, picked up the needle and thread, and began focusing on the next stitches for the twin lotus flowers in her Cantonese embroidery piece. She concentrated intently on the direction of every stitch and thread, gradually immersing herself in the tranquil atmosphere of handcrafting. The session lasted about two hours, during which she completed most of the petal embroidery.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Finished binding off and admired the work
subevent.description: As the embroidery was nearing completion, Yu Xiaowei carefully finished the final stitches on the last few petals, making sure the stitches were even. She cut the thread, set the embroidery frame upright, and held it in both hands to admire the entire Cantonese embroidery piece, smiling with satisfaction and feeling her mind soothed and relaxed.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Organizing embroidery tools and storing works
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei carefully removed the finished Cantonese embroidery piece from the embroidery frame, laid it flat on a clean table to inspect the details, and then put it into a dedicated storage bag. Afterward, she wiped and put away the embroidery frame, needles, threads, and other tools one by one, turned off the desk lamp, and finally returned to the bedroom to rest.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

name: First time participating in a community book club discussion of the Hong Kong Trilogy.
description: Yu Xiaowei attended a community book club discussion of Hong Kong Trilogy for the first time. On the evening of July 3, she reread some chapters at home, looked up review materials, and jotted down her thoughts to prepare for the discussion. On the afternoon of July 5, she went to the community library for the book club, listened attentively to others' remarks, and shared her feelings of having lived in Hong Kong for many years. After the event, she felt she had found spiritual sustenance and decided to attend monthly from then on; she also joined the book club's WeChat group.

subevent.name: Preparation for the book club
subevent.description: On July 3, Yu Xiaowei spent her evening after work in her home study rereading parts of Hong Kong Trilogy, searching online for reviews and background information, and writing down personal reflections to prepare for Saturday's book club sharing. She also wrote several personal impressions from her years living in Hong Kong in her notebook, so she could speak during the discussion.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Attend community book club
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, July 5, Yu Xiaowei walked to the community library to attend the monthly book club. During the event, she listened carefully to the speeches and discussions of more than ten other readers, and in the free exchange session, she shared how her many years of living in Kowloon City District resonated with the colonial-era changes depicted in Hong Kong Trilogy. The whole event lasted about two hours, and she felt she had found spiritual sustenance outside her intense insurance sales work.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Community Library

subevent.name: Decided to keep attending the book club
subevent.description: After the book club ended, Yu Xiaowei proactively asked the organizer about next month's time and book selection, and immediately confirmed her registration. She said she hoped to participate long-term and joined the book club's WeChat group to exchange ideas with other members. When she got home, she marked the next meeting date on her calendar and excitedly shared the experience with her husband Zhang Weiming.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Community Library and Home

name: Fulfilling the promise, visiting Ocean Park with best friend Lin Jiaxin and their children
description: The post-holiday trip agreed with Lin Jiaxin during Chinese New Year greetings finally came true. On Sunday, February 9, Yu Xiaowei brought her younger daughter Zhang Yuxin, and Lin Jiaxin brought her son, and they went to Ocean Park Hong Kong together. The children excitedly looked at marine life and played on kids' rides, while the two mothers sat on a bench chatting, sharing New Year stories, parenting troubles, and work plans. The relaxed atmosphere dispelled the tension of returning to work after the holiday.

subevent.name: Go to Ocean Park to meet up.
subevent.description: At around 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowei left home with her daughter Zhang Yuxin and took the MTR to Hong Kong Ocean Park, located in the Southern District of Hong Kong Island. At the main entrance of Ocean Park, she met up with her close friend Lin Jiaxin, who had already arrived, and Lin Jiaxin's son Lin Haoyu (5 years old). The four of them queued up together to enter the park with tickets.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Southern District - Hong Kong Ocean Park

subevent.name: Visiting the marine life exhibition area and children's facilities
subevent.description: From 10 a.m. to noon, Yu Xiaowei and Lin Jiaxin took the two children to visit in turn the Ocean Wonders exhibition hall (viewing the giant aquarium and coral reefs), the Panda Pavilion, and the Ocean Theatre. The children were very excited about the colorful tropical fish and the dolphin show. Afterwards, the two mothers took the children to the children's play area to ride the carousel and the mini Ferris wheel. During this time, the two mothers rested and chatted on a nearby bench, sharing their Chinese New Year experiences, parenting worries, and work plans.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Southern District - Hong Kong Ocean Park

subevent.name: Had lunch together at Ocean Park.
subevent.description: From 12 p.m. to 1 p.m., the four of them went to Neptune's Restaurant inside Ocean Park for lunch. Yu Xiaowei ordered a kids' meal for her daughter, while she and Lin Jiaxin shared Hong Kong-style milk tea, pineapple buns with butter, and roast meat rice. The children excitedly talked about the dolphins they saw in the morning while eating. The two mothers also took the opportunity to have an in-depth exchange about their work progress and family plans.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Southern District - Ocean Park Hong Kong - Neptune's Restaurant

subevent.name: Afternoon free time and group photos
subevent.description: From 1 p.m. to 3 p.m., the four of them went to the Waterfront area, rode the Ocean Tower to overlook the South China Sea, and visited the Shark Aquarium and the Penguin House. The children also tried the Arctic Blast mini roller coaster. At around 3 p.m., in front of Ocean Park's iconic attraction, Ocean Wonders, the two mothers took several group photos of the children and used a selfie stick to take a four-person group photo, recording their enjoyable time.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Southern District - Hong Kong Ocean Park

subevent.name: Leaving Ocean Park and returning home
subevent.description: Around 4 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and Lin Jiaxin left with the children through the main entrance of Ocean Park. The two mothers said goodbye after confirming the time of their next gathering. Yu Xiaowei took her daughter by the hand and took the MTR back to their home in Kowloon City. After arriving home, Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter bathe and change clothes, and organized the photos taken that day to share them in the family group and the close friends group.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Southern District - Hong Kong Ocean Park to Kowloon City District - Home

name: Explore cross-border insurance opportunities through client Wang Qiming and systematically understand the policies
description: On May 22, existing client Wang Qiming proactively contacted Yu Xiaowei and introduced a friend who owns an electronics factory in Shenzhen; the friend was interested in cross-border insurance. Yu Xiaowei seized the opportunity and began systematically researching the policies, products, and operating procedures for cross-border insurance between the mainland and Hong Kong. She also communicated separately with her brother Yu Xiaofeng, who works in Shenzhen, and her colleague Guo Junwei to gather practical information. This was her first substantial entry into the cross-border business field.

subevent.name: Wang Qiming called to introduce cross-border insurance opportunities.
subevent.description: On the morning of May 22, Yu Xiaowei received a call from existing client Wang Qiming in her AIA Insurance office. Wang Qiming introduced a friend who runs an electronics factory in Shenzhen. The client is interested in cross-border insurance products between the mainland and Hong Kong and hopes to get professional advice. Yu Xiaowei carefully recorded the client's basic information and needs, thanked Wang Qiming for the referral, and said she would study it carefully before contacting the client.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Systematically reviewed cross-border insurance policies between Mainland China and Hong Kong
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 22, Yu Xiaowei used the company's internal database and the official website of the Hong Kong Insurance Authority to systematically search for laws and regulations related to cross-border insurance between the mainland and Hong Kong, common product types (such as high-end medical insurance, savings insurance, critical illness insurance, etc.) and sales restrictions. She focused on studying the process of mainland clients purchasing Hong Kong insurance, foreign exchange management policies, and compliance requirements, and organized the key information into notes for future reference.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Called her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng to learn about the insurance needs of Shenzhen enterprises.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 22, Yu Xiaowei called her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng on WeChat. Yu Xiaofeng works at Tencent in Shenzhen and knows a lot about the insurance needs of local companies and executives. Yu Xiaowei asked her brother about what types of insurance Shenzhen business owners usually care about, mainland clients' general perceptions and concerns about Hong Kong insurance, and whether there were reliable cross-border service channels. Yu Xiaofeng shared some practical information based on cases from his friends, and encouraged his sister to seize this opportunity. The call lasted about 30 minutes.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Communicate with colleague Guo Junwei about details of cross-border insurance products
subevent.description: Later in the afternoon of May 22, Yu Xiaowei contacted her colleague Guo Junwei through the company's internal communication software. Guo Junwei is an insurance actuarial and product specialist, based in the Guangzhou branch, with in-depth knowledge of the design and compliance of cross-border insurance products. Yu Xiaowei consulted Guo Junwei on key issues such as the cross-border claims process for high-end medical insurance, the policy currency options for savings insurance, and underwriting considerations for mainland Chinese clients. Guo Junwei answered each question one by one and provided a product comparison table for her reference.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Organize the information gathered during the day and plan subsequent follow-ups.
subevent.description: On the evening of May 22, Yu Xiaowei returned to her home in Kowloon City. In her study, she compiled the phone records, policy notes, her younger brother's suggestions, and the product information provided by Guo Junwei into a preliminary client needs analysis document. She listed the questions that needed further confirmation, planned to contact the client the next day to understand more specific needs, and scheduled a meeting with her supervisor Liang Zhenhua to consult on the compliance requirements of cross-border business.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

name: Monthly family finance review and transfer to travel fund
description: On May 24, 2025, Yu Xiaowei sorted through the family income and expenditure records, bank statements, receipts and vouchers, and dedicated fund account information from April to May 2025 in the study of her home in Kowloon City, preparing for a financial review. On the evening of May 25, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming checked the family ledger in the living room, confirmed that the family travel fund target set in April had been deposited on time this month with HK$1,500, and HK$800 was transferred to the emergency reserve. They also reviewed the monthly income and expenditure details, including the use of Yu Xiaowei's promotion bonus to install safety facilities for her mother-in-law, and tallied the total income and expenditure for April.

subevent.name: Organize family financial records
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei is organizing the family income and expenditure records, bank statements, receipts and vouchers from April to May 2025, as well as the dedicated account information for the travel fund and emergency reserve fund, in her home study in Kowloon City, preparing for the evening's monthly financial review meeting.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

subevent.name: Checked the ledger with her husband and confirmed the fund transfer
subevent.description: On the evening of May 25, 2025, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming reviewed the family accounts in the living room of their Kowloon City home. Yu Xiaowei first confirmed that the family travel fund goal set in April (save HK$22,000 by the end of the year) had been met with a monthly deposit of HK$1,500 into the dedicated savings account, and that the emergency reserve (target HK$30,000) had also received an allocation of HK$800. The two then reviewed the month's income and expense details, including the use of Yu Xiaowei's promotion bonus (installing safety equipment for her mother-in-law), and tallied the total income and expenses for April.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - living room at home in Kowloon City District

name: After returning to Hong Kong from Shenzhen, she handled the renewal procedures for her long-time client Mrs. Chen.
description: On June 25, Yu Xiaowei returned from Shenzhen to her home in Kowloon City, Hong Kong for a brief rest. In the afternoon, she took the renewal documents to the residence of her client Mrs. Chen in Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, used a tablet to process the medical insurance renewal for her, and explained the terms and premium changes.

subevent.name: Returned from Shenzhen to Hong Kong
subevent.description: That morning, Yu Xiaowei took the MTR East Rail line (via Luohu Port) from Shenzhen back to Hong Kong, arrived home in Kowloon City District before noon for a brief rest, and prepared for the afternoon meeting with client Mrs. Chen.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Go to Mrs. Chen's home to handle insurance renewal procedures.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei took the renewal documents to visit her client Chen Meiling (Mrs. Chen) at her residence in Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, Hong Kong. She logged into the company system on her tablet, completed the online renewal of Mrs. Chen's medical insurance policy, and explained the renewal terms and premium changes in detail.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Eastern District, Taikoo Shing residence.

name: Follow up on Lin Jiaxin's licensing exam progress and provide study materials.
description: On Thursday, August 21, Yu Xiaowei contacted Lin Jiaxin by phone to ask about her progress in reviewing for the insurance intermediary qualification exam, and sent her a set of the latest mock exam questions and a summary of key test points. She reminded Lin Jiaxin that the registration deadline was the end of August, and the two agreed to meet again before the end of the month.

subevent.name: Organized materials for the Insurance Intermediary Qualifying Examination
subevent.description: In her home study, Yu Xiaowei organized from her computer a set of the latest Insurance Intermediaries Qualifying Examination mock exam questions and key-point summary documents, ready to send to Lin Jiaxin.
subevent.location: Home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Called Lin Jiaxin to check on her review progress
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei called her close friend Lin Jiaxin at home and asked in detail about her revision progress for the Insurance Intermediary Qualification Examination, learned which chapters she found difficult, and verbally reminded her of the registration deadline at the end of August.
subevent.location: Home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Send study materials and confirm the meeting at the end of the month
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei sent the compiled mock exam PDF and key points summary document to Lin Jiaxin via WeChat, and in the chat again emphasized the registration deadline. She also agreed with Lin Jiaxin to meet again before the end of the month (around August 28) to answer difficult questions in person.
subevent.location: Home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Promoted to Regional Sales Deputy Manager and used the bonus to install safety equipment for her mother-in-law
description: At the beginning of May, her mother-in-law's ankle fully recovered, and the relationship between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law became closer because of the earlier care. On May 12, Yu Xiaowei was officially promoted to Deputy Regional Sales Manager, responsible for building and leading a three-person team. The new KPI targets brought enormous pressure. She did not hold a celebration, but instead used her first promotion bonus for the family: on May 19, she hired a worker to install anti-slip handrails in her mother-in-law's bathroom and purchased accident insurance. Her mother-in-law was deeply moved, and their bond as mother-in-law and daughter-in-law deepened further.

subevent.name: Mother-in-law's ankle has fully healed
subevent.description: After a period of rest and recovery, Yu Xiaowei's mother-in-law, Li Shufen, fully recovered from her ankle injury. Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming went together to visit her mother-in-law at her home in Kwun Tong District. Delighted at her recovery, the mother-in-law personally made soup to thank her daughter-in-law for the careful nursing. The mother-in-law/daughter-in-law relationship became closer and more harmonious because of this shared experience.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kwun Tong District - 45 Hong Ning Road, Golden Bridge Mansion

subevent.name: Officially promoted to Deputy Regional Sales Manager
subevent.description: At AIA Hong Kong's Wan Chai headquarters, Yu Xiaowei officially received her promotion notice to serve as Deputy Regional Sales Manager. She needed to build and lead a three-person sales team, facing entirely new KPI targets and enormous pressure. That day, her direct supervisor, Director Liang Zhenhua, presided over a small team meeting, announced the promotion decision, and assigned initial tasks. Yu Xiaowei did not hold a celebration; instead, she quietly planned to use the promotion bonus for her family.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road

subevent.name: Install anti-slip handrails in mother-in-law's bathroom and purchase accident insurance.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei used the first bonus from her promotion. She first called a home renovation worker by phone and arranged to install a non-slip grab bar on the bathroom wall at her mother-in-law Li Shufen's home in Kwun Tong. Then, through her insurance business channels, she purchased a personal accident insurance policy for her mother-in-law. All the work was completed that morning. Seeing the new grab bar and the policy, her mother-in-law was deeply moved. Yu Xiaowei said this was her sincerity as a daughter-in-law, and the bond between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law deepened further.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kwun Tong District - 45 Hong Ning Road, Golden Bridge Mansion

name: Afternoon tea with mother Chen Meiling at the cha chaan teng in Kowloon City Plaza
description: On the afternoon of February 19, Yu Xiaowei, taking a rare break, invited her mother Chen Meiling to a cha chaan teng at Kowloon City Plaza for afternoon tea. The two ordered pineapple buns and silk-stocking milk tea, and chatted about work stress and parenting matters while eating. Her mother shared amusing stories from teaching primary school in her youth, and Yu Xiaowei confided her anxiety about promotion. The mother and daughter also agreed to do Cantonese embroidery together next month. This time alone with her mother made Yu Xiaowei feel deeply warm and supported.

subevent.name: Invited Mother over the phone for afternoon tea
subevent.description: On the morning of February 19, Yu Xiaowei called her mother Chen Meiling from home on her mobile phone, inviting her to go to a tea restaurant at Kowloon City Plaza for afternoon tea that afternoon. Over the phone, the mother and daughter confirmed they would meet at the tea restaurant at 3 p.m. and agreed to order pineapple buns and silk-stocking milk tea.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Went to the cha chaan teng at Kowloon City Plaza.
subevent.description: At 2:45 p.m. on February 19, Yu Xiaowei set off from her home on Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City District and walked to the nearby Kowloon City Plaza. About 10 minutes later, she arrived at the long-established cha chaan teng on the second floor of the plaza, found a window-side booth, sat down, and waited for her mother.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Kowloon City Plaza Hong Kong-style cafe

subevent.name: Have afternoon tea with mother and have a heart-to-heart talk.
subevent.description: On February 19 from 3 to 4:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei met her mother Chen Meiling at a cha chaan teng in Kowloon City Plaza. They ordered pineapple buns and silk-stocking milk tea and chatted while eating. Yu Xiaowei poured out the stress and anxiety of being promoted to regional sales manager at work, while her mother shared amusing stories from her younger days teaching at Kowloon Tong Alliance Primary School and encouraged her to relax. The mother and daughter also talked about the small everyday matters of raising children and agreed to do Cantonese embroidery crafts together next month. This time alone together made Yu Xiaowei feel very warm and supported.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Kowloon City Plaza Hong Kong-style cafe

subevent.name: After seeing her mother off, she returned home.
subevent.description: At around 4:30 p.m. on February 19, after afternoon tea, Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to her mother at the entrance of the Hong Kong-style cafe. Her mother walked home, while Yu Xiaowei stopped by Kowloon City Plaza for about 20 minutes on the way, then returned to her home on Prince Edward Road West, arriving at about 5:15 p.m.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - around Kowloon City Plaza

name: Complete the CFP investment planning module mock test
description: On Sunday, August 24, Yu Xiaowei used a solid block of time at home to complete the online simulation test for the CFP investment planning module. After getting up in the morning, she first prepared her textbooks, computer, and scratch paper, then answered questions continuously for 3 hours starting at 9 a.m. The content covered core knowledge points such as asset allocation, securities analysis, and investment portfolio management. She finally submitted the answer sheet on time.

subevent.name: Prepare the simulation test environment.
subevent.description: After getting up in the morning, Yu Xiaowei organized the textbooks and notes for the CFP investment planning module in the study of her home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong. She turned on her laptop, logged in to the online mock test platform, confirmed that the network connection was stable, prepared a calculator and scratch paper, and completed the pre-test preparations.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Complete the online mock test
subevent.description: Starting at 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowei spent about three consecutive hours independently completing the online mock test for the CFP investment planning module in her home study. The test covered core knowledge points such as asset allocation, securities analysis, and portfolio management. She answered carefully, allocated time reasonably, and finally submitted the paper on time.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: At the end of the month, Liang Zhenhua called me in for a talk and reminded me that I had been giving too much attention to Shenzhen clients.
description: On the afternoon of August 28, 2025, team director Liang Zhenhua called Yu Xiaowei into his office at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, and said in a calm but direct tone: 'Some colleagues have reported that you've recently been putting more focus on Shenzhen clients and haven't been keeping up closely enough with the maintenance of Hong Kong headquarters clients. You'd better watch it.' Yu Xiaowei was taken aback and immediately thought of the time she had recently devoted to cross-border business, as well as Zhou Minyi's unusual enthusiasm for Shenzhen clients. On the surface she promised to keep things balanced, but she was deeply suspicious and decided not to say anything for the time being, quietly reviewing her recent client records.

subevent.name: Was summoned by Liang Zhenhua for a talk.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 28, 2025, Yu Xiaowei's team director Liang Zhenhua called her into his office and, in a calm but direct tone, reminded her that she had recently been focusing too much on Shenzhen clients and not maintaining Hong Kong headquarters clients well enough. Yu Xiaowei was puzzled inwardly, but on the surface agreed to balance things out, deciding not to make it public for now.
subevent.location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner for Yu Xiaowei's 36th birthday.
description: On Friday evening, March 14, Yu Xiaowei celebrated her 36th birthday. Her husband Zhang Weiming and their two children prepared a simple yet warm birthday dinner for her at home. Her mother Chen Meiling cooked longevity noodles, and her mother-in-law also came to join. She received hand-drawn cards from her children and a sports watch from her husband. The whole family cut the cake and sang the birthday song together. Amid her busy schedule, this family warmth made her feel deeply happy.

subevent.name: Buying birthday groceries and gifts
subevent.description: Zhang Weiming took the two children, Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin, to a supermarket in Kowloon City District to buy ingredients for the birthday dinner (such as vegetables, meat, and cake-making materials), and on the way stopped at a sports goods store to buy the sports watch he had picked out earlier as a gift. The children used their pocket money to buy colored cardstock and paintbrushes, planning to draw greeting cards by hand at home.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Supermarket and sporting goods store

subevent.name: Mother-in-law set off for Yu Xiaowei's home.
subevent.description: Li Shufen (mother-in-law) set off from her home in Kwun Tong District and took a bus to Yu Xiaowei's home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, to attend her daughter-in-law's birthday family dinner. She brought along a pot of pre-simmered pork bone soup with green radish and carrot as a birthday gift.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kwun Tong District to Kowloon City District - bus route

subevent.name: Preparing birthday dinner
subevent.description: After Yu Xiaowei arrived home, her mother Chen Meiling was cooking long-life noodles in the kitchen, her husband Zhang Weiming was cooking the ingredients he had bought, and the children were setting the dining table in the living room with candles and flowers. After her mother-in-law Li Shufen arrived, she heated up the soup she had brought. The family divided up the tasks and prepared a hearty birthday dinner.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home kitchen and dining room at 328 Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: Birthday celebration ceremony
subevent.description: Before dinner began, the whole family sat around the dining table, lit the candles on the birthday cake, and sang the birthday song together for Yu Xiaowei. After making a wish, Yu Xiaowei blew out the candles, then opened the hand-drawn cards from the children and the sports watch given by her husband. She was deeply moved and hugged her family, and then everyone shared the cake and a hearty dinner.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - 328 Prince Edward Road West, home dining room

subevent.name: Birthday dinner wrap-up and cleanup
subevent.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei cleaned up the table with her family, washed the dishes, and properly stored the leftover food. Her mother-in-law Li Shufen rested for a while at Yu Xiaowei's urging, and at about 9:30 p.m. Zhang Weiming drove her back to her residence in Kwun Tong. The children said goodnight to their mother again before bed, and the family birthday gathering came to a warm end.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home, 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: Visited a new client and signed a critical illness insurance policy
description: Through an introduction from her long-standing client Mrs. Chen, Yu Xiaowei scheduled a visit with Mr. Huang on January 8, prepared a personalized plan on the 9th, and visited Mr. Huang's family on the 10th. She introduced AIA critical illness insurance in detail, successfully signed a policy with an annual premium of HK$15,000, and thanked the introducer and sent the policy to her.

subevent.name: Schedule a visit appointment
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei contacted Mr. Huang (Huang Zhiqiang) by phone to confirm a visit to his home on the afternoon of January 10, while also getting an initial understanding of his family's financial situation, health status, and protection needs, preparing for subsequent customized planning.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Building Office

subevent.name: Prepare materials for the visit
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei organized critical illness insurance product brochures, personalized proposals, application forms, and customer needs analysis tables at the AIA office, and, referring to the information provided by Chen Meiling, customized a critical illness protection plan for Mr. Huang's family with an annual premium of HK$15,000.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Building Office

subevent.name: Visit Mr. Huang's family and introduce the plan
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei went to the home of Mr. Huang in the Eastern District of Hong Kong Island at the agreed time, and had a face-to-face meeting with Mr. Huang and his wife Li Wanyi. She explained in detail the coverage, claim conditions, and premium discounts of AIA critical illness insurance, analyzed the risks regarding Mr. Huang as the family's main breadwinner, and answered their questions.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Eastern District, Hong Kong Island - Mr. Wong's home

subevent.name: Sign critical illness insurance policy
subevent.description: After thorough communication, Mr. Huang expressed approval of the critical illness insurance plan and signed the application form on the spot, choosing an annual premium payment of HK$15,000. Yu Xiaowei assisted in filling in his personal information, confirmed everything was correct, completed the signing process, and handed over the policy receipt on site.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Eastern District, Hong Kong Island - Mr. Wong's home

subevent.name: Follow-up and thank-you notes.
subevent.description: After returning to the company, Yu Xiaowei organized the policy documents and entered them into the system. She sent a text message to the referrer, Chen Meiling, to thank her, informed her of the successful signing, and promised follow-up services. Afterward, she emailed a copy of the electronic policy to Mr. Huang and scheduled a phone follow-up one week later to confirm the policy had taken effect.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Building Office

name: Team weekly meeting and new staff training plan
description: On the morning of Monday, June 2, Yu Xiaowei chaired her first team weekly meeting after her promotion. At the meeting, in light of the evasive attitude that new hire He Junwen displayed when organizing client information, she discussed with senior team member Su Lishan and developed a one-on-one training plan, with Su Lishan responsible for basic guidance and process oversight and Yu Xiaowei focusing on key accounts and business development. Although this arrangement later faced difficulties in execution, it demonstrated her proactive approach to management challenges.

subevent.name: Prepare materials for the weekly meeting
subevent.description: On the morning of June 2, 2025, Yu Xiaowei arrived at the AIA Building office in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, and organized last week's team sales data, customer follow-up status, and He Junwen's work records to prepare the meeting agenda and discussion points for the upcoming weekly team meeting.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Meeting Room

subevent.name: Hosted the weekly team meeting.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei presided over her first team weekly meeting after the promotion in the AIA meeting room, attended by all team members. She first reviewed the team's performance last week, then pointed out the evasive attitude of the new member He Junwen in organizing client files, and publicly stated her expectations for improvement. The meeting lasted about 1.5 hours.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Meeting Room

subevent.name: Discuss new-hire training arrangements with Su Lishan
subevent.description: After the weekly meeting, Yu Xiaowei spoke separately with senior team member Su Lishan in the pantry next to the meeting room. Regarding He Junwen's attitude problem, she discussed with Su Lishan how to formulate a targeted training plan. They decided that Su Lishan would handle basic guidance and process supervision, while Yu Xiaowei herself would focus on key clients and business development. The discussion lasted about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA pantry

subevent.name: Develop a one-on-one training plan.
subevent.description: That afternoon, Yu Xiaowei returned to her desk and, based on the discussion with Su Lishan, organized and drafted a one-on-one training plan document for He Junwen, specifying training objectives, schedule, assessment indicators, as well as Su Lishan's supervisory responsibilities and her own regular check-in arrangements. After finishing, she sent the plan to Su Lishan and He Junwen through the company's internal system.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District - AIA workstation

name: Video call with younger brother Yu Xiaofeng to catch up on work and family.
description: On Tuesday evening, August 19, after finishing her CFP course study, Yu Xiaowei had a nearly one-hour video call via WeChat with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng, who was far away in Shenzhen. Her brother shared the progress of Tencent's new project and funny stories about his one-year-old son. Yu Xiaowei talked about her trip to Macau and client stress. The two agreed to meet in Hong Kong during the National Day holiday. After the call, Yu Xiaowei felt relaxed, and the bond between sister and brother grew closer.

subevent.name: Video call with younger brother Yu Xiaofeng
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei had a nearly one-hour WeChat video call with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng, who was at home in the TCL Building, South Area of Shenzhen Science and Technology Park. Her brother shared the progress of a new Tencent project and amusing stories about his one-year-old son, while Yu Xiaowei talked about her recent trip to Macau and the client pressure she faced at work. Yu Xiaowei promised to plan the itinerary and arrange family activities in advance, and planned to notify her mother Chen Meiling and her husband Zhang Weiming.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-night weekend time listening to old Cantonese songs and petting the cat.
description: Late in the night of August 16, after her son's birthday party, Yu Xiaowei finally had some free time. She changed into home clothes, brewed a cup of jasmine tea, and put on the stereo to play Sam Hui's “The Drifter's Heart” and Paula Tsui's “Season of the Wind” on repeat. Fatty jumped onto the sofa and curled up beside her knee. She gently stroked the cat's back and hummed along, then casually took a photo of the lazy moment with her phone and sent it to the besties' group. Lin Jiaxin instantly replied: “Finally seeing you rest!” She smiled and replied: “Charged up.” This late night became her most luxurious moment of self-care this month.

subevent.name: Late-night relaxation and preparation
subevent.description: After her son's birthday party ended, Yu Xiaowei changed into comfortable loungewear in her living room, boiled water in the kitchen and made a cup of jasmine tea, then turned on the audio system, ready to play classic Cantonese old songs by Sam Hui and Paula Tsui to create a relaxing atmosphere.
subevent.location: Home living room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Listen to old Cantonese songs and pet the cat
subevent.description: As the stereo played Xu Guanjie's "A Drifter's Heart" and Xu Xiaofeng's "Season of the Wind" on repeat, the family pet cat Feizai jumped onto the sofa on its own and curled up beside Yu Xiaowei's knees. Yu Xiaowei gently stroked the cat's back while humming along, immersed in this quiet time to herself, enjoying the warm moment with her pet.
subevent.location: Home living room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Take a photo and share it in the besties group.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei used her phone to capture a lazy moment with Fatty and sent the photo to her best-friend group (including Lin Jiaxin and Huang Wenhui). Lin Jiaxin replied instantly, “Finally I see you resting!” Yu Xiaowei smiled and replied, “Recharged,” and had a brief online interaction with her close friends to express her feelings.
subevent.location: Home living room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Fell asleep after late-night relaxation.
subevent.description: After about an hour of listening to music, petting the cat, and interacting online, Yu Xiaowei felt relaxed in both body and mind. She washed the teacup, turned off the stereo, and returned to the bedroom to get ready for bed, ending what she considered the most luxurious me-time of the month.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, bedroom at home

Yu Xiaowei realized she could not juggle the CFP, Cantonese embroidery, and Japanese courses at the same time, so she decided to suspend the formal courses, keep the textbooks and app accounts, and planned to review intensively before a future trip to Japan.

subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei jotted down a simple list on her notebook of the modules she needs to review before her future trip to Japan (e.g., daily conversation, transportation phrases, ordering food vocabulary), and marked her current weak areas so she can focus on breaking through them when the time comes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

name: Pre-New Year gathering with best friend Lin Jiaxin
