On the afternoon of January 26, she went to a café in Kowloon City to meet her close friend Lin Jiaxin. They exchanged gifts, shared family updates and thoughts on children's education, and agreed to take their children to Disneyland together after the Spring Festival.

subevent.name: Prepare New Year gifts.
subevent.description: In her home study, Yu Xiaowei wrapped the Cantonese embroidered handkerchief she had made herself as a New Year gift, preparing to exchange it at tomorrow's gathering with her best friend Lin Jiaxin. She carefully chose ribbon and wrapping paper to highlight the traditional style.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Heading to the meetup location with her best friend
subevent.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei left her home in Kowloon City District and took the MTR to a coffee shop in Kowloon City that she often visited with Lin Jiaxin (located near Prince Edward Road West). She carried with her wrapped New Year gifts and a handbag.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - MTR and coffee shop

subevent.name: Exchanging gifts and having a heart-to-heart talk with best friend Lin Jiaxin.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei met up with her best friend Lin Jiaxin at a cozy coffee shop in Kowloon City. They first exchanged New Year gifts: Yu Xiaowei gave her a Cantonese embroidery handkerchief, and Lin Jiaxin gave her a handmade aromatherapy gift box in return. Then they shared updates about their families, chatting about the eldest son Zhang Zixuan's final exam results and daughter Zhang Yuxin's funny kindergarten stories. Lin Jiaxin also shared amusing anecdotes from her teaching career. The two also discussed their family arrangements during the Lunar New Year period and agreed to take their children together to Hong Kong Disneyland after the Spring Festival (around mid-February). The whole gathering lasted about two hours, with a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: A coffee shop on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Signed her first Shenzhen client for high-end medical insurance and received a reminder from her supervisor.
description: On September 3, 2025, after sustained follow-up, Yu Xiaowei finally signed her first high-end medical insurance policy with a Shenzhen client, a key breakthrough in her cross-border business exploration. That afternoon, she took the contract to report to team director Liang Zhenhua. Liang Zhenhua praised her on the spot, but then added meaningfully, 'Keep up the good work in the Shenzhen market, but don't forget that Hong Kong is the foundation.' This remark made Yu Xiaowei's heart sink slightly, and she secretly became wary that the praise might carry hidden implications.

subevent.name: Travel to Shenzhen to sign a high-end medical insurance contract with a client.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei set off from Hong Kong with the contract documents, took the MTR East Rail line to Lo Wu Control Point, crossed the border, and arrived in Luohu, Shenzhen around 11:30. She then transferred to Shenzhen Metro Line 1 to Nanshan Science and Technology Park, reaching a cafe near Wang Qiming's company around 12:30. After they met, Yu Xiaowei explained the policy terms, claims process, and renewal precautions to Wang Qiming item by item. Once he confirmed he had no objections, Wang Qiming signed the contract. After signing, they took a group photo to mark the occasion, and Yu Xiaowei expressed her gratitude and said she would continue to provide high-quality service.
subevent.location: Café in Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

subevent.name: Return to Hong Kong to report to the director and receive reminders
subevent.description: At about 14:30, Yu Xiaowei returned to Hong Kong from Shenzhen and went directly back to the AIA Building office in Wan Chai District. She took the signed contract to team director Liang Zhenhua's office and reported in detail on the process of closing the deal and the client background. Liang Zhenhua first fully affirmed her efforts and results, praising her for making a substantial breakthrough in expanding the Shenzhen market. But then he changed his tone and reminded her meaningfully: "Keep up the Shenzhen market, but don't forget that Hong Kong is the foundation." These words made Yu Xiaowei feel a weight in her heart. She realized that behind this praise there might be a subtle reminder about her business focus, and she silently told herself to balance her energy between the two markets.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Director's office, AIA Building, Wan Chai District

name: Late-night accidental loudspeaker playback on phone leads to a complaint and a cold response from the neighbor
description: Late on July 8, nearly 11 p.m., while Yu Xiaowei was organizing client files in the living room, she accidentally touched the music play button on her phone, and the sound suddenly blared out. The middle-aged neighbor living alone downstairs immediately pounded on the door to complain, visibly agitated. She apologized at once, and the next evening specially prepared a box of premium hand-brewed coffee packs and went to his door to apologize. The neighbor took them expressionlessly, gave a faint nod, and closed the door. After that, when they met in the elevator, he said nothing, as if it had never happened. For the first time, Yu Xiaowei personally felt that in reality, not all goodwill can be repaid with understanding and relief.

subevent.name: Accidentally triggered loud audio on my phone late at night.
subevent.description: At nearly 11 p.m. on July 8, 2025, while Yu Xiaowei was organizing client files in the living room of her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, she accidentally pressed the music play button on her phone, and the sudden blast of music broke the quiet of the late night. Yu Xiaowei immediately realized the mistake and turned off the music.
subevent.location: Home living room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: A neighbor came to the door to complain.
subevent.description: Not long after the loud sound from the speaker, Chen Zhiqiang, the middle-aged neighbor living alone downstairs, pounded fiercely on Yu Xiaowei's door and emotionally complained about the late-night noise. Yu Xiaowei opened the door and immediately apologized sincerely, explaining that she had accidentally triggered the sound on her phone, and promised to be more careful in the future. The neighbor expressed his dissatisfaction in strong words and then returned to his own home.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - 328 Prince Edward Road West, doorstep and corridor

subevent.name: Preparing an apology gift
subevent.description: During the day on July 9, Yu Xiaowei decided to pay a formal visit to her neighbor to apologize for what had happened the night before, in order to repair the neighborly relationship. At home, she carefully prepared a box of pour-over coffee packs from a specialty coffee shop as an apology gift, and added a handwritten card expressing her apology.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home at 328 Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: Paying a personal apology visit
subevent.description: On the evening of July 9, Yu Xiaowei brought prepared premium pour-over coffee packs to the door of downstairs neighbor Chen Zhiqiang, knocked, and again apologized in person, explaining that she had not meant to disturb him, and handed over the coffee packs. The neighbor took the gift with a blank expression, gave a faint nod, and directly closed the door without saying anything.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - front door of the downstairs neighbor, 328 Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: Neighbor's subsequent cold response
subevent.description: On July 10 and the following days, when Yu Xiaowei ran into her neighbor Chen Zhiqiang in the residential elevator or hallway and took the initiative to greet him, he remained expressionless and gave no verbal or facial response, as if the apology incident had never happened between them. For the first time, Yu Xiaowei deeply felt that in real life, not all goodwill can be repaid with understanding and relief.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - elevator and stairwell, 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: Monthly performance review and customer churn warning discussion
description: On Monday afternoon, July 28, Yu Xiaowei held a monthly review meeting for her team. She analyzed the July performance figures: her personal premiums reached 420,000 yuan and the team's total was 1.3 million yuan, neither meeting the targets. She focused on the recent risk of client churn and reminded everyone to pay attention to the retention of high-net-worth clients. After the meeting, she privately met with team member Chen Li to understand the details of how her client had been poached, and decided to give a dedicated report to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua the following week. The review made her more alert, and she planned to establish a regular client follow-up system.

subevent.name: Prepare materials for the monthly review meeting.
subevent.description: On the morning of Monday, July 28, 2025, Yu Xiaowei sorted through her personal and team performance data for July at her desk in AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong. She made PPT and Excel charts, highlighting the gap between premium achievements (personal 420,000, team 1.3 million) and targets, and sorted out recent high-net-worth client dynamics and a churn risk list. She printed the meeting agenda and materials and prepared a speaking outline for the afternoon team review meeting.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - AIA Building, Wan Chai District - workstation

subevent.name: Held the July team monthly review meeting
subevent.description: On Monday, July 28, 2025, at 2:00 PM, Yu Xiaowei chaired the team's monthly review meeting in a meeting room at the AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong. She showed the July performance data to more than 10 team members, noting that her personal premiums reached 420,000 (failed to meet the target) and the team's total premiums reached 1,300,000 (failed to meet the target). She analyzed that the root cause of the problems was the loss of some clients and insufficient conversion of new policies. She emphasized the importance of maintaining high-net-worth clients, reminded everyone to be alert to recent poaching attempts by competitors, and encouraged team members to share cases and difficulties. The meeting lasted about 90 minutes, and everyone discussed improvement measures together.
subevent.location: Meeting room, AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Private talk with team member Chen Li
subevent.description: After the Monday afternoon review meeting on July 28, 2025, Yu Xiaowei privately talked with team member Chen Li in a separate meeting room in the AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong. Yu Xiaowei asked in detail about the specifics of Chen Li's recent client poaching, including the other company, the names of the clients involved, and the poaching tactics. She comforted Chen Li and together they analyzed coping strategies. She suggested Chen Li strengthen client relationship maintenance and said she would later assist her in deep communication with the clients. The conversation lasted about 30 minutes, and Yu Xiaowei recorded the key information.
subevent.location: Private meeting room, AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Formulate a follow-up action plan
subevent.description: After the Monday afternoon meeting on July 28, 2025, Yu Xiaowei returned to her desk, organized the meeting minutes of the review meeting, and sorted out the customer churn warning list and response plans. She decided to give a special report to regional sales director Liang Zhenhua next week and scheduled the report time in her calendar. At the same time, she drafted a draft policy for regular customer follow-up visits, planning to implement it within the team next week, requiring each member to follow up with at least one high-net-worth customer per month and keep records in a ledger. She wrote the action plan into her work log and set follow-up milestones.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - AIA Building, Wan Chai District - workstation

name: Weekend shopping and afternoon tea with best friend Lin Jiaxin.
description: On Sunday, September 7, 2025, Yu Xiaowei met her childhood friend Lin Jiaxin for shopping at Times Square in Causeway Bay. The two browsed autumn new arrivals while chatting about work and family matters. Later, at the nearby Lady M dessert shop, they enjoyed mille crepe cake and Earl Grey tea. Lin Jiaxin shared funny stories from her teaching, and Yu Xiaowei confided her worry about Huang Wenhui's faint sense of betrayal. Lin Jiaxin comforted her, telling her not to overthink and suggesting she observe first. This relaxing afternoon tea temporarily relieved Yu Xiaowei's high pressure and deepened their bond as close friends.

subevent.name: Set off for Causeway Bay
subevent.description: On the morning of Sunday, September 7, 2025, Yu Xiaowei set out from her home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, and took the MTR to Times Square in Causeway Bay, planning to meet her close friend Lin Jiaxin for shopping. She had confirmed the time and place of the meeting in advance on her phone.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong - from home to MTR Causeway Bay Station

subevent.name: Met up with Lin Jiaxin at Times Square and went shopping
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her childhood friend Lin Jiaxin met on time at Times Square in Causeway Bay. The two went shopping in the mall, picking out new autumn clothes while chatting about each other's recent lives, including work and family matters.
subevent.location: Causeway Bay, Hong Kong - Times Square

subevent.name: Enjoying afternoon tea at Lady M
subevent.description: After shopping, Yu Xiaowei and Lin Jiaxin went to the Lady M dessert shop near Times Square and enjoyed mille crêpe cake and Earl Grey tea together. During the chat, Lin Jiaxin shared amusing stories from teaching, while Yu Xiaowei confided her worry that another childhood friend, Huang Wenhui, had vaguely betrayed her. Lin Jiaxin comforted her and advised her not to overthink, suggesting she observe first. This afternoon tea deepened their close friendship.
subevent.location: Causeway Bay, Hong Kong - Lady M dessert shop

name: The family cat Feizai went missing for two days and returned home on its own, finally putting the whole family's worries to rest.
description: On the evening of April 18, because the family was frequently coming and going while her mother-in-law was recovering from a foot injury, the family's orange cat Fatty slipped out while the front door was left slightly open. Yu Xiaowei was frantic when she discovered it and, together with her husband, put up lost-cat notices in the neighborhood overnight; the children also called out with snack cans. For two days there was no news. Just as the whole family was deep in gloom, at around 8 p.m. on April 20, Fatty unexpectedly appeared at the doorstep on his own, a little dirty and thinner, but otherwise fine. The joy of finding what had been lost eased the exhaustion of the past days. Yu Xiaowei held the cat and muttered that he must not run off again, while feeling relieved that the little life had returned safely. This incident made the family cherish the companionship of one another and their pet even more, and the warm atmosphere was restored at home.

subevent.name: Discovered Fatty missing and searched for him urgently
subevent.description: On the evening of April 18, because of frequent comings and goings while her mother-in-law was recovering from a foot injury, the family's orange cat Feizai slipped out when the front door was left ajar. Yu Xiaowei was frantic when she discovered it and immediately posted lost-cat notices with her husband Zhang Weiming at their home on 328 Prince Edward Road West and around the estate. They also had their son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin call the cat with treat cans in the stairwells and garden, but there was still no news by late night.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - inside the residential complex at 328 Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: The whole family continues to search for Fatty
subevent.description: During the day on April 19, Yu Xiaowei and her family continued searching for Fatty in the residential compound and the nearby streets. They asked neighbors whether they had seen an orange cat and posted lost-cat notices in social groups, but there was still no news. The whole family was heavy-hearted, especially the children, who were very down. In the evening, Yu Xiaowei made another round of the compound and returned disappointed, leaving the family shrouded in gloom.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - residential complex at 328 Prince Edward Road West and surrounding streets.

subevent.name: Fatty returned home on his own, and the whole family was reunited.
subevent.description: During the day on April 20, Yu Xiaowei and her family kept searching for Feizai without giving up, but found nothing. At around 8 p.m., Feizai unexpectedly appeared at the front door on his own. He looked a bit dirty and thin, but was otherwise fine. Yu Xiaowei excitedly picked up the cat, checked him, and confirmed there were no external injuries. Then she bathed Feizai and fed him. The children cheered and jumped with joy, and the whole family was immersed in the happiness of having him back. Holding the cat, Yu Xiaowei murmured, "Don't run off like that again," feeling grateful that the little life had returned safely.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home at 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: Daughter's kindergarten family day; the paintings inspired Cantonese embroidery, and family time temporarily eased worries.
description: On Saturday, April 26, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Xinxin to the Parent-Child Art Day held by Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten. She saw her daughter's painting: a girl in a ballet tulle skirt dancing among flowers, with butterflies fluttering around, which sparked her inspiration for Cantonese embroidery. She remembered the advice of her teacher Wu Xiuying and sketched an outline of an embroidered piece, Butterfly Dance, in her sketchbook, but her inner worries kept her from going deeper. The time together as mother and child let her temporarily forget her worries and feel the warmth of family.

subevent.name: Getting ready to leave for the kindergarten parent-child day
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, April 26, Yu Xiaowei packed her daughter Zhang Yuxin's (Xinxin) schoolbag and art supplies at home, had a simple breakfast, changed into casual clothes, and went out holding her daughter's hand, planning to attend the parent-child art day event held in the afternoon at Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten

subevent.name: Attended Parent-Child Art Day and appreciated daughter's paintings.
subevent.description: After Yu Xiaowei and her daughter arrived at the kindergarten, they took part in the parent-child art creation activity organized by the school. Her daughter Xinxin excitedly showed off a painting she had finished earlier: a girl in a ballet tulle skirt dancing among flowers, with butterflies fluttering around. Yu Xiaowei crouched beside her daughter, carefully admiring the painting, deeply moved by the innocent and romantic imagery inside.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten

subevent.name: The painting inspired Cantonese embroidery, and she sketched a pattern on the spot.
subevent.description: After seeing her daughter's painting, Yu Xiaowei was instantly reminded of an embroidery theme her teacher Wu Xiuying had once mentioned, and inspiration surged. She immediately took her sketchbook and pencil out of her bag, sat down in a corner of the kindergarten activity area, and quickly sketched a few rough ideas for a new embroidery series themed 'Butterfly Dance.' But still preoccupied by recent worries, she didn't dare to develop it further. A few minutes later, she closed the sketchbook and sighed quietly.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten

subevent.name: Parent-child time ended, took daughter home
subevent.description: As the parent-child art day came to an end, Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter pack up her paintings and craft materials, then held her daughter's hand and left the kindergarten. On the way back to their home in Kowloon City District, the two chatted and laughed as her daughter shared fun moments from the activity. Yu Xiaowei temporarily forgot her recent worries and felt the warmth and nourishment of family life. After arriving home, she put the sketch away and planned to discuss it with Teacher Wu later.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten to home

name: Afternoon tea with close friends in Mong Kok, shopping to relax.
description: On the afternoon of April 13, Yu Xiaowei met her close friend Lin Jiaxin at Langham Place in Mong Kok. They drank Hong Kong-style milk tea with buttered pineapple buns and talked about recent work and family stress. Then the two browsed ZARA and UNIQLO. Yu Xiaowei tried on a few spring outfits but didn't buy any, remarking that shopping could temporarily relieve stress. Lin Jiaxin listened to her worries and encouraged her, and they agreed to attend a yoga workshop together next month.

subevent.name: Afternoon tea and chat in Mong Kok.
subevent.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei met Lin Jiaxin at a Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng on the 4th floor of Langham Place in Mongkok, and ordered Hong Kong-style milk tea with pineapple buns and butter. The two chatted while eating. Yu Xiaowei poured out her recent work and family pressures, and Lin Jiaxin listened patiently and gave her encouragement.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Mong Kok - Langham Place Cha Chaan Teng

subevent.name: Visited a ZARA store.
subevent.description: After afternoon tea, Yu Xiaowei and Lin Jiaxin walked into the ZARA store at Langham Place. Yu Xiaowei tried on several spring outfits. She was quite interested in a floral dress, but considering her budget and practicality, she did not buy it in the end, remarking that shopping could briefly relieve stress.
subevent.location: ZARA, Langham Place, Mong Kok, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Browsing at a UNIQLO store
subevent.description: After leaving ZARA, Yu Xiaowei and Lin Jiaxin went on to browse UNIQLO in the same mall. Yu Xiaowei looked at the season's new arrivals and exchanged styling ideas with Lin Jiaxin. Neither of them bought anything, and they enjoyed the relaxing experience of shopping.
subevent.location: UNIQLO at Langham Place, Mong Kok, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Scheduled next month's yoga workshop.
subevent.description: After shopping, Yu Xiaowei and Lin Jiaxin sat down in the rest area at Langham Place. Yu Xiaowei suggested attending a yoga workshop together next month. Lin Jiaxin agreed, and the two immediately used their phones to look up course information for nearby yoga studios, agreeing to sign up together on a chosen day in mid-May.
subevent.location: Mong Kok – Langham Place rest area, Hong Kong

name: Late-night meditation practice to relieve anxiety.
description: From April 15, due to days of high pressure and insufficient sleep, Yu Xiaowei began trying 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation every night before going to bed. She downloaded a meditation app and, after her mother-in-law had gone to sleep and before she herself went to bed, sat cross-legged in a corner of the bedroom, focusing on her breath. At first her thoughts were scattered, but after persisting for several days, she found that it took less time to fall asleep and her daytime anxiety eased somewhat. This practice became her secret for self-regulation in the midst of busy family care and work.

subevent.name: Prepare for meditation practice.
subevent.description: To relieve the anxiety and sleep deprivation caused by days of high pressure, Yu Xiaowei searched and downloaded a mindfulness meditation app (such as Tide or Headspace) from the app store, preparing for the bedtime meditation session she was about to start. She browsed the guided courses in the app, chose the basic mindful breathing course best suited for beginners, and set a daily evening reminder.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District, home bedroom.

subevent.name: Do the daily bedtime meditation practice
subevent.description: Starting on the evening of April 15, after her mother-in-law had gone to bed and before she herself fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei sat cross-legged on a mat in the corner of the bedroom and did 10 minutes of mindful breathing using a meditation app. She focused on her breath, observing her thoughts without judging them. At first her thoughts were scattered, but after practicing daily, the time it took her to fall asleep gradually shortened and her daytime anxiety eased. This practice became an important way for her to regulate herself amid her busy caregiving and work schedule.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District, home bedroom.

subevent.name: Initial stage of meditation practice.
subevent.description: Starting on the evening of April 15, Yu Xiaowei sat cross-legged on a cushion in the corner of her bedroom after her mother-in-law fell asleep and before she herself went to bed, opening a meditation app to do 10 minutes of mindful breathing practice. She focused on her breath and observed her thoughts without judgment. In the first few days her thoughts were scattered and hard to concentrate, but she kept practicing daily and gradually felt brief moments of inner calm.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District, home bedroom.

subevent.name: Stable stage of meditation practice
subevent.description: From April 23 to 26, Yu Xiaowei's meditation practice entered a stable phase. Every night she skillfully adjusted her posture, opened the app, and followed the guided breathing. The mindfulness practice allowed her to become almost fully immersed within ten minutes, with fewer stray thoughts. She noticed that she could handle work pressure and household trivialities more calmly during the day, and her sleep quality improved significantly. This habit became her core way of self-regulation.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District, home bedroom.

subevent.name: Meditation practice consolidation stage
subevent.description: In the last four days, from April 27 to 30, Yu Xiaowei continued to do 10 minutes of mindful breathing meditation every night. She could now easily enter a state of focus, and even occasionally felt deep relaxation during practice. Difficulty falling asleep had basically disappeared, and her emotions were calmer during the day. She decided to stick with this habit long-term to cope with the anxiety in her busy life.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District, home bedroom.

subevent.name: Organizing cross-border client cases
