subevent.location: Hong Kong - home study

name: Detected signs of her best friend's betrayal during a business trip to Shenzhen
description: On September 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowei went to Shenzhen on a business trip. She first met her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng at a café in the Science Park, giving him pour-over coffee equipment as a belated birthday gift. Later, she met up with her close friends Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi at a shopping mall. During the gathering, Zhou Minyi enthusiastically congratulated her on signing the Shenzhen client. As the meal was ending, however, Yu Xiaowei overheard Huang Wenhui quietly say to Zhou Minyi, “Are you really going to keep hiding it? Awei will find out sooner or later.” She felt a chill in her heart but suppressed the urge to confront them on the spot and pretended she hadn't heard.

subevent.name: Business trip from Hong Kong to Shenzhen
subevent.description: On the morning of September 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowei set off from her home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, took the MTR East Rail Line to Lo Wu Control Point, crossed the border, then transferred to the Shenzhen Metro and headed to the Science and Technology Park to prepare for a gathering with her younger brother and close friends. On the way, she used WeChat to confirm the time and place of the gathering.
subevent.location: Shenzhen - border crossing points and metro lines

subevent.name: Meet her younger brother at a café in the science park to give him a gift
subevent.description: After arriving in Shenzhen, Yu Xiaowei met her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng at a boutique café in the technology park. She gave him the carefully wrapped pour-over coffee equipment as a belated birthday gift. The two caught up. Yu Xiaofeng shared funny stories from work at Tencent and his parenting experience, while Yu Xiaowei mentioned the upcoming gathering with her close girlfriends. The meeting lasted about 45 minutes.
subevent.location: Nanshan District, Shenzhen - Science and Technology Park Boutique Cafe

subevent.name: Gathering with close girlfriends at the mall and being congratulated
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei met her close friends Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi at a Hong Kong-style tea restaurant in a large shopping mall in Nanshan District, Shenzhen. The three enjoyed lunch. Zhou Minyi warmly congratulated Yu Xiaowei on recently successfully signing a Shenzhen client and praised her business ability. Yu Xiaowei shared amusing stories from the signing process, and the atmosphere was pleasant.
subevent.location: Nanshan District, Shenzhen - Hong Kong-style tea restaurant in a large shopping mall

subevent.name: Accidentally overheard her close friend's conversation and kept her emotions in check
subevent.description: As the gathering was coming to an end, Yu Xiaowei got up to go to the restroom and overheard Huang Wenhui say quietly to Zhou Minyi, Do you really plan to keep hiding it? Awei will find out sooner or later. She felt a sudden chill, realizing that those words might be about her, but she suppressed the urge to confront them on the spot, pretended not to hear, returned to her seat, and calmly ended the gathering, all while filled with doubt and unease inside.
subevent.location: At a Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng in a large shopping mall in Nanshan District, Shenzhen.

name: Took the initiative to book an annual physical exam and adjusted her health plan based on the doctor's advice.
description: On August 18, Yu Xiaowei called Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital to book her annual physical on the 22nd, and added an ECG and body fat percentage test. On the morning of Saturday, August 22, she went to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital for the routine checkup and additional tests, and found her body fat percentage was slightly elevated. Dr. Zhou Wenbin, taking into account her marathon training plan, advised increasing protein intake and ensuring 7 hours of sleep. Yu Xiaowei carefully noted the advice and planned to adjust her diet.

subevent.name: Book annual physical exam.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei called the office of Zhou Wenbin, family physician at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, to schedule an annual physical examination for the morning of Saturday, August 22, 2025, and told the nurse she wanted to add an electrocardiogram and body fat percentage measurement.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - home

subevent.name: Go to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital for a physical examination.
subevent.description: At 8 a.m. on Saturday, August 22, Yu Xiaowei left her home in Kowloon City and took a taxi to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital in the Central and Western District. After arriving, she registered at the front desk and waited for her number to be called.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital

subevent.name: Completed the annual physical exam and additional tests.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei completed her routine annual checkup in Dr. Zhou Wenbin's consulting room (height, weight, blood pressure, blood routine, urine routine, etc.), and, following the doctor's advice, additionally had an electrocardiogram and body fat percentage measurement. The results showed that her body fat percentage was slightly high.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital

subevent.name: Listen to the doctor's advice and record the medical instructions
subevent.description: Dr. Zhou, considering Yu Xiaowei's marathon training plan and her relatively high body fat percentage, suggested increasing daily protein intake and ensuring 7 hours of sleep. Yu Xiaowei listened attentively and used her phone memo app to note down the specific dietary adjustment suggestions.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital

name: Joined an international Cantonese embroidery online community, debut piece "Peony Painting".
description: On the afternoon of February 16, through the recommendation of her embroidery friend He Meiling, Yu Xiaowei joined an international online Cantonese embroidery enthusiast community made up of overseas Chinese. That day, she plucked up the courage to attend her first video exchange session. She shared her recently completed 'Peony Painting' in Cantonese and demonstrated a stitching technique. Embroidery friends from Singapore, Malaysia, and Canada all gave it a thumbs-up, and some asked her for details. This experience made her feel the cross-regional charm of the traditional craft and stirred her hope of one day bringing Cantonese embroidery beyond Hong Kong.

subevent.name: Received a community recommendation from He Meiling
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei’s embroidery friend He Meiling recommended an international Cantonese embroidery online community to her via WeChat, introducing in detail the nature of the community, its membership, and daily activities, and sharing her own participation experience, encouraging Yu Xiaowei to join. Yu Xiaowei became very interested and said she was willing to try.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Apply to join an international online community for Cantonese embroidery
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei used the invitation link provided by He Meiling to submit a join request to the international Cantonese embroidery online community, filling in her personal profile, Cantonese embroidery learning experience, and representative works information. After the community administrator approved it, she successfully joined the community and browsed the group's historical messages, member works album, and activity announcements.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Prepare content for video communication.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 16, Yu Xiaowei prepared for the afternoon video exchange session: she selected her most satisfying recent work, 'Peony Painting,' and took high-definition detail photos with her phone; organized the creative inspiration and stitch techniques she needed to share; practiced the demonstration steps of the core stitches in advance using an embroidery hoop and silk thread; and checked the network, camera, and microphone equipment in the home study to ensure the session went smoothly.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Attended the first video exchange meeting and shared “Peony Painting”.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 16, Yu Xiaowei joined the video conference of the international Cantonese embroidery online community on time. During the exchange session, she mustered the courage to show her work Peony Painting in Cantonese to fellow embroiderers from Singapore, Malaysia, Canada and other places, explaining in detail the design inspiration, color techniques, and composition concept, and demonstrating live the core stitches used in the work (such as the rolling stitch and the layered stitch). Her sharing received praise and questions from several embroiderers, and she answered them one by one patiently. The atmosphere was warm and lively.
subevent.location: At home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (via video conferencing platform)

subevent.name: Post-exchange interaction and community integration
subevent.description: After the video exchange session ended, Yu Xiaowei replied in the community group to other embroidery friends' follow-up questions about her works, proactively added three like-minded embroidery friends, and browsed other members' works in the group photo album. She deeply felt the charm of traditional crafts transcending regions, left a message in the group expressing her gratitude, and developed an aspiration to one day take Cantonese embroidery beyond Hong Kong and participate in international exchange.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

name: Bought a monthly facial care card with colleague Su Lishan and had the first treatment, establishing a regular stress-relief routine.
description: Facing workplace stress, on February 7 her colleague Su Lishan invited Yu Xiaowei to get facial treatments together. The two first discussed details in the rest area of the AIA Building, then after work went to a beauty salon in Causeway Bay to try it out. Satisfied with the experience, they bought a monthly treatment card together and agreed to go together every Friday after work. On Friday, February 14, they had their first regular facial treatment, officially launching the fixed stress-relief plan.

subevent.name: Su Lishan invited to discuss facial care
subevent.description: During the lunch break at work on February 7, colleague Su Lishan invited Yu Xiaowei to try a facial treatment together in the rest area of AIA Building, suggesting they co-purchase a monthly card as a regular way to relieve stress. The two discussed details such as the choice of beauty salon, cost sharing, and fixed times to go together.
subevent.location: AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Head to a beauty salon in Causeway Bay for a trial experience
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan went together to the designated beauty salon in Causeway Bay for a first facial care experience, sampling the salon's environment, service quality, and treatment results.
subevent.location: Beauty salon in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Co-purchasing a monthly facial care card
subevent.description: After the trial experience, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan expressed satisfaction with the beauty salon's services and decided to jointly purchase a monthly care card, splitting the cost and paying on the spot. They also agreed to go to the beauty salon together every Friday after work from then on.
subevent.location: Beauty salon in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong

subevent.name: First time doing the Friday full-care treatment together.
subevent.description: As agreed last week, after work on Friday, February 14, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan went together to the beauty salon in Causeway Bay for their first regular facial treatment, beginning their fixed stress-relief plan.
subevent.location: Beauty salon in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong

name: Prepared and submitted a team collaboration proposal to Liang Zhenhua, and received verbal encouragement
description: On March 2, Yu Xiaowei used her after-work time at home to prepare the 'Preliminary Plan for Improving Customer Policy Renewal Rates and Team Collaboration'. On March 3, she took the plan to AIA Insurance's head office, presented it in person to regional manager Liang Zhenhua, and gave a brief report. After reading it, Liang Zhenhua verbally praised and encouraged her, but pointed out that a more comprehensive budget and consensus were needed, and it was not added to the official agenda.

subevent.name: Prepare team collaboration plan
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei used her after-work and lunch break time, combined with past customer renewal data and the current state of team collaboration, to organize and analyze bottleneck issues. Using a computer and notebook, she wrote the "Preliminary Plan for Improving Customer Renewal Rates and Team Collaboration," repeatedly revised the format and wording, and finally printed and bound it into a booklet, preparing for submission the next day.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

subevent.name: Submitted the proposal and gave an in-person presentation
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei took the printed proposal to Liang Zhenhua's office at AIA Hong Kong Headquarters (AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District), personally submitted the proposal, and gave a brief verbal summary of its core contents, including the suggestion to improve renewal rates through cross-team sharing sessions.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District AIA office

subevent.name: Received verbal feedback and encouragement
subevent.description: After carefully reading the proposal, Liang Zhenhua praised Yu Xiaowei's initiative and analysis, affirming her positive attitude. However, he pointed out that implementation would require a more comprehensive budget and team consensus, so he did not immediately place it on the formal agenda. Yu Xiaowei listened attentively, took notes, and expressed her gratitude.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District AIA office

name: Attend the company's internal cross-border business training.
description: On February 13, Yu Xiaowei attended an internal training session on cross-border business organized by AIA Insurance's Hong Kong headquarters. The training was led by senior product manager Guo Junwei and focused on analyzing changes in mainland clients' demand for Hong Kong insurance, compliance requirements, and sales techniques. Yu Xiaowei took careful notes and discussed Shenzhen market expansion strategies with her colleague Su Lishan, accumulating professional knowledge for the March sharing session.

subevent.name: Participated in a special training course on cross-border business
subevent.description: On the morning and afternoon of February 13, 2025, Yu Xiaowei attended the full internal training on cross-border business in the training room at AIA Hong Kong headquarters. The training was led by senior product manager Guo Junwei, covering the latest changes in mainland clients' demand for Hong Kong insurance, cross-border sales compliance requirements, and sales techniques for high-net-worth clients. Yu Xiaowei listened carefully and took detailed notes, paying particular attention to the Shenzhen market expansion strategy section.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Building training conference room

subevent.name: Discussed Shenzhen market expansion strategy with colleagues.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 13, 2025, during a break or after the training, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan had an in-depth discussion in a corner of the training meeting room about strategies for developing the Shenzhen market. Based on the characteristics of mainland Chinese client needs mentioned in the training, the two exchanged their views on potential client groups in Shenzhen and explored how to use the advantages of Hong Kong insurance products for differentiated sales. The discussion lasted about half an hour, and both agreed that the Shenzhen market deserved focused follow-up.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Building training conference room

subevent.name: Organizing notes and archiving knowledge after training.
subevent.description: On the evening of February 13, 2025, Yu Xiaowei returned to her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, and systematically organized the notes from the day's training in her study. Using her computer, she categorized and archived the key content, flagging the knowledge points related to the March sharing session, and wrote several paragraphs of reflections for future review and sharing. Her husband Zhang Weiming brought her a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea, and she continued working while drinking it until late into the night.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

name: Resume yoga classes and add morning meditation.
description: On Wednesday, February 12, after Chinese New Year, Yu Xiaowei went to her usual yoga studio (Mong Kok Yoga Zone) for the first time, for a Vinyasa flow class. After that, she adjusted her yoga practice to 15 minutes at home on Wednesday and Saturday mornings, adding 5 minutes of meditation to ease the pressure of work and race preparation.

subevent.name: Returning to yoga class for the first time
subevent.description: On Wednesday evening, February 12, Yu Xiaowei, wearing yoga clothes and carrying her personal yoga mat, went to Yoga Zone in Mong Kok for a vinyasa yoga class of about one hour. This was her first yoga practice after the Spring Festival. During the class, she followed the instructor's cues to complete basic pose sequences, and afterward felt her body stretched and her stress relieved.
subevent.location: Mong Kok, Kowloon, Hong Kong - Yoga Studio (Yoga Zone)

subevent.name: First at-home morning yoga and meditation.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, February 15, Yu Xiaowei laid out her yoga mat in the living room of her home in Kowloon City District and did 15 minutes of basic vinyasa yoga (including Cat-Cow, Downward-Facing Dog, Warrior series, and other poses). She then sat quietly for 5 minutes doing breathing meditation, focusing on regulating her breathing rhythm to relieve the pressure of work and race preparation.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Second morning yoga and meditation session at home
subevent.description: On the morning of Wednesday, February 19, Yu Xiaowei repeated her routine morning exercise in the living room: 15 minutes of yoga (focusing on spinal twists and neck-and-shoulder relaxation sequences) plus 5 minutes of meditation, aiming to start the workday in a calm state and continue to relieve muscle tension from marathon training.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Third morning yoga and meditation at home
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, February 22, Yu Xiaowei did her daily 15-minute yoga practice at home (incorporating balancing poses such as Tree Pose and Eagle Pose), followed by 5 minutes of meditation, using deep breathing to help herself detach from weekend family matters and maintain physical and mental balance.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Fourth at-home morning yoga and meditation session
subevent.description: On the morning of Wednesday, February 26, Yu Xiaowei, following her newly formed habit, did a 15-minute vinyasa yoga session in her living room (focusing on hip opening and core activation) plus 5 minutes of meditation. After finishing, she felt energized and ready for the day's work and client visits.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - living room at home

name: Take my son to visit the Hong Kong Ani-Com & Games Fair
description: On August 10, unable to withstand her son Xuanxuan's days of pleading, Yu Xiaowei reluctantly took him to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai to visit the Hong Kong Animation and Game Festival. The venue was packed, and the various cosplay characters dazzled her. She originally planned to just make do, but at a creative market stall she saw Cantonese-embroidery-style phone straps and badges and was immediately drawn to them, buying several as references for future design work. Her son cheered with joy after receiving the robot model he loved. Later she laughed to herself that anime conventions weren't entirely a young person's world, and said she could bring her daughter next time.

subevent.name: Getting ready to head to the Anime and Game Festival
subevent.description: On the morning of August 10, Yu Xiaowei was at home with her son Zhang Zixuan (Xuanxuan) preparing the items for visiting the Hong Kong Animation and Gaming Festival, including a water bottle, snacks, a sun hat, and cash, and checked the e-ticket voucher. Yu Xiaowei told Xuanxuan to stay close to her in crowded places, then the two set off from their home on Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City District and took the MTR to the Wan Chai Convention and Exhibition Centre.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Enter the venue to visit the Animation and Game Festival
subevent.description: At around 10:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei and her son Xuanxuan arrived at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai District and queued through security and ticket inspection in the crowd. Inside was packed with people; cosplayers of all kinds moved back and forth. Xuanxuan excitedly pointed out anime characters. Although Yu Xiaowei felt dazzled, she patiently accompanied her son through the exhibition areas to satisfy his curiosity.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre

subevent.name: Discovered Guangdong embroidery handicrafts at the creative market
subevent.description: During the visit, Yu Xiaowei had planned to just go through the motions, but as she passed a creative market stall she was drawn to Cantonese-embroidery-style phone straps and badges. She stopped, examined the items closely, and talked with the stall owner about embroidery craft and design inspiration. In the end she chose three badges and a phone strap to buy, planning to use them as reference material for her own traditional Cantonese embroidery creations later.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - Creative Market at Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre

subevent.name: Buy a robot model for her son.
subevent.description: After Yu Xiaowei bought a handicraft, Xuanxuan pulled her to the anime merchandise area, pointed at a robot model, and looked at his mother with pleading eyes. Yu Xiaowei remembered the promise she had made to her son, so she paid for the model. Xuanxuan hugged the box and jumped for joy, saying thank you, Mom, over and over, hopping and skipping with happiness.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - Anime Merchandise Zone at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre

subevent.name: Finished the visit and planned to bring my daughter next time.
subevent.description: At around two in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei and her son Xuanxuan left the convention and exhibition center with their haul. On the MTR ride home, Xiaowei looked through photos of Cantonese embroidery works she had taken on her phone and laughed at herself for being drawn to the creative market at the anime convention. "So anime conventions aren't all a young person's world," she joked to herself. She told Xuanxuan that next time they could bring his younger sister Xinxin along, and that Xuanxuan could be the little guide and show her around. Xuanxuan readily agreed.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai to Kowloon City District - MTR carriage.

name: Son wins sprint title at school sports meet, inspiring mother to keep running.
description: On Saturday, March 15, her son won first place in the grade-level sprint at the school sports meet. Yu Xiaowei went to cheer him on. After the event, mother and son jogged back along their usual weekend jogging route. Her son excitedly shared his race strategy and said, “Mom, let's keep running fast from now on.” Her son's achievement and enthusiasm made Yu Xiaowei feel the positive passing down of the running habit, and also strengthened her confidence in her marathon goal.

subevent.name: Went to school to attend her son's school sports meet.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, March 15, Yu Xiaowei accompanied her son Zhang Zixuan from home and walked to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, where he studies, to attend this year's school sports day. After arriving, Yu Xiaowei found a seat in the spectator area by the sports field, sat down, and prepared to watch her son's sprint race and cheer him on.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon Tong Government Primary School playground

subevent.name: Watched her son's sprint race, and he won the championship
subevent.description: In the morning, the sprint events of the school sports meet began. Yu Xiaowei watched nervously and excitedly from the stands as her son Zhang Zixuan competed in the grade-level sprint race. Zhang Zixuan performed outstandingly, crossing the finish line first with a clear advantage and winning first place in the grade-level sprint. Yu Xiaowei stood up and cheered, applauding and congratulating her son along with the surrounding parents.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon Tong Government Primary School playground

subevent.name: After the race, the mother and son run home along their usual running route and talk.
subevent.description: On the afternoon after the school sports meet, Yu Xiaowei and her son Zhang Zixuan jogged home easily along their usual weekend route (starting from school, passing through Kowloon Tong streets, and returning to their home on Prince Edward Road West). On the way, Zhang Zixuan excitedly shared race strategies, such as how to jockey for position at the start and how to maintain pace during the run, and blurted out, “Mom, from now on we should both run fast.” This deeply moved Yu Xiaowei, as she felt her son's love for running and the positive influence of her long-term persistence.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - along the route from Kowloon Tong Street to Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: Evening family sharing and reaffirming marathon goals.
subevent.description: That evening at home, Yu Xiaowei, together with her husband Zhang Weiming, her mother Chen Meiling, and the children who were present, looked back on the highlights of the school sports meet, especially telling about her son winning the championship and the mother-son exchange while running. Inspired by her son, she became even more confident about achieving her annual marathon goal and planned to adjust her subsequent training plan to maintain the exercise habit together with her son.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home, 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: Pre-Spring Festival family cleaning and New Year shopping
description: On January 24, Yu Xiaowei discussed and made a cleaning division of labor and a New Year shopping list with her mother Chen Meiling. On January 25, Yu Xiaowei organized the whole family for a thorough spring cleaning, tidied up the home, and put up Spring Festival couplets and fu characters. On January 26, she went with her mother to Mong Kok Market to buy New Year goods, including traditional foods such as rice cakes and cured meats, to prepare for the New Year's Eve reunion dinner.

subevent.name: Make a thorough cleaning and shopping plan
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her mother Chen Meiling discussed and made arrangements in the living room for the family cleaning on January 25 and the Chinese New Year shopping list for January 26. They listed traditional items to buy, such as Spring Festival couplets, the character 'Fu', rice cakes, and cured meats, and confirmed that the cleaning tools were complete.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - living room at home in Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Family deep cleaning and putting up Spring Festival couplets and blessing characters
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei organized her husband Zhang Weiming, her mother Chen Meiling, and the two children Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin to do a full-house spring cleaning. They divided the work: Yu Xiaowei wiped furniture and cleaned the kitchen, Zhang Weiming mopped the floors and cleaned the windows, mother Chen Meiling tidied up clutter and washed the sheets and quilts, Zhang Zixuan helped organize his toys and books, and Zhang Yuxin watered the plants. In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming put up the newly purchased Spring Festival couplets and fu characters on the entrance door and the doors of each room to create a festive Chinese New Year atmosphere.
subevent.location: Home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Buy New Year goods at Mong Kok market
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her mother Chen Meiling went to Mong Kok Street Market together to buy Chinese New Year goods according to the shopping list confirmed the day before. At the market, they bought traditional New Year cake, turnip cake, cured meats, dried scallops, flower mushrooms, and other ingredients, and also picked out fresh flowers and decorations suitable for the Spring Festival. Yu Xiaowei also specially bought candies and red envelopes for the children. After shopping, the two returned home together, sorted the New Year goods, and put them in the refrigerator or storage cabinets, making preparations for the New Year's Eve reunion dinner.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Mong Kok Street Market

name: Attended a workshop on breathing control and meditation skills
description: On Saturday morning, July 5, 2025, Yu Xiaowei signed up for a three-hour workshop called "Pranayama and Meditation" held at a yoga studio. The instructor taught deep abdominal breathing and nadi shodhana in depth. During practice, she felt a deep relaxation she had not experienced in a long time and realized that her daily morning yoga was only an introduction. After class, she bought a book on breathing techniques, planned to incorporate them into her daily practice, and shared her learning insights with her colleague Su Lishan, continuing to improve her self-regulation ability.

subevent.name: Attend a breathing control and meditation workshop.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, July 5, 2025, Yu Xiaowei arrived at the yoga studio in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong half an hour early, checked in, and changed into comfortable clothes. The workshop started at 10:00 sharp. The instructor first explained the theoretical basis of breathing control and the basic principles of meditation, then led the participants through practices such as abdominal breathing and meridian breath regulation, with guided meditation interspersed. During the practices, Yu Xiaowei felt a deep relaxation she had not experienced in a long time and realized that her usual morning yoga was only at an introductory level. The class ended at 13:00. She thanked the instructor and briefly exchanged a few words with the other participants.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - a yoga studio

subevent.name: Buy books related to breathing techniques
subevent.description: After the workshop ended, Yu Xiaowei found a book in the bookshelf attached to the yoga studio or a nearby bookstore that introduced breath control techniques in detail, and its content closely matched what she had learned in the workshop, so she bought it immediately. After flipping through it, she decided to incorporate the methods into her daily morning exercise routine to continuously improve her self-regulation ability.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - bookstore or yoga studio

subevent.name: Shared learning insights with colleagues
subevent.description: That evening, after returning home, Yu Xiaowei contacted her colleague Su Lishan, who also works on the insurance team, via a WeChat voice call, and excitedly shared what she had gained and experienced at the workshop. She described the relaxing effects of abdominal breathing and meditation, and suggested that Su Lishan might also try similar courses. The two talked for about 20 minutes about how to integrate breathing techniques into high-pressure work.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

name: Accompanied her mother-in-law Li Shufen to her annual checkup, showing the deep bond between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law.
description: On February 10, Yu Xiaowei specially took leave to accompany her mother-in-law Li Shufen to Hong Kong Sanatorium and Hospital for an annual checkup. After a series of examinations, the doctor told them that key indicators such as blood pressure and blood sugar were all within the normal range, and Yu Xiaowei felt much relieved. Her mother-in-law was touched by her daughter-in-law's filial piety, and the two chatted about family matters and amusing stories about the grandchildren while waiting, deepening their bond.

subevent.name: Accompany to complete physical examination items
subevent.description: From 8:00 AM to 9:30 AM, Yu Xiaowei accompanied her mother-in-law Li Shufen to complete several checkup items in sequence at the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital Medical Examination Center, including blood draw, blood pressure measurement, electrocardiogram, and vision test. Yu Xiaowei supported and guided her throughout, communicated details with the nurses, and ensured her mother-in-law completed the examination smoothly.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Health Assessment Centre, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital

subevent.name: Waiting for the results and chatting with mother-in-law.
subevent.description: After the physical examination, Yu Xiaowei and her mother-in-law Li Shufen waited in the rest area of the examination center for some results. While waiting, they chatted about family matters. Her mother-in-law mentioned her grandson Zhang Zixuan's academic progress and her granddaughter Zhang Yuxin's fun drawing stories. Yu Xiaowei also shared what she had seen and heard at work. The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law got along well, and their bond deepened.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital rest area

subevent.name: Got the check-up results and felt at ease.
subevent.description: At around 10:00 a.m., Dr. Zhou Wenbin explained the physical examination report to Li Shufen, telling her that key indicators such as blood pressure, blood sugar, and blood lipids were all within normal ranges and that she was in good health. Yu Xiaowei breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing the results. Her mother-in-law, pleased and relieved, praised her daughter-in-law for being filial and considerate, and Yu Xiaowei, in turn, urged her mother-in-law to continue maintaining good living habits.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital consulting room

subevent.name: Accompanied her mother-in-law back home
subevent.description: Around 11 a.m., Yu Xiaowei accompanied her mother-in-law Li Shufen by taxi back to their home at Golden Bridge Mansion, Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District. Yu Xiaowei put away the medical checkup report and reminded her mother-in-law to have lunch and take a nap on time. Then she returned to the company to handle unfinished client work.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kam Kiu Building, Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District / Hong Kong - AIA Office

name: Family gathering at a teahouse to celebrate mother's birthday
description: On the morning of August 22, Yu Xiaowei did a final check of the hand-embroidered Cantonese embroidery silk scarf gift, wrapped it carefully, and then went to Maxim's Bakery to pick up the pre-ordered birthday cake, getting ready to head to the tea house. From 12:00 noon to 2:00 p.m., the whole family celebrated her mother Chen Meiling's 63rd birthday in a private room at the Star Tea House. Yu Xiaowei had booked the room in advance and ordered the traditional Cantonese dim sum her mother loved. During the meal, the children sang Happy Birthday to their grandmother, and her father, Yu Guoqiang, rarely took the initiative to clink glasses with his son-in-law Zhang Weiming. Yu Xiaowei presented the hand-embroidered Cantonese embroidery silk scarf as a gift, and her mother was deeply moved. Her mother recalled memories of raising her children in her younger days, and Yu Xiaowei felt how precious family reunion is. After the gathering ended at 2:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei paid the bill and packed up the leftover dim sum. The family walked back to their home on Prince Edward Road West. Her mother was still happy, and after arriving home, Yu Xiaowei helped her put the cake in the refrigerator, and they agreed to enjoy it in the evening.

subevent.name: Preparing birthday gifts and cake
subevent.description: On the morning of August 22, Yu Xiaowei did a final check at home on the hand-embroidered Guangdong embroidery silk scarf gift and wrapped it carefully. She then went to the Maxim's Cakes shop in Kowloon City District to pick up the birthday cake she had pre-ordered. After returning home, she put the cake and gift into an insulated bag and a gift box, making all preparations to go to the teahouse.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - home and Maxim's Bakery

subevent.name: Birthday celebration meal in a tea house private room
subevent.description: From 12:00 noon to 2:00 pm on August 22, the whole family celebrated mother Chen Meiling's 63rd birthday in a private room at Ming Xing Teahouse. Yu Xiaowei had booked the private room in advance and ordered the traditional Cantonese dim sum her mother loved. During the meal, the children sang a birthday song in chorus for their grandmother, and her father Yu Guoqiang, unusually, took the initiative to clink glasses with son-in-law Zhang Weiming. Yu Xiaowei presented a hand-embroidered Guangdong silk scarf as a gift, and her mother was deeply moved. As the family ate and chatted, her mother recalled stories of raising her children when she was young, and Yu Xiaowei felt deeply how precious family reunion is.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - private room at Star Tea House

subevent.name: Return home after the dinner gathering
subevent.description: On August 22 at 2:30 p.m., after the gathering, Yu Xiaowei paid the bill and packed up the leftover dim sum to take home. The family walked back to their home on Prince Edward Road West. On the way, her mother kept happily talking about the gifts and the atmosphere of the day, while Yu Xiaowei held her mother's arm; her husband Zhang Weiming walked ahead with the two children. After arriving home, everyone rested briefly. Yu Xiaowei helped her mother put the cake in the fridge, and they agreed to enjoy it together in the evening.
subevent.location: From Star Teahouse, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong to home

name: Go to Shenzhen to hold a cross-border insurance sharing session and visit clients
description: On March 11, Yu Xiaowei prepared materials for the sharing session at home and booked the trip. On March 12, she went to Shenzhen and held a small cross-border insurance sharing session in a meeting room at Tencent Building. After the session, she had an in-depth exchange with the client Wang Qiming and initially reached a cooperation intention. In the evening, she had dinner with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng, her close friend Huang Wenhui, and her embroidery friend He Meiling, gave them embroidery pieces, and returned to Hong Kong that night. This trip marked the official start of her cross-border business.

subevent.name: Preparing materials and itinerary for the sharing session
subevent.description: At her home at No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, Yu Xiaowei prepared the presentation materials for the cross-border insurance sharing session in advance, printed promotional brochures, and reviewed the company information of client Wang Qiming. At the same time, she booked cross-border direct bus tickets for the morning of March 12 and a dinner restaurant in Shenzhen via her phone.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Depart for Shenzhen
subevent.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowei set out from home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, took a cross-border direct bus via Shenzhen Bay Port, and after about a one-hour ride arrived at the Science and Technology Park in Nanshan District, Shenzhen, reaching the vicinity of Tencent Building around 11 a.m.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to Shenzhen, Guangdong Province (cross-border bus)

subevent.name: Host a cross-border insurance sharing session.
subevent.description: In a reserved meeting room at Tencent Building, Nanshan District Science and Technology Park, Shenzhen, Yu Xiaowei held a small cross-border insurance sharing session for prospective clients in attendance (about 10–15 people). Drawing on her experience working at AIA Hong Kong, she explained in detail the advantages of Hong Kong insurance products (such as multi-currency policies, high-end medical coverage, and savings with dividends) as well as cross-border asset allocation plans for high-net-worth individuals on the mainland, interspersing real cases and answering clients' questions during the session.
subevent.location: Conference Room, Tencent Building, Nanshan Science and Technology Park, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

subevent.name: In-depth exchange with client Wang Qiming
subevent.description: After the sharing session ended, Yu Xiaowei held an in-depth one-on-one meeting with her client Wang Qiming at a coffee shop near Tencent Building. Wang Qiming consulted her on customized cross-border group health insurance and individual high-end medical plans for his company's executive team. Based on the company's size, employee composition, and budget, Yu Xiaowei initially designed several options. The two parties reached a preliminary intention to cooperate on premiums, coverage, and claims procedures, and agreed to submit a formal quotation later.
subevent.location: Cafe at Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

subevent.name: Dinner gathering and catching up with family and friends
subevent.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowei had dinner with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng, who also lives in Shenzhen, her close friend Huang Wenhui, and her embroidery friend He Meiling at a Hong Kong-style tea restaurant near the Science and Technology Park in Nanshan District. During the meal, they shared updates: Yu Xiaowei talked about the progress of her cross-border business and gave each of them a small Cantonese embroidery souvenir she had made herself; Yu Xiaofeng talked about Tencent's new project; Huang Wenhui shared about life in Shenzhen; and He Meiling talked about her latest embroidery works. The atmosphere was warm, and the dinner ended around 8 p.m.
subevent.location: Guangdong Province, Shenzhen City - Nanshan District Tea Restaurant

subevent.name: Return to Hong Kong
subevent.description: After the dinner gathering, Yu Xiaowei left Shenzhen Science and Technology Park around 8:30 p.m., took a cross-border direct bus via Shenzhen Bay Port back to Hong Kong, and arrived home in Kowloon City District around 10 p.m. After returning home, she briefly noted the key points of the trip and organized the cooperation intention reached with Wang Qiming into a memo, ready to report to her direct supervisor Liang Zhenhua the next day.
subevent.location: From Shenzhen, Guangdong Province to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (cross-border bus).

name: Celebrating the 15th wedding anniversary with dinner at The Peninsula Hotel.
description: On the evening of May 20, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming celebrated their 15th wedding anniversary at the Felix restaurant in The Peninsula Hotel (actual anniversary May 20, 2010). The restaurant was elegant, with a panoramic view of the Victoria Harbour night scene through the window. Her husband gave her a delicate pearl necklace, and she gave him a set of pour-over coffee equipment in return. During the meal, they reminisced about the years from meeting while working in a factory to now having both a son and a daughter, and were moved by how they had supported each other all along. Her husband confessed that he was considering a career change, and Yu Xiaowei immediately expressed full support. Their bond as a couple was strengthened on this special day.

subevent.name: Pre-dinner preparations
subevent.description: In the early evening, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming began to get dressed at their home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District. Yu Xiaowei changed into an elegant dress and put on pearl earrings, while Zhang Weiming put on a suit and tie. The two helped each other tidy their outfits and happily got ready to go out.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Head to The Peninsula Hotel
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming drove their family car from their home in Kowloon City District to The Peninsula Hotel in Tsim Sha Tsui. On the way, they talked about the children's recent situation and the plans for the evening. The drive took about 20 minutes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - The Peninsula Hotel, Tsim Sha Tsui

subevent.name: Celebration dinner at Felix restaurant, The Peninsula Hotel
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming had their 15th wedding anniversary dinner at Felix Restaurant on the 28th floor of The Peninsula Hotel. The restaurant was elegant, and the night view of Victoria Harbour outside the window was dazzling. During the meal, Zhang Weiming gave her a pearl necklace, and Yu Xiaowei gave him pour-over coffee equipment in return. As they savored the fine French cuisine, they recalled the years from meeting while working in a factory, getting married, and now having both a son and a daughter, and were deeply moved. Zhang Weiming said frankly that he was considering a transition from air-conditioning maintenance technician to engineering management. Yu Xiaowei expressed full support on the spot, and their bond was further strengthened on their anniversary.
subevent.location: Felix Restaurant, The Peninsula Hong Kong, Tsim Sha Tsui

subevent.name: Returned home after the dinner banquet.
subevent.description: After the dinner ended, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming drove back to their home on Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City District. It was nearly midnight when they arrived. The two chatted for a while in the living room, sharing the moments that touched them tonight, then washed up and went to bed.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - Home

name: Resume morning runs and develop an autumn half-marathon training plan.
description: On the morning of June 22, Yu Xiaowei jogged 3 km along the community jogging trail near Prince Edward Road West. This was her first regular run since she stopped training in April. She strictly followed her doctor's advice, keeping her pace at about 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer and focusing on her breathing rhythm. After the run, she did 5 minutes of stretching on the lawn to avoid muscle soreness. When she got home, she immediately used a mobile app and calendar to create a 12-week basic training plan for the autumn half marathon, covering three easy runs and one long-distance run per week, and shared the plan with her coach Zhao Zhiming for feedback.

subevent.name: Jog 3 kilometers.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei started jogging on the community jogging trail, strictly keeping her pace at about 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer as her doctor advised, focusing on her breathing rhythm, and completed 3 kilometers along the trail. After finishing, she felt a long-missed sense of ease and joy, and her desire for the autumn half marathon was rekindled.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Prince Edward Road West community jogging trail.

subevent.name: Stretching and relaxation after running.
subevent.description: After her jog, Yu Xiaowei spread out her yoga mat on the grass beside the jogging trail and did five minutes of static stretching, focusing on her calves, front thighs, and back muscles to avoid muscle soreness.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Prince Edward Road West community jogging trail.

subevent.name: Planning autumn half-marathon training
subevent.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei used the mobile app and calendar functions to develop a 12-week base training plan based on her autumn half-marathon goal (expected to race in November), including three easy runs per week and one long run, and set progressive pace targets. She also shared the plan with her coach Zhao Zhiming for advice.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home study on Prince Edward Road West

name: He Junjie privately asked Yu Xiaowei about her relationship with Zhou Minyi, and Yu Xiaowei avoided answering.
description: On October 27, He Junjie asked Yu Xiaowei in a WeChat private chat window: 'What's going on between you and Mandy lately? I always feel like something's off between you two.' Yu Xiaowei felt bitter and awkward, didn't want to say more, and only replied briefly, 'Just busy,' avoiding the question.

subevent.name: He Junjie privately asked about the relationship between Yu Xiaowei and Zhou Minyi
subevent.description: During a break in the classmates group discussion, He Junjie asked Yu Xiaowei through a private WeChat chat: “What's going on between you and Mandy lately? It feels like something is off.” After receiving the message, Yu Xiaowei felt bitter and awkward.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Home

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowei avoided answering the question about her relationship with Zhou Minyi.
subevent.description: Facing He Junjie's private inquiry, Yu Xiaowei felt bitter inside and did not want to talk more about the rift that had developed between her and Zhou Minyi. In the end, she merely replied briefly, “Just busy,” to avoid any in-depth discussion.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Home

name: Night talk with her husband Zhang Weiming, sharing her stress and supporting his career transition
description: On the evening of June 12, after finishing a day's work, Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to invite her husband Zhang Weiming to sit down for a long talk in the living room. She poured out the problem of shirking responsibility she encountered in team management and the father-daughter conflict that she still could not resolve. Zhang Weiming frankly admitted that he intended to leave the air-conditioning repair industry, but worried that unstable income during the transition would drag down the family. Yu Xiaowei encouraged him to use his spare time to learn new skills or look for opportunities, and said the family could handle a short-term adjustment. This sincere exchange made the couple's feelings flow again, and Zhang Weiming's expression was obviously much more relaxed.

subevent.name: Getting the children to sleep and preparing for a late-night talk.
subevent.description: After finishing the day's work, Yu Xiaowei returned to her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong. She first discussed the children's situation with her mother Chen Meiling, and helped put her 8-year-old son Zhang Zixuan and 5-year-old daughter Zhang Yuxin to bed, making sure the home was quiet to create time and space for a private in-depth conversation with her husband Zhang Weiming.
subevent.location: Home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: The couple begins to confide their stress to each other
subevent.description: At about 9 p.m., Yu Xiaowei made two cups of hot tea and invited her husband, Zhang Weiming, to sit down on the living room sofa. She first poured out the difficulty of team members shirking responsibility in her team management at AIA, then mentioned the still unresolved father-daughter conflict with her father, Yu Guoqiang. Her emotions showed, and she hoped to gain her husband's understanding and support.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Home living room

subevent.name: Husband candidly expressed his thoughts on a career change
subevent.description: After Yu Xiaowei opened up, Zhang Weiming honestly said that he wanted to leave the air-conditioning repair industry he had been in for many years, but worried that unstable income during the transition would burden the family. Yu Xiaowei listened carefully, then encouraged her husband to use his spare time to learn new skills or look for other opportunities, and said that the family savings and her income could handle the short-term adjustment, so he didn't need to worry too much.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Home living room

subevent.name: Late-night talk ends, couple's emotional repair
subevent.description: After about an hour of in-depth conversation, the couple reached a consensus on career direction and family division of labor. Yu Xiaowei felt relieved, and Zhang Weiming’s expression was visibly much more relaxed. The two hugged each other. Then they cleaned up the tea set together and each prepared for rest. This late-night talk made the emotions between husband and wife flow again, and the family atmosphere became more harmonious.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Home living room

name: Video call with younger brother to confirm National Day family gathering arrangements
description: Yu Xiaowei had a WeChat video call with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng. The two confirmed the specific itinerary for his family's return to Hong Kong during the National Day holiday (October 1 to 3), including the family dinner location and arrangements for taking the kids to Ocean Park. The siblings also talked about their work pressures, and Yu Xiaowei took the opportunity to ask about Tencent's internal views on insurance benefits, gathering information for future expansion into corporate group insurance.

subevent.name: Had a WeChat video call with my younger brother.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei had a video call via WeChat with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng, who lives far away in Shenzhen, for about 45 minutes. The two confirmed in detail the itinerary for her brother's family's return to Hong Kong during the National Day holiday (October 1 to 3): including a family dinner at a Cantonese restaurant in Kowloon City on the evening of October 1, coordination for the whole family to take the children to Ocean Park on October 2, and free time on October 3. In addition, the siblings talked about their work stress, and Yu Xiaowei took the opportunity to ask her brother about Tencent's current insurance benefit plan for employees, gathering information for future expansion into corporate group insurance business. The call was relaxed and pleasant.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Kowloon City District - living room at home on Prince Road West

name: Proactively invited her father to tea to ease the father-daughter relationship
description: On the evening of July 18, Yu Xiaowei called her father Yu Guoqiang and invited him to yum cha at Lin Heung Kui in Prince Edward the next morning (the 19th), and her father agreed. At about 9:45 a.m. on the 19th, Yu Xiaowei walked to the restaurant. After they were seated, she took the initiative to mention amusing anecdotes about her younger brother's family, and the atmosphere gradually eased. Her father asked about her work stress. After the tea gathering lasted about an hour and a half, they said goodbye, and Yu Xiaowei walked home and told her mother.

subevent.name: Call Dad to invite him for tea
subevent.description: On the evening of July 18, Yu Xiaowei called her father, Yu Guoqiang, and suggested that the two of them go to a traditional teahouse near Prince Edward for yum cha the next morning (Saturday, July 19). Her father was slightly surprised but agreed to the invitation. The two briefly confirmed the time and place, and the call ended after about 5 minutes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Go to Prince Edward Tea House
subevent.description: At about 9:45 a.m. on July 19, Yu Xiaowei set out on foot from her home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, and headed for the agreed traditional teahouse 'Lianxiangju' near Prince Edward MTR Station. She arrived early and waited for her father at the entrance.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Prince Edward area - walking en route.

subevent.name: Have tea with her father to mend their relationship
subevent.description: At about 10 a.m. on July 19, Yu Xiaowei and her father, Yu Guoqiang, sat down at the Lin Heung Kui teahouse in Prince Edward. The atmosphere was quiet at first. Yu Xiaowei proactively brought up funny stories about her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng's family in Shenzhen and the studies of the grandchildren, Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin. Her father gradually relaxed and began asking about her work pressure. Although they did not directly discuss the earlier investment disagreement, the conversation clearly became warmer, and Yu Xiaowei felt the ice between father and daughter begin to thaw. The two spent about an hour and a half drinking tea and having dim sum.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Prince Edward District - Lin Heung Kui Tea House

subevent.name: After yum cha, they each went home.
subevent.description: At about 11:30 on the morning of July 19, after yum cha, Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to her father at the entrance of the teahouse. Her father said he was very glad she had taken the initiative to invite him, and told her to take care of herself. Yu Xiaowei walked home and, on the way, briefly recounted the yum cha gathering to her mother Chen Meiling via WeChat. Her mother felt comforted.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Prince Edward / Kowloon City District

name: Morning half-marathon training, maintaining race preparation rhythm
description: On the morning of April 6, Yu Xiaowei continued her half-marathon training plan, completing a long-distance training run at Kowloon Tsai Park near her home with a steady pace. Although she sensed a busy period ahead, she still tried to maintain her weekend running habit to accumulate mileage for races in the second half of the year.

subevent.name: Waking up and morning preparation
subevent.description: At 5:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei was woken by her alarm clock. After getting up, she quickly washed up, changed into her marathon training gear (running shoes, quick-dry clothes, sports watch), drank a glass of warm water, ate a banana for a quick energy boost, checked her water bottle and phone, and got ready for the upcoming long run.
subevent.location: Home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

subevent.name: Dynamic warm-up and heading to the park.
subevent.description: At 6:00, Yu Xiaowei completed about 10 minutes of dynamic warm-up before running on her home balcony, including high knees, jumping jacks, and lunge stretches to activate muscles and joints. She then walked about 5 minutes to Kowloon Tsai Park near her home, adjusting the GPS on her sports watch on the way, ready to begin running.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Half marathon training - main run.
subevent.description: From 6:15 to 8:15, Yu Xiaowei started a long training run according to her half-marathon plan, completing 21.1 km (half-marathon distance) along the jogging track planned in the park. She maintained a steady pace (about 5:30 per kilometer), briefly rehydrated at 7 km and 14 km, and paid attention to adjusting her breathing and cadence for rhythmic running. The whole process lasted about 2 hours, and the distance reached half-marathon length.
subevent.location: Jogging track, Kowloon Tsai Park, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Post-run cool-down and stretching
subevent.description: From 8:15 to 8:30, after finishing her run, Yu Xiaowei did a slow walking cool-down and full-body static stretching in the park rest area, focusing on the front and back of the thighs, calves, hips and back muscles, for about 15 minutes, to relieve muscle tension and promote recovery. At the same time, she recorded the running data (distance, time, pace) into the mobile fitness app.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - Kowloon Tsai Park rest area

subevent.name: Returned home to shower and have breakfast.
subevent.description: From 8:30 to 9:00, Yu Xiaowei walked back home, immediately took a shower and changed into dry clothes, drank a protein shake to supplement protein, then enjoyed a nutritious breakfast consisting of Hong Kong-style milk tea, a pineapple bun, and boiled eggs. Meanwhile, she chatted briefly with her family (mother, husband, and children) about the morning run and felt their warmth and support.
subevent.location: Home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Attend and follow up on AIA cross-border insurance themed training.
description: Yu Xiaowei carried out a complete learning and application process around AIA's internal cross-border insurance training: on the evening of May 26, she looked up materials at home to prepare; on May 27, she attended the training led by Guo Junwei, and in the afternoon exchanged ideas with colleagues and further developed the business lead of client Wang Qiming; on May 28, she organized her notes, applied what she had learned to client proposal design, and contacted Guo Junwei to arrange a follow-up discussion.

subevent.name: Prepare materials before training.
subevent.description: On the evening of May 26, Yu Xiaowei used her computer in her home study to look up cross-border insurance regulatory comparisons and product structure materials, reviewing the differences between Mainland and Hong Kong insurance, to prepare for the AIA internal cross-border insurance training session the next day.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Home study on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Attended a special training course on cross-border insurance.
subevent.description: From 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. on May 27, Yu Xiaowei went to the training room at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, to attend a special training on cross-border insurance led by Guo Junwei, a colleague from the actuarial department. The course content covered differences between mainland and Hong Kong insurance regulations, common product structures, and compliance practices. Yu Xiaowei listened attentively and took notes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Wan Chai District, AIA Building training room

subevent.name: Training Exchange and Meeting Colleagues
subevent.description: After the training ended on the afternoon of May 27, Yu Xiaowei proactively talked with other attending colleagues inside and outside the training room. She met several colleagues who were also interested in developing the mainland market, and during the break, she consulted the speaker Guo Junwei in detail about the specific compliance issues involved in client Wang Qiming's cross-border business needs, deepening the business lead she had obtained on May 22.
subevent.location: Training room and lounge area, AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

subevent.name: Organizing and following up on client needs after the training
subevent.description: During the day on May 28, Yu Xiaowei organized her training notes at her desk in the AIA Building, applying the regulatory and product knowledge learned in the training to the cross-border business solution design for client Wang Qiming. She also proactively contacted Guo Junwei to arrange further discussion of details within the week, laying the foundation for the subsequent client solution.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District, AIA Building office area

name: Passed the CFP foundation course exam; upon receiving the transcript, I felt more exhausted than joyful.
description: On June 5, Yu Xiaowei received the notification of her CFP basic course exam results and passed. The months of pre-dawn studying since May finally came to an end. When she opened the email, she felt little joy, only the fatigue accumulated over the past months surging up at once. Her husband Zhang Weiming silently handed her a cup of warm water. As she took it, her eyes grew slightly warm, but she simply said that she had passed. The two did not say much, but both understood how hard this period had been.

subevent.name: Final sprint review in the early morning
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei got up at 4 a.m. on June 5 and did a final intensive review in her home study before the CFP basic course exam, focusing on her collection of wrong questions and core formulas. She fought off drowsiness, reviewing while drinking strong tea, until 6 a.m.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home study

subevent.name: Check exam results in the morning
subevent.description: At 7 a.m., Yu Xiaowei logged into the CFP exam system on her phone to check her results. After seeing the word 'Pass,' she did not feel joy; instead, the fatigue accumulated over several months surged up in an instant. She silently put down her phone and sat on the edge of the bed in a daze.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - bedroom at home

name: Open a money market fund account to start small-scale investing.
description: Accompanied by her husband, Yu Xiaowei, after preliminary research (May 18) and an appointment (May 19), opened a money market fund account at HSBC's Wan Chai branch on May 20, 2025, with the assistance of relationship manager Li Guodong, using 10,000 Hong Kong dollars from the family emergency reserve fund, and completed her first purchase. She chose a low-risk, highly liquid money market fund with an annualized return of about 2.5%, and plans to make a monthly fixed investment of 2,000 Hong Kong dollars. This was her first attempt at wealth management beyond savings, reflecting her gradual approach to investing under a conservative financial style.

subevent.name: Learn about money market fund products.
subevent.description: At home, Yu Xiaowei searched online for money market fund product information and called HSBC relationship manager Li Guodong to ask about detailed terms (such as minimum investment amount, fees, redemption rules, etc.). At the same time, she discussed with her husband Zhang Weiming the feasibility of using 10,000 Hong Kong dollars from the family emergency reserve to invest, in preparation for opening an account.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Make an appointment to open a bank account
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei used the HSBC mobile app to book an appointment for the afternoon of May 20, 2025, at the Wan Chai branch to open a money market fund account, and confirmed with her husband once again their schedules for that day.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Go to the bank to open an account and make the first deposit
subevent.description: Accompanied by her husband Zhang Weiming, Yu Xiaowei arrived at the HSBC Wan Chai Branch at the scheduled time. With the assistance of relationship manager Li Guodong, she filled out the account opening application form, signed the agreement, and transferred 10,000 Hong Kong dollars from the family emergency reserve account into the newly opened money market fund account, completing her first subscription.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - HSBC Wan Chai Branch

name: Praise for daughter's ballet sparked a discussion about the parenting budget.
description: On Saturday morning, July 12, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Zhang Zhiqing to ballet class. During class, Zhang Zhiqing performed consecutive turns and was praised by the teacher. After class, the teacher suggested adding one extra intensive class per week to prepare for the year-end recital. That evening, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming spread out the accounting ledger at home, calculated household expenses and their daughter's education costs, and after discussion decided to keep the current number of classes for now and adjust in September.

subevent.name: Take daughter to ballet class.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, July 12, Yu Xiaowei as usual took her daughter Zhang Zhiqing to a dance studio in Kowloon City District to attend that day's ballet class. Yu Xiaowei chatted with other parents while waiting outside the classroom.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - Dance Studio

subevent.name: Daughter received praise, and the teacher suggested adding extra classes.
subevent.description: Zhang Zhiqing completed a set of continuous turns during class and received personal praise from the ballet teacher. After class, the teacher asked Yu Xiaowei to stay behind, praised Zhang Zhiqing's progress, and suggested adding an extra intensive class per week to prepare for the year-end recital.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong - dance studio rest area

subevent.name: Reached consensus in the family budget discussion.
subevent.description: That evening, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming spread out the family ledger at the desk at home and, for the first time, carefully calculated the monthly fixed expenses and their daughter Zhang Zhiqing's extracurricular education costs, discussing the boundary between educational investment and the family budget. The two eventually reached a consensus: keep the current class hours for now and adjust as conditions allow in September.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - home study

name: Responding to the beach cleanup call and cleaning Shek O Beach with daughter
description: On the morning of September 21, Yu Xiaowei responded to a neighbor's beach cleanup call in the community group. She came to Shek O Beach with rubber gloves and a trash grabber, and together with more than twenty volunteers, cleared marine debris that had piled up after the typhoon. Under the scorching sun, she picked up plastic bags, foam, and broken glass. Sweating profusely, she felt an unprecedented sense of fulfillment. Her daughter Xinxin followed behind with a small basket to help, and together the mother and daughter filled three bags of trash. In the afternoon, she posted on Moments: For the first time, I feel that picking up trash is more meaningful than signing a big deal, and received many likes. This experience overturned her previously monotonous weekends, which had been focused only on work and family.

subevent.name: Prepare beach cleanup tools
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei rummaged through the storage room at home and found two pairs of rubber gloves, two litter pickers, and several large garbage bags. She also called her daughter Zhang Yuxin to change into sun-protective clothing and sneakers together, preparing to go to Shek O Beach for a community-organized beach cleanup activity.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Go to Shek O Beach
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei drove her family car, taking her daughter Zhang Yuxin, starting from Kowloon City and driving along the Island Eastern Corridor and Shek O Road for about 40 minutes, then arriving at the parking lot near Shek O Beach.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Shek O Road to Shek O Beach

subevent.name: Participate in beach cleanup
subevent.description: After Yu Xiaowei and her daughter arrived at Shek O Beach, they joined more than twenty volunteers and received their assigned areas. Under the scorching sun, Yu Xiaowei bent down to pick up plastic bags, foam fragments, and glass shards left after the typhoon, while her daughter Xinxin followed behind with a small basket, helping collect smaller pieces of trash. Working with the other volunteers, the mother and daughter filled three large bags of garbage in total. The activity lasted about two hours.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Shek O Beach

subevent.name: Posted on Moments to record the experience
subevent.description: After returning home in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei washed her hands and feet clean, sorted through several activity photos (including a mother-daughter photo and the filled trash bags), and on her phone wrote a WeChat Moments post: "For the first time, I feel that picking up trash is more meaningful than signing a big deal." She attached the beach cleanup photos and published it. Then she checked the comments and likes below and felt fulfilled.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

name: Attend the company's special training on cross-border insurance products
description: On March 26, Yu Xiaowei devoted the entire day to the special training on cross-border insurance products organized by AIA. She prepared a list of questions at home in the study in the morning, and in the afternoon went to the company headquarters in Wan Chai to attend the training given remotely by actuarial colleague Guo Junwei, learning about the latest medical and savings insurance products for Greater Bay Area clients. She asked questions and took notes based on her experience from the Shenzhen sharing session. After the training, she went home, systematically organized her notes, and thought about sales strategies, thereby strengthening her cross-border business capabilities.

subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Attend special training on cross-border insurance products
subevent.description: That afternoon, Yu Xiaowei went to the corporate training room at AIA Tower, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, to attend a special training session on cross-border insurance products organized by the company. The training was led by actuarial colleague Guo Junwei via remote video link, mainly covering the product features, applicable scenarios, and key selling points of the latest medical and savings insurance combinations for clients in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Drawing on her previous understanding of client needs accumulated from the Shenzhen sharing session, Yu Xiaowei asked Guo Junwei questions about product selection strategies for different client groups, and carefully noted the core product points suitable for recommending to mainland clients.

subevent.description: After the training, Yu Xiaowei returned home and immediately organized the notes she had taken during the training. She filed the key points of products suitable for recommending to mainland clients by category, including medical insurance claim details and savings insurance yield comparisons, and noted the differences from local Hong Kong products. At the same time, she thought about how to integrate these new products into her existing sales strategy to enhance their appeal to Greater Bay Area clients.

name: Consult about low-risk wealth management products and make the first transfer.
description: On February 5, 2025, Yu Xiaowei made an appointment via WeChat with relationship manager Li Guodong to meet during the lunch break the next day. On February 6, she went to HSBC to consult in detail about low-risk products such as savings insurance and bond funds. Taking into account her monthly savings target of HK$8,000, she settled on transferring her idle funds of HK$50,000 into the investment account in three installments, with priority allocation of HK$30,000 to savings insurance and HK$20,000 to bond funds. That evening, Yu Xiaowei completed the first transfer of HK$30,000 through mobile banking at home, kicking off her steady asset allocation plan.

subevent.name: Schedule an appointment with the relationship manager
subevent.description: On February 5, 2025, Yu Xiaowei contacted HSBC client manager Li Guodong via WeChat to schedule a lunch break from 1 PM to 2 PM the next day to consult about low-risk wealth management products.
