subevent.name: Consulted and finalized the financial plan
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei met with account manager Li Guodong at HSBC and consulted in detail about low-risk wealth management products such as savings insurance and bond funds. Taking into account her goal of saving HK$8,000 per month, the two finalized a prudent allocation plan: transfer the existing idle funds of HK$50,000 into the wealth management account in three installments, prioritizing savings insurance (HK$30,000) and bond funds (HK$20,000).
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - HSBC Bank Branch

subevent.name: Executed the first transfer from the investment account
subevent.description: At 8 PM that evening, at home, Yu Xiaowei used HSBC mobile banking to transfer the first 30,000 Hong Kong dollars from her current account to a newly opened savings-linked insurance investment account, starting to implement the finalized low-risk allocation plan.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home on Prince Edward Road West

name: Health check-up and implementation of the diet adjustment plan
description: After work on May 15, Yu Xiaowei went to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital for a health checkup and found that her weight had increased slightly and her blood pressure was at the high end of normal. She then consulted Dr. Zhou, who advised her to eat lightly and maintain a regular routine. After returning home that evening, she made a plan to adjust dinner to be low in oil and salt, scheduled to start on May 19. On May 18, she went to Kowloon City Market to buy healthy ingredients. On the evening of May 19, she officially began the new dinner structure at home, preparing healthy meals for her husband and herself.

subevent.name: Go to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital
subevent.description: After work at 6 p.m. on May 15, 2025, Yu Xiaowei set out from her company at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, and took the MTR to the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital in the Central and Western District for a health checkup. She carried her medical insurance card and the physical examination appointment confirmation.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Central and Western District - Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital

subevent.name: Consulted the doctor for health advice.
subevent.description: After the check-up, Yu Xiaowei met with family doctor Zhou Wenbin in the consulting room. After reviewing the report, Dr. Zhou noted that she had gained 1 kg compared with three months earlier and her blood pressure was at the high end of normal. He advised her to eat a light diet, keep a regular schedule, reduce greasy takeout food, increase her intake of vegetables and high-quality protein, and do aerobic exercise at least three times a week. Yu Xiaowei listened carefully and took notes on the key points.
subevent.location: Outpatient consultation room, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, Central and Western District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Formulate a diet adjustment plan.
subevent.description: At 9 p.m. that night, after returning to her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Yu Xiaowei used the memo app on her phone at the kitchen table to draft a dinner adjustment plan for the next week. Based on the doctor's advice, she listed a low-oil, low-salt diet, added ingredients such as chicken breast, salmon, and broccoli, reduced the frequency of takeout, and planned to keep each dinner within 500 kcal. The plan was set to start on May 19 (next Monday).
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Purchase healthy ingredients
subevent.description: At 10 a.m. on Saturday, May 17, Yu Xiaowei went to Kowloon City Market to buy the healthy ingredients she needed for her plan. She purchased chicken breast, salmon, broccoli, spinach, tomatoes, eggs, oats, and more, spending about 280 Hong Kong dollars. After returning home, she sorted the ingredients and put them in the refrigerator, getting ready for next week's dinner adjustments.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong - Kowloon City Market

subevent.name: Start implementing the new dinner plan
subevent.description: On Monday, May 19, at 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowei began implementing the adjusted dinner plan as scheduled. Using the ingredients she had bought the previous day, she prepared two healthy dinners for herself and her husband Zhang Weiming: pan-seared chicken breast with stir-fried broccoli and multigrain rice, each about 450 kcal. She took photos to document it and reminded herself to stick with it for at least a month.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - home kitchen

name: Weekend mother-daughter ballet class quality time
description: Every Saturday morning, Yu Xiaowei takes her daughter Zhang Yuxin to a ballet class at the dance studio in Kowloon City District. While waiting, she handles work, studies, or arranges household chores; after class, mother and daughter often enjoy quality time at nearby dessert shops, noodle shops, shopping malls, or parks, doing activities such as shopping, afternoon tea, and playing. This fixed routine is an important family leisure activity that allows her to maintain close interaction and relaxation with her daughter amid her busy schedule.

subevent.name: Parent-child time at ballet class on Saturday morning, March 1
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, March 1, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to a dance studio in Kowloon City District for a ballet class. While the class was in session, Yu Xiaowei waited at a nearby cha chaan teng, drinking Hong Kong-style milk tea. After class, the mother and daughter enjoyed Hong Kong-style desserts at a dessert shop near the dance studio, then browsed a nearby accessories shop, enjoying some quality time together.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - dance studio and surrounding area in Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Saturday morning, March 8: parent-child time at ballet class.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, March 8, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to a ballet class at a dance studio in Kowloon City District. While waiting, Yu Xiaowei used her phone to handle work messages in the studio's waiting area. After class, the mother and daughter had lunch at a nearby wonton noodle shop. Zhang Yuxin shared fun stories from class, and then they walked home together.
subevent.location: Dance studio and noodle shop, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Parent-child time at the ballet class on Saturday morning, March 15
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, March 15, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to a ballet class at a dance studio in Kowloon City District. With midterm exams approaching this week, Yu Xiaowei used the waiting time to review insurance product materials on a bench outside the classroom. After class, the mother and daughter went shopping in the nearby plaza, bought a new hairband for Zhang Yuxin, and enjoyed pineapple bun afternoon tea together.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District dance studio and shopping plaza

subevent.name: Saturday morning, March 22: ballet class parent-child time
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, March 22, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to a dance studio in Kowloon City for a ballet class. Because she would be attending a meditation retreat the following week, Yu Xiaowei had already discussed the subsequent pickup and drop-off arrangements with her husband Zhang Weiming. While waiting, she made phone calls to confirm family matters. After class, the mother and daughter went to a nearby park to play. Zhang Yuxin practiced ballet moves on the grass while Yu Xiaowei took photos beside her. Then they went home together.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - dance studio and park in Kowloon City District

name: Annual family health checkup and dinner, returning home.
description: On the morning of January 11, Yu Xiaowei, her husband Zhang Weiming, and their two children went to the health check center at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital for their annual physical examination. Yu Xiaowei also consulted about marathon training. After the examination, the family had morning tea at a nearby Hong Kong-style diner, then drove home to rest and organize the health check reports.

subevent.name: Complete all the family physical examination items at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital
subevent.description: After arriving at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital at 8:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei's family checked in at the self-service terminal in the outpatient hall and were then guided by a nurse to the health assessment center. The whole family took basic examinations in turn, including height, weight, blood pressure, vision, complete blood count, urinalysis, electrocardiogram, and abdominal ultrasound. While waiting, the children were comforted by their parents, and Yu Xiaowei also took time to complete the consultation registration related to marathon training. The whole checkup lasted about 1.5 hours, and all examinations were finished around 10:00.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Central and Western District - Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital Health Check Centre

subevent.name: The whole family enjoyed morning tea together after the health check-up.
subevent.description: At 10:50 a.m., Yu Xiaowei's family left Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital and walked to a nearby Hong Kong-style tea restaurant. The four ordered shrimp dumplings, siu mai, barbecue pork buns, chicken feet, and Yu Xiaowei's favorite pineapple bun with butter and Hong Kong-style milk tea, while the children had egg tarts and iced lemon tea. During the meal, the family talked about the funny things the children did at the checkup and planned next weekend's activities. Yu Xiaowei paid the bill by credit card, totaling about HK$300. The meal took about an hour and ended at 11:50.
subevent.location: A Hong Kong-style tea restaurant near Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

subevent.name: After the meal, return home to rest.
subevent.description: Around noon at 12:00, the family finished lunch, and Zhang Weiming drove Yu Xiaowei and the children back to their home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District. After arriving home around 12:30, Yu Xiaowei put the two children down for a nap and organized the medical examination reports and health records she had brought back from the hospital. She also photographed the doctor's recommended exercise and diet plan and sent it to the family WeChat group. She then rested briefly in the living room to prepare for handling work emails in the afternoon.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

name: Monthly family financial review and holiday budget planning.
description: On the evening of November 29, Yu Xiaowei and her husband sat in the study and opened the expense-tracking app to review monthly spending. Because they had strictly followed the plan to cut back on dining out, they saved more than 800 Hong Kong dollars this month, and with the half-marathon expenses kept within budget, the family savings had recovered somewhat. The two then took the opportunity to discuss the Christmas gift budget and year-end additional savings goal, wrapping up the year's financial targets.

subevent.name: Check monthly expenses.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming sat together in the study, cross-checking the bookkeeping app against paper receipts, and verified item by item the family's November expenses, including food, transportation, daily necessities, children's education, half-marathon-related costs, and so on, confirming that the records were accurate.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Evaluate the results of cutting back on eating out
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming compared their dining-out spending in October and November and found that because they had strictly implemented the plan to cut down on eating out, this month's dining-out costs decreased by about 800 HKD compared with last month. The two were satisfied with this result.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Discussing the Christmas gift budget
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming discussed the total budget for preparing Christmas gifts for family members (parents, children, and mother-in-law), initially drafted a plan of 500-800 Hong Kong dollars per person, and agreed to do the shopping together next week.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Set a year-end additional savings target
subevent.description: Based on this month's balance, Yu Xiaowei discussed it with her husband Zhang Weiming and added 2,000 Hong Kong dollars to the November savings plan, then adjusted the December budget to ensure the annual household savings target could be successfully met.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Visited her mother-in-law with joint pain, bringing Cantonese embroidery tools, and completed the embroidery work together.
description: On Wednesday evening, August 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowei learned that her mother-in-law Li Shufen had a flare-up of rheumatic joint pain. After work, she took her Cantonese embroidery tools from the AIA Building in Wan Chai and went to visit her at Gold Bridge Building, 45 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District. Her mother-in-law was sitting by the window rubbing her knees; seeing the needle and thread, she recalled her younger days embroidering in a garment factory. The two spread out the fabric, and her mother-in-law guided the stitching while Xiaowei threaded the needle, together completing a small embroidered piece of butterflies and peonies. Her mother-in-law stroked the embroidery, moved that the craft had been passed down. Xiaowei comforted her and promised to come often to embroider with her. After a warm evening together, she left around 9 p.m.

subevent.name: Learned that her mother-in-law had joint pain and decided to visit her
subevent.description: On the evening of Wednesday, August 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowei received a call from her mother-in-law Li Shufen before leaving work, or learned from the family group chat that her mother-in-law's rheumatic joint pain had flared up. Worried, she decided to bring her Yue embroidery tools and go to Kwun Tong to visit her mother-in-law right after work, chatting with her to cheer her up.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road

subevent.name: Took Cantonese embroidery tools to her mother-in-law's house.
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowei left from AIA Hong Kong's Wan Chai office, brought along tools she usually uses for Cantonese embroidery such as needles and thread, fabric, and embroidery hoops, and took the MTR or bus to her mother-in-law's home in Kwun Tong District. On the way, she bought her mother-in-law's favorite pineapple bun and Hong Kong-style milk tea at a nearby tea restaurant as snacks.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District to Kwun Tong District

subevent.name: Embroidering butterflies and peonies together with my mother-in-law
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at her mother-in-law's home at Golden Bridge Building, 45 Hong Ning Street, Kwun Tong District, and saw her mother-in-law sitting by the window rubbing her knees. She took out the Cantonese embroidery tools. Her mother-in-law recalled memories of embroidering at a garment factory when she was young, and the two of them spread out the fabric together. Her mother-in-law guided the stitching while Xiaowei threaded the needle, and together they embroidered a pattern of butterflies and peonies. As they worked, they chatted about family matters, creating a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kwun Tong District - 45 Hong Ning Road, Golden Bridge Mansion

subevent.name: Completed the embroidery and shared emotions
subevent.description: After completing the small butterfly-and-peony embroidery piece, Yu Xiaowei tidied up the embroidered panel and handed it to her mother-in-law. Her mother-in-law stroked the panel, her eyes slightly moist, and remarked with emotion that the craft had been passed down. Yu Xiaowei comforted her and said that she would come often to do embroidery with her in the future. The two spent a warm evening together, and Yu Xiaowei left her mother-in-law's home around 9 p.m. and returned to her own home in Kowloon City District.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kwun Tong District - 45 Hong Ning Road, Golden Bridge Mansion

name: First time attending the community book club; discussed The Drunkard
description: After seeing the recruitment poster for the community center’s [One Book a Month] program, Yu Xiaowei attended her first reading club meeting with a try-it-out attitude. The book under discussion was The Drunkard by local writer Liu Yichang. At the meeting she met new friends such as retired editor Uncle Liang and stay-at-home mom May. Although she mainly listened, she gained a long-lost serenity in spirit.

subevent.name: Took note of the book club recruitment poster
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei saw a recruitment poster for 'One Book a Month' on the bulletin board at the Kowloon City Community Centre. She was interested in the book being discussed, The Drunkard by Liu Yichang, and decided to attend the first reading club meeting. She noted down the activity time and location on her phone.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Kowloon City Community Centre

subevent.name: Go to the community center to attend the book club
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei set out from her home on Prince Edward Road West, walked about 15 minutes to the Kowloon City Community Center, arrived at the event venue early, checked in, and picked up the book club materials.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - on the way from home to Kowloon City Community Centre

subevent.name: Participated in the first book club discussion of The Drunkard.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei attended the monthly book club organized by the community center in its activity room. This session discussed Liu Yichang's The Drunkard. She listened carefully to the other members' remarks, mainly listening, and only briefly shared her initial thoughts when introducing the topic, feeling a long-lost spiritual peace inside.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Activity Room, Kowloon City Community Centre

subevent.name: Made new friends, Uncle Liang and Ah May
subevent.description: After the book club ended, Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to talk with the retired editor Liang Zhiqiang (Uncle Liang) and full-time mother Chen Meiyi (May) sitting next to her. The three introduced their reading preferences and community activity experiences, and agreed to meet again at the next book club.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Kowloon City Community Centre Rest Area

subevent.name: After returning home, review the book club experience
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei returned home, briefly wrote down today's book club experience in her notebook in the study, took out a copy of The Drunkard from her home collection and reread the first few chapters, and shared her feelings about attending the book club for the first time with her husband Zhang Weiming, feeling spiritually fulfilled.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

name: Cross-border business knowledge preparation received lukewarm feedback
description: On July 3, to prepare for the cross-border insurance business, Yu Xiaowei contacted HSBC Bank relationship manager Li Guodong and actuarial colleague Guo Junwei in Guangzhou. Li Guodong only briefly explained the process over the phone and postponed the face-to-face meeting due to a busy schedule; Guo Junwei only replied with an email attachment and did not follow up after that. On July 10, she further tried calling the front desk of the Shenzhen branch and sought contacts through client Wang Qiming, but got no substantial help. Throughout the process, feedback from all parties remained cold and fragmented, and as of July 12, preparation of cross-border business knowledge had come to a standstill.

subevent.name: Contacted Li Guodong for the first time to consult about cross-border business.
subevent.description: In order to expand her cross-border insurance business, on the morning of July 3, Yu Xiaowei called Li Guodong, a relationship manager at HSBC, from the study of her home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong. During the call, Li briefly introduced the basic process of cross-border insurance but said he was too busy recently and postponed the face-to-face meeting to a later date. Yu Xiaowei recorded the preliminary information and agreed to get in touch later.
subevent.location: Home study in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Sent an email to Guo Junwei requesting Shenzhen market materials
subevent.description: That same afternoon, Yu Xiaowei sent an email from her office (AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong) through the company email system to Guo Junwei (insurance actuarial and product specialist in Guangzhou), describing in detail the insurance product rules and key cross-border business points she needed to understand about the Shenzhen market, and attaching a list of specific questions. Guo Junwei replied that day with some standard attachments, but there was no further follow-up.
subevent.location: Office, AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Try to contact the Shenzhen branch through other channels
subevent.description: On July 10, Yu Xiaowei used internal company resources to find the public contact information for the Shenzhen branch. She called the front desk and tried to be transferred to the relevant business department, but the front desk said an internal referral was required and could not connect her directly. She then contacted Wang Qiming, a Shenzhen client she had known before (CTO of a tech company), via WeChat, asking whether he had any contacts in the insurance industry. Wang Qiming said he could help ask around, but there was no clear response yet.
subevent.location: Office, AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: At a Spring Festival gathering of high school classmates, Zhou Minyi shared opportunities in Shenzhen, and He Junjie lamented the changes in the industry.
description: On February 2 (the fifth day of the first lunar month), Yu Xiaowei attended a Spring Festival dinner with high school classmates. During the meal, Zhou Minyi, who works in finance in Shenzhen, enthusiastically talked about the local financial circle's new demand for Hong Kong insurance. When she saw Yu Xiaowei's family photo, she softly sighed, 'I really envy you, having your family by your side.' Yu Xiaowei noted the potential cross-border opportunity but did not notice the complex emotions hidden in her envy. At the same table, He Junjie complained that new energy vehicles were severely impacting traditional car sales and that foot traffic at the 4S dealership where he worked had plummeted, drawing sighs from everyone about the industry's changes, and also vaguely stirred Xiaowei's thoughts about her husband's repair and maintenance industry.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparation and heading to the gathering
subevent.description: At about 4 pm on February 2, 2025 (the fifth day of the first lunar month), Yu Xiaowei got ready at her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong. She brought the family photo she had prepared in advance and New Year gifts for her classmates, said a brief goodbye to her husband Zhang Weiming and the children, then walked alone to the nearby Prince Edward Road West bus stop at 4:30 pm and took KMB route 1A toward Mong Kok, planning to have a dinner gathering with high school classmates at a pre-booked Chinese restaurant in Mong Kok.
subevent.location: Hong Kong – home in Kowloon City District; Mong Kok – Chinese restaurant

subevent.name: Spring Festival dinner with high school classmates
subevent.description: On February 2, 2025 (the fifth day of Chinese New Year), from 5:30 p.m. to 8:00 p.m., Yu Xiaowei attended a Chinese New Year dinner with high school classmates at a Chinese restaurant in Mong Kok. During the meal, her old classmate Zhou Minyi, who works in financial analysis in Shenzhen, enthusiastically shared that Shenzhen's finance circle had growing demand for Hong Kong's high-end insurance products and suggested that Yu Xiaowei could take advantage of the cross-border business opportunity. When Yu Xiaowei took out a family photo to show, Zhou Minyi looked at it and sighed softly, "I really envy you—your family is all by your side." Yu Xiaowei only took it as polite small talk and did not notice the complex emotions hidden in her envy. Another old classmate, He Junjie, complained about the impact of new-energy vehicles on traditional car sales, saying that foot traffic at the 4S store where he worked had dropped by more than 50%, prompting the classmates present to lament the changes in the industry. Yu Xiaowei thought of her husband, Zhang Weiming, who might also face the challenge of technological iteration in the air-conditioning repair industry, but she did not mention it at the table. The three of them ate Hong Kong-style dim sum while recalling high school memories, and the atmosphere was lively.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Mong Kok - private room in a Chinese restaurant

subevent.name: Returning home
subevent.description: At 8:20 p.m. on February 2, 2025, the fifth day of the first lunar month, after the dinner gathering, Yu Xiaowei, Zhou Minyi, and He Junjie said goodbye to one another at the entrance of the restaurant and agreed to stay in touch. Yu Xiaowei took KMB bus 1A back to Kowloon City District and arrived home at 8:50 p.m. She briefly told her husband Zhang Weiming about the gathering, praised Zhou Minyi for doing well in Shenzhen, and mentioned He Junjie's industry difficulties. Afterward, she checked the children's homework and chatted briefly with her mother Chen Meiling.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Mong Kok to Kowloon City District - bus and home

subevent.name: Organized the get-together information and follow-up thoughts.
subevent.description: On February 2, 2025 (the fifth day of the first lunar month), from 9:00 to 9:30 p.m., after washing up, Yu Xiaowei sat down at the dressing table in her bedroom and used the memo on her phone to record what Zhou Minyi had mentioned about Shenzhen clients' needs for Hong Kong insurance, marking it as a potential opportunity. She also thought of He Junjie's conversation about new energy vehicles impacting traditional industries, and wrote the reminder 'pay attention to changes in Weiming's industry' in her notebook. After that, she sent Zhou Minyi a WeChat message thanking her for sharing, and agreed to visit her next time she went to Shenzhen. Finally, she browsed the work group messages and fell asleep before 10 p.m.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home bedroom

name: Create a spring exercise and nutrition plan
description: From January 5 to 7, Yu Xiaowei first organized the detailed performance data from the Standard Chartered Half Marathon and her recent medical examination report in her home study. Then, on January 6, she went to Hong Kong Vitality Fitness Centre in Sha Tin District to meet with coach Zhao Zhiming, and together they developed a spring exercise and nutrition plan that included running, yoga, and strength training, with a focus on protein supplementation three times a week and vegetable and fruit juice intake, and set a phased goal of a 10-kilometer road race in April. On January 7, she organized the plan into a written document at home, confirmed it, and saved it in the memo app on her phone for execution.

subevent.name: Preparing the materials needed to make the spring plan.
subevent.description: At home in her study, Yu Xiaowei organized the detailed performance data from the Standard Chartered Half Marathon (split pace, heart rate, recovery) along with her recent physical examination report. She categorized and summarized them, preparing the data for the next day's meeting with coach Zhao Zhiming to create a spring exercise and nutrition plan.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home study

subevent.name: Meet with coach Zhao Zhiming to develop the spring plan.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei went to Hong Kong Vitality Fitness Centre in Sha Tin District to meet her coach Zhao Zhiming. Based on half-marathon performance data and medical examination reports, they had an in-depth discussion and jointly developed a spring exercise and nutrition plan that included running, yoga, and strength training. It focused on three weekly protein supplements and a vegetable-fruit juice intake plan, and set a phased goal of participating in a 10-kilometer road race in April.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Sha Tin District - Hong Kong Vitality Fitness Center

subevent.name: Organize and confirm the spring plan
subevent.description: In her home study, based on the discussion with coach Zhao Zhiming, Yu Xiaowei organized the spring exercise and nutrition plan into a complete written document, including the weekly training schedule (time allocation for running, yoga, and strength training), daily dietary supplement requirements, and a reminder to register for the April road race. After confirming it, she saved it to her phone memo for daily execution.

name: Attended the team quarterly performance review meeting and received the Sales Pioneer Award; after the meeting, exchanged ideas and formulated the Q2 plan.
description: On the afternoon of April 2, 2025, Yu Xiaowei attended the team's quarterly performance review meeting at AIA's Wan Chai office, hosted by Regional Sales Director Liang Zhenhua. At the meeting, Liang Zhenhua summarized the team's performance in the first quarter, commented on each member's strengths and weaknesses, and announced the incentive plan for the new quarter. Because Yu Xiaowei had exceeded her personal critical illness insurance target in the first quarter, she received a small “Sales Pioneer” trophy and an Amazon gift card. subevent.name: Attended the quarterly review meeting and received the Sales Pioneer Award

At the meeting, Liang Zhenhua summarized the team's performance in the first quarter, commented on each member's strengths and weaknesses one by one, and announced the incentive plan for the new quarter. She went on stage to receive the award and shared concise experience.
