Yu Xiaowei planned to learn more first and then talk to her father, to avoid upsetting him directly.

subevent.name: Call Li Guodong to consult about estate planning.
subevent.description: During the lunch break on October 30, 2025, Yu Xiaowei called Li Guodong, senior wealth management manager at HSBC, from her office at AIA in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, for an initial consultation about the estate planning of her father Yu Guoqiang, who wanted to leave his savings to his children. Yu Xiaowei briefly explained her father's situation and asked about feasible options. Li Guodong suggested considering setting up a trust or purchasing tax-exempt savings insurance, and promised to provide detailed materials later. The call lasted about 20 minutes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

subevent.name: Recorded Li Guodong's suggestions and scheduled a time for detailed discussion.
subevent.description: After the call ended, Yu Xiaowei jotted down the two main directions Li Guodong mentioned—trusts and tax-exempt savings insurance—along with the advantages and disadvantages of each in her notebook at her desk. She then confirmed with Li Guodong via WeChat and scheduled a face-to-face discussion for an afternoon on a weekday next week (tentatively November 5 or 6) at the HSBC Wan Chai branch office, so as to go into the plan details in depth. Yu Xiaowei noted the appointment in her calendar.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

subevent.name: Think about strategies for communicating with father and do preliminary research
subevent.description: Before her lunch break ended, Yu Xiaowei used her phone to briefly search for basic introductions to family trusts and Hong Kong tax-exempt savings insurance to deepen her understanding of the concepts. At the same time, she mentally sorted out how to discuss the topic with her father, Yu Guoqiang, planning to start by saying she wanted to understand family financial security, avoiding direct mention of estate planning to prevent her father from becoming resistant. She decided to wait until after her detailed discussion with Li Guodong next week before finding an opportunity to talk with her father.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

name: Complaint-driven team responsibility restructuring and process optimization
description: From September 15 to 18, 2025, Li Ming, a new team member, publicly complained about unfair task allocation. With the help of senior colleague Su Lishan, Yu Xiaowei gradually resolved the conflict through one-on-one communication, clarification of responsibilities, release of a restructuring plan, review and reflection, and the establishment of transparent operating procedures. Amid doubt and persistence, she improved her management skills.

subevent.name: Handle a new hire's public complaint
subevent.description: On the morning of September 15, 2025, Li Ming, a new team member, publicly complained in the office about unfair task allocation, accusing Yu Xiaowei of favoring some members. Yu Xiaowei immediately paused her work, invited Li Ming to the meeting room for one-on-one communication, and patiently listened to his specific grievances and demands. Afterwards, Yu Xiaowei contacted senior colleague Su Lishan and asked her to help mediate and soothe the team's emotions. That afternoon, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan reviewed the complaint together, made a preliminary judgment that the task allocation indeed had a problem of information opacity, and decided to start a thorough review of responsibilities.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

subevent.name: Clarifying the team's division of responsibilities
subevent.description: On September 16, 2025, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan spent the whole day in the AIA Insurance meeting room, going through all team members (8 people in total) item by item to review their current responsibilities and project assignments. Using an Excel spreadsheet, they calculated workload differences and found that new employees were indeed handling trivial tasks while senior employees were concentrated on high-value projects. During the process, some senior employees questioned Yu Xiaowei's intentions and management ability, believing that the changes would disrupt the existing rhythm. Yu Xiaowei insisted on having a brief conversation with each member, recording their concerns, and promised that the plan would balance fairness and efficiency.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

subevent.name: Announce the restructuring plan and communicate it
subevent.description: On the morning of September 17, 2025, Yu Xiaowei officially announced the restructured responsibility and task allocation plan at the team regular meeting, including rotating some high-value projects based on capability, and clarifying task assignment principles and the public notification process. She candidly explained the reasons for the adjustment and emphasized transparent operations. Facing continued questions from some members, Yu Xiaowei answered them one by one and promised on the spot to publish the assignment table every month. In the end, most members expressed understanding and support, and the new colleague Li Ming also accepted the new arrangement. That afternoon, Yu Xiaowei accompanied Li Ming to get familiar with the new tasks, and the team collaboration atmosphere recovered.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

subevent.name: Review and establish transparent process specifications
subevent.description: On September 18, 2025, Yu Xiaowei was alone in her office reviewing the entire incident and summarizing management lessons. In the afternoon, after discussing with Su Lishan, they jointly drafted the Operational Guidelines for Transparent Team Task Allocation, which included publishing the next week's tasks every Friday and setting up open feedback channels. Yu Xiaowei submitted the guidelines to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua for review and planned to formally implement them the following Monday. Through this incident, Yu Xiaowei's management ability slowly improved amid criticism and reflection.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

name: CFP basic course exam preparation shifted to the early morning hours; her husband accompanied her but grew increasingly silent.
description: To balance work and preparation for the CFP basic course, Yu Xiaowei discussed with her husband Zhang Weiming on the evening of April 28 and agreed to adjust her study time to 5 a.m. to 7 a.m. starting in May. Her husband voluntarily accompanied her, getting up early every day to prepare warm water for her and reading beside her. However, after May began, her husband gradually became quiet and withdrawn, often staring blankly or looking preoccupied. Although Yu Xiaowei noticed something was wrong, she did not investigate because of the pressure of exam preparation and her new position. The hidden worry between the couple lasted until the end of May.

subevent.name: Communication with husband about adjusting study schedule
subevent.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowei discussed with her husband Zhang Weiming in the living room of their home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, and decided that starting May 1, the time for studying CFP foundation courses would be adjusted to 5:00 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. in order to balance work and exam preparation. Zhang Weiming expressed support and was willing to get up at the same time to keep her company, prepare warm water for her, and wait by her side reading.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Kowloon City District - living room at home on Prince Road West

subevent.name: First early-morning study accompaniment
subevent.description: At 5 a.m., Yu Xiaowei followed the adjusted study plan for the first time, studying the CFP foundation course in her home study on Prince Edward Road West. Her husband Zhang Weiming also got up at the same time, quietly prepared a glass of warm water for her, and sat in the living room reading to keep her company. The couple did not communicate much, but the atmosphere was peaceful.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - study and living room at home on Prince Edward Road West.

subevent.name: Her husband's silence first appears
subevent.description: During her early-morning study session, Yu Xiaowei noticed that her husband, Zhang Weiming, was no longer focusing on his reading as usual; he was frequently spacing out and staying quiet. Because she was busy with exam preparation and her new position, she sensed something was off but did not ask in depth. She only said a few brief words of concern and then continued studying.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Kowloon City District - living room at home on Prince Road West

subevent.name: Her husband's silence deepened.
subevent.description: At 5 a.m., Yu Xiaowei continued studying the CFP course in the study. Zhang Weiming stayed by her side as usual, but he was clearly preoccupied, staring blankly out the window for a long time and giving short responses to any conversation. Yu Xiaowei felt a sense of worry inside, but because of the pressure of exam preparation and the tight schedule, she did not have an in-depth conversation with her husband.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Kowloon City District - living room at home on Prince Road West

subevent.name: Month-end status continues
subevent.description: On the last day of her early-morning study, Yu Xiaowei completed the May CFP basic course review plan. Her husband Zhang Weiming continued to keep her company, but his reticence had not improved. After finishing her study, Yu Xiaowei briefly talked with her husband, but the core issue was not addressed, and the underlying worries between the couple continued to build.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Kowloon City District - living room at home on Prince Road West

name: Planned visit to younger brother in Shenzhen ran into a client no-show and Zhou Minyi demanding client information.
description: On July 13, Yu Xiaowei took her children by high-speed rail to Shenzhen, planning to visit her younger brother's family. Along the way, she arranged to meet a client at a mall coffee shop, but the client stood her up at the last minute, leaving her and the children waiting in the mall all afternoon until the children were bored of playing in the play area. In the evening, Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi came to meet up. During the meal, Zhou Minyi raised the topic of high-end clients again and asked for information. Yu Xiaowei, without thinking twice, sent her the client's WeChat contact card and requirements, but there was no follow-up progress afterward.

subevent.name: Take the children to Shenzhen by high-speed rail.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei prepared gifts and children's supplies in advance. In the morning, she set out from home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, took her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin to Hong Kong West Kowloon High-Speed Rail Station, and took the high-speed rail to Shenzhen North Station, planning to visit her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng's family.
subevent.location: Home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Hong Kong West Kowloon High-Speed Rail Station

subevent.name: At a coffee shop in the mall, waiting for a client who stood her up.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei brought her two children to a coffee shop in a shopping mall in Shenzhen, waiting to meet a potential cross-border client introduced by Wang Qiming. She waited while taking care of the children, but half an hour after the scheduled time, the client sent a message to cancel at the last minute, leaving her waiting idly in the mall all afternoon.
subevent.location: Coffee shop at a shopping mall, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

subevent.name: The children spent time in the mall's play area
subevent.description: Because the client stood her up, Yu Xiaowei could not leave the mall, so she had her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin play in the children's play area to pass the time. After playing for a long time, the children became bored; Yu Xiaowei had to patiently accompany them, all the while anxiously waiting for the evening gathering with friends.
subevent.location: Shenzhen, Guangdong Province - children's play area in a shopping mall

subevent.name: Evening get-together with Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi
subevent.description: In the evening, Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi came to the mall to meet Yu Xiaowei. The four of them (plus the two children) went to a restaurant near the mall for dinner. During the meal, Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi asked with concern about Yu Xiaowei's experiences that day; the three chatted happily while the children played nearby.
subevent.location: Shenzhen, Guangdong Province - restaurant near the mall

subevent.name: Shared client information with Zhou Minyi.
subevent.description: During dinner, Zhou Minyi enthusiastically brought up a high-end client that Yu Xiaowei had mentioned before, saying the client was very interested and that she was willing to help make the introduction. Without giving it much thought, Yu Xiaowei sent the client's WeChat contact card and basic insurance needs to Zhou Minyi from her phone on the spot. Zhou Minyi immediately added the client on WeChat, but afterwards their communication remained only polite greetings, with no substantive in-depth conversation.
subevent.location: Shenzhen, Guangdong Province - restaurant near the mall

name: New Year's Day at Victoria Peak and Family Sharing
description: On January 1, 2025, Yu Xiaowei, her husband Zhang Weiming, and their family climbed to the observation deck at Peak Tower on Victoria Peak in the early morning to await the New Year sunrise. At sunrise, they wrote their New Year wishes and hung them on the wishing wall. Afterwards, the family took the Peak Tram down the mountain and returned to their home in Kowloon City District, where they had breakfast with her mother, Chen Meiling, sharing the Peak-wishing experience and New Year plans.

subevent.name: Waiting for sunrise at the Sky Terrace of The Peak Tower.
subevent.description: At around 5 a.m., Yu Xiaowei's family arrived at the observation deck of the Peak Tower on Victoria Peak. Many tourists were already on the peak waiting for sunrise. Yu Xiaowei held her daughter Zhang Yuxin, while Zhang Weiming held their son Zhang Zixuan by the hand, and they found a good spot by the railing with a view. As they admired the dazzling night view of Victoria Harbour, they chatted excitedly about their New Year plans. Yu Xiaowei took out her phone to take photos.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Peak Tower Observation Deck at Victoria Peak

subevent.name: Greet the New Year's sunrise and write down a wish.
subevent.description: At 6:05 in the morning, the first ray of sunshine of the New Year rose from the sea in the east, and Yu Xiaowei's family cheered to welcome it. Then Yu Xiaowei took three wish cards and a pen from her backpack. She first wrote down two goals: "Be promoted to deputy manager, finish half marathon under 2 hours." Zhang Weiming silently took the pen and added "Keep your own pace" at the bottom of her card. Zhang Zixuan drew a small car, and Zhang Yuxin drew a heart. The whole family hung the wish cards on the wishing wall at the viewing platform and took a group photo.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wishing Wall, Sky Terrace 428, The Peak Tower

subevent.name: Walked down the mountain and returned home
subevent.description: The sunrise ended around 7 a.m., and the crowd at the summit gradually grew. Yu Xiaowei's family took the summit cable car down the mountain, then walked to the parking lot and drove their private car back to their home in Kowloon City District. On the way, the children dozed off in the car, while Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming chatted softly about their New Year plans. They arrived home around 8 a.m.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - from the Peak Tram Station to home in Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Family breakfast and New Year sharing
subevent.description: At 8:30 on the morning of January 1, Yu Xiaowei's family returned home. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had already prepared breakfast: Hong Kong-style milk tea, pineapple buns with butter, and fried eggs. The whole family sat around the table. Yu Xiaowei shared the wishes she had written on the Peak, and Zhang Weiming smiled and explained that the sentence he added was a hope that both of them could work at their own pace. The children also showed their drawings. After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei sent the photos to the family WeChat group.
subevent.location: Home dining room, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Resume regular breakfast adaptation training
description: As the November half marathon approached, the energy demands of high-intensity training exceeded what intermittent fasting could support. In early November, Yu Xiaowei decided to resume regular breakfasts, re-plan her pre- and post-workout nutrition, and flexibly adapt her health management to her athletic goals.

subevent.name: Assess training energy needs
subevent.description: After waking up on the morning of November 1, Yu Xiaowei, given the high-intensity demands of her half-marathon training plan, assessed the insufficient energy from her current intermittent fasting state, decided to resume a regular breakfast to provide enough calories, and considered adjusting her pre- and post-workout nutrition plan.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - home kitchen

subevent.name: Developing a breakfast and refueling plan
subevent.description: During her lunch break, Yu Xiaowei used her training schedule and nutrition knowledge to develop a new regular breakfast menu and pre-workout (such as banana, whole wheat bread) and post-workout (such as protein shake) nutrition plans, and recorded the plan in her phone memo.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - AIA Insurance office

subevent.name: Purchase new ingredients
subevent.description: After work, Yu Xiaowei went to the supermarket near her home and bought new ingredients according to the plan she had set, including whole wheat bread, oats, eggs, bananas, protein powder, etc., to prepare for starting the new diet plan the next day.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong - PARKnSHOP

name: Daughter's ballet class was suspended for two weeks because no one could take her. Her grandmother practiced ballet with her granddaughter at home.
description: During the ballet class suspension, starting April 15, maternal grandmother Chen Meiling came to Yu Xiaowei's home every afternoon, played ballet instructional videos, dressed her granddaughter Zhang Yuxin in colorful silk scarves, and led her through basic movements. Although Xinxin was a little disappointed, she was lifted by her grandmother's creativity and eagerly showed her mother new poses every evening. On April 28, Yu Xiaowei resumed normal work and took her daughter Zhang Yuxin back to resume the ballet class, thanking her mother for her efforts over the past two weeks. The suspension began on April 14 and ended on April 28.

subevent.name: Every day, Grandma guides ballet practice at home.
subevent.description: Starting April 15, every afternoon grandmother Chen Meiling came to Yu Xiaowei's home, played ballet teaching videos in the living room, and dressed her granddaughter Zhang Yuxin as a little swan with colorful silk scarves. She led her granddaughter through the basic movements step by step, including first-position arms, second-position arms, small jumps, and spins on tiptoe. Although Xinxin was a little disappointed at not being able to go to the studio, she was soon caught up in her grandmother's creativity and excitedly showed her mother the new poses every evening. The interaction between grandmother and granddaughter was warm. The practice lasted until April 27.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Resume picking up and dropping off for ballet class
subevent.description: On April 28, Yu Xiaowei resumed her normal work schedule. She left AIA early in the afternoon, drove to Wuyue Ballet Studio on Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City, and picked up her daughter Zhang Yuxin from class. Xinxin put on her proper ballet tutu and ballet shoes again and returned to the classroom to continue the course. Yu Xiaowei thanked her mother for her hard work over the past two weeks and informed her that the ballet class had resumed normally.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Wuyue Ballet Studio

name: At a gathering with her younger brother on the eve of Mid-Autumn Festival, he revealed that Zhou Minyi had taken away a major Shenzhen client. Yu Xiaowei was unable to sleep all night.
description: On October 4, her younger brother's family returned to Hong Kong from Shenzhen early for the Mid-Autumn Festival. During a restaurant dinner, her sister-in-law accidentally let it slip: "That big client Wang of yours in Shenzhen, seems he ended up signing with another company." Yu Xiaowei was shocked and pressed for details, only to find that it was the "interested" client Zhou Minyi had originally introduced. She held back her emotions and ended the gathering. That night she tossed and turned, realizing that Zhou Minyi had betrayed her trust, and felt a mix of anger and disappointment.

subevent.name: Went to the restaurant for dinner with my younger brother's family.
subevent.description: On October 4, the eve of the Mid-Autumn Festival, Yu Xiaowei brought her family (husband Zhang Weiming, son Zhang Zixuan, daughter Zhang Yuxin) to a Hong Kong-style restaurant in Kowloon City District ahead of time, waiting for her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng and his family, who were returning from Shenzhen to Hong Kong for the Mid-Autumn Festival. Yu Xiaowei was in a good mood and planned to enjoy a warm family dinner with her brother's family.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - a Hong Kong-style restaurant

subevent.name: During the dinner gathering, learned that a client had been robbed
subevent.description: During a family dinner at a restaurant, her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng and his wife Wang Lihua talked about work and life in Shenzhen. His wife accidentally let slip: “That big client of yours in Shenzhen, Wang So-and-so, seems to have ended up signing with someone else.” Yu Xiaowei was shocked and pressed for details, only to find that it was exactly the client Zhou Minyi had introduced to her back then. She held back the anger and disappointment inside her and remained polite on the surface, but her mood was clearly low.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - a Hong Kong-style restaurant

subevent.name: Sleepless all night reflecting on betrayal
subevent.description: That night, Yu Xiaowei tossed and turned in bed, replaying her sister-in-law's words at the dinner. She confirmed that Zhou Minyi had betrayed her trust and stolen the major client she had introduced. She felt betrayed by a trusted close friend, anger and disappointment intertwined, and she lay awake all night thinking about how to handle the relationship and future client maintenance.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - 328 Prince Edward Road West - Master Bedroom

name: Went to Shenzhen to attend the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao cross-border insurance business summit.
description: From June 22 to 25, Yu Xiaowei was recommended by her company to go to Shenzhen to attend the three-day Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao cross-border insurance business summit. On the 22nd, she prepared meeting materials at her home in Hong Kong, booked high-speed rail tickets, and confirmed the dinner arrangement with client Wang Qiming on the evening of the 23rd. On the 23rd, she arrived in Shenzhen, attended the summit, listened to interpretations of mainland regulatory policies, and participated in roundtable discussions. That evening she had dinner with Wang Qiming to learn about the insurance needs of Shenzhen entrepreneurs. On the 24th, she continued attending the summit, proactively exchanged ideas with peers, and met several potential partners. On the 25th, she rushed back to Hong Kong to provide renewal services for long-time client Mrs. Chen. Despite the tight schedule, she gained a more systematic understanding of cross-border business and strengthened her determination to secure company resources for this area in the future.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations
subevent.description: At home, Yu Xiaowei organized the materials for the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Cross-Border Insurance Business Summit, prepared enough business cards, booked high-speed rail tickets from Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Shenzhen North Station through a mobile app, confirmed the time and location of the June 23 dinner with client Wang Qiming in advance via WeChat, and planned her activity arrangements during the meeting.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home study

subevent.name: Attend the first-day agenda of the summit and have dinner with clients
subevent.description: On the morning of June 23, 2025, Yu Xiaowei arrived at the Shenzhen summit venue and listened carefully to the interpretation of mainland regulatory policies; in the afternoon she attended a roundtable discussion, actively exchanged business cards with other participants, and shared cross-border insurance business experience. That evening, she had dinner with client Wang Qiming at a boutique Cantonese restaurant in Nanshan District, Shenzhen, during which they discussed in depth the insurance needs of Shenzhen entrepreneurs and future cooperation opportunities.
subevent.location: Shenzhen - summit venue and Cantonese restaurant

subevent.name: Meeting partners the day after the summit.
subevent.description: On June 24, 2025, Yu Xiaowei continued attending the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Cross-Border Insurance Business Summit. During the main venue sessions and tea breaks, she proactively exchanged ideas with several insurance peers from the mainland and Hong Kong, swapped business cards, and held preliminary discussions on topics such as cross-border product cooperation and client resource sharing, getting to know several potential partners.
subevent.location: Shenzhen - summit venue.

subevent.name: Returned to Hong Kong and provided policy renewal services for long-standing clients
subevent.description: On the morning of June 25, 2025, Yu Xiaowei took the high-speed rail from Shenzhen back to Hong Kong. In the afternoon, she went to the home of her long-time client Chen Meiling (Mrs. Chen) in the Eastern District of Hong Kong Island to explain in detail the renewal terms, premium changes, and latest coverage of her family insurance policies, assisted her in completing the renewal procedures, and answered several coverage questions Mrs. Chen cared about, ensuring professional and attentive service.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - client's home

name: Try intermittent fasting.
description: After her colleague Su Lishan shared the benefits of intermittent fasting, Yu Xiaowei began learning about and trying the 16:8 eating method from August 3. On August 5, she officially set her daily eating window to 10:00-18:00, delaying breakfast and moving dinner earlier. She experienced mild hunger at first, gradually adapted after a week, and her evening snack intake decreased significantly.

subevent.name: Learn about intermittent fasting from a colleague
subevent.description: During a work break, her colleague Su Lishan shared with Yu Xiaowei the positive experience and benefits of trying 16:8 intermittent fasting. Yu Xiaowei became interested and decided to learn more and try it herself.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Wan Chai District - AIA Building office pantry

subevent.name: Officially start intermittent fasting
subevent.description: Starting August 5, Yu Xiaowei officially began the 16:8 intermittent fasting plan, setting her daily eating window from 10:00 to 18:00, postponing breakfast to 10 a.m., moving dinner earlier to 6 p.m., and recording how she felt on the first day.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Early fasting adaptation and adjustment (Days 1-6).
subevent.description: Starting from the first day of fasting (August 7), Yu Xiaowei experienced noticeable hunger, which she coped with by drinking water, distracting herself, and doing yoga. On the second day, the hunger eased; she diverted her attention through reading, walking, green tea, and planning runs. On the fourth day, her body gradually adapted, hunger significantly decreased, and she focused on work and family. By the sixth day, she had basically adjusted to the new rhythm, successfully resisted food temptations, politely declined sweet soup when visiting her mother-in-law, sorted out her reflections, and decided to resume eating the next day. Throughout the process, she adjusted her eating rhythm through various strategies, and her willpower grew stronger.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong - Home and Workplace

subevent.name: Dealing with Early-Stage Hunger During Fasting (Day 1)
subevent.description: On the first morning of the fast, Yu Xiaowei felt noticeably hungry after getting up. She first drank a glass of warm water to ease it, then went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast for her family without eating anything herself. In the morning at the office, while handling client insurance policies, she was distracted by hunger, so she distracted herself with unsweetened Hong Kong-style milk tea and chatting with her colleague Su Lishan. In the afternoon, the hunger weakened, but at dinner time, seeing her family eating made her feel hungry again. She chose to go to the balcony for 10 minutes of deep breathing and listen to music. Before bed, the hunger made it hard to fall asleep, so she did a set of light yoga stretches and finally fell asleep successfully.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong — home and AIA Building, Wan Chai District

subevent.name: Adjusting meal pace and managing hunger (Day 2).
subevent.description: On the morning of the second day of her fast, Yu Xiaowei woke up and felt less hungry than the previous day. After drinking water as usual, she tried to distract herself by doing household chores (tidying up clutter) while preparing breakfast for her family. During her commute to work, she read an article on Cantonese embroidery techniques on her phone while on the MTR. At lunch break, her colleagues had a group meal, but she declined, saying she was carrying out a health plan, and went alone to a park near the office for a 15-minute walk. In the afternoon, while working on a client proposal, the thought of snacking came to mind. She immediately got up, brewed a cup of unsweetened green tea, and contacted her running buddy Shen Peiwen to arrange a weekend run. After returning home in the evening, she took the initiative to help her son with his homework, avoiding food in the living room. Before going to bed, she felt only slight hunger and did a set of yoga to relax.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Kowloon City District - home and Wan Chai District office surroundings

subevent.name: Mid-adaptation period: hunger significantly reduced (day 4).
subevent.description: On the fourth day of fasting, Yu Xiaowei's body began to adapt to the new rhythm. When she got up in the morning, she only felt a slight sense of emptiness. She still drank only water, and after preparing breakfast for her family, she went to the balcony to take care of the pet cat and tidy her Yue embroidery frame. After arriving at work, she focused on organizing next week's client visit plan and worked efficiently until the lunch break. During lunch, she discussed quarterly goals with her superior Liang Zhenhua, drinking only plain water. In the afternoon, she handled two customer claim consultations, and hunger hardly appeared. On the evening commute, she lingered briefly at a pet shop on Prince Edward Road West to pick out a toy for the cat at home. After returning home, she painted with her daughter Zhang Yuxin and felt relaxed. Before bed, she did only a few simple stretches and fell asleep peacefully.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong — home and AIA Building, Wan Chai District

subevent.name: Consolidating adaptation results and self-reward (Day 6)
subevent.description: On the sixth day of fasting, Yu Xiaowei had basically adapted to her new eating rhythm. In the morning, after easily handling household chores, she went to the nearby vegetable market to buy ingredients for her family, picking only a few kinds of fruit for herself. In the morning she did a half-hour yoga practice at home, then finished her Cantonese embroidery homework and took photos to send to her teacher Wu Xiuying for feedback. At noon when the family ate, she sat at the dining table drinking lemon water and talked with her father Yu Guoqiang about marathon training plans, successfully resisting food temptation. In the afternoon, she took the children to visit her mother-in-law Li Shufen's home. Her mother-in-law prepared sweet soup, but she politely declined, saying she was following her eating plan, and only drank tea. After returning home in the evening, she organized her reflections on the week of fasting, felt her willpower had strengthened, and shared encouraging words without images on social media. Before bed, she decided to gradually resume eating the next day and planned out her refeeding menu.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - home and mother-in-law's home in Kwun Tong District

subevent.name: Maintain 16:8 fasting and track the results
subevent.description: After a week of adjustment, Yu Xiaowei has fully adapted to the 16:8 eating method, eating two to three meals between 10:00 and 18:00 each day and drinking only water the rest of the time. She has plenty of energy, no longer snacks at night, has lost a little weight, and her mental state has improved.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong - Home and Workplace

subevent.name: Day 1 of 16:8 fasting (Tuesday)
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei had breakfast at 10:00, drinking Hong Kong-style milk tea and eating a pineapple bun in the home kitchen; at 13:00 she ate wonton noodles as lunch at a cha chaan teng near the AIA office in Wan Chai; she finished dinner before 18:00, eating roast meat platter and vegetables at home with her family. She drank only water all day and had no extra snacks. In the evening she felt energetic, more relaxed than during the adaptation period, and her weight was 0.2 kg lower than the previous day.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong - home; and Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance office.

subevent.name: Day 4 of 16:8 fasting (Friday)
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei had breakfast at 10:00. Since it was her son Zhang Zixuan's birthday, she specially prepared his favorite French toast in the morning, pairing it with Hong Kong-style milk tea and a piece of fruit for herself. At 12:00 she ordered takeout with her team colleagues in the office, choosing roast goose lai fun. At 17:00 she went home early to prepare dinner, and before 18:00 she celebrated the birthday and had dinner with her family, including cake and Cantonese dishes. She ate nothing in the evening, felt physically energetic and mentally happy, and her weight continued to drop by 0.1 kg.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - home, and Wan Chai District - office

subevent.name: Day 6 of 16:8 fasting (Sunday)
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei had breakfast at 10:00, eating at home with her parents and children. She ordered wonton noodles with Hong Kong-style milk tea for herself. At 13:00 she went out with her husband to shop in Mong Kok and had an assorted roast meat platter and iced lemon tea at the food court in the mall. At 17:30 she returned home and had dinner with the whole family, finishing her meal before 18:00. She strictly followed the 16:8 principle all day, did yoga stretching in the evening, and felt light in her body, with her mental state significantly improved compared to a week ago. Summary of the week: she lost about 1 kg, her skin improved, and she had no discomfort.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Kowloon City District - home; and Mong Kok District - shopping mall

name: Passed the CFP investment planning exam, but didn't feel like celebrating
description: On November 2, Yu Xiaowei checked her results and learned that she had passed the CFP investment planning module exam. This was the result of long-term persistent study, but recent troubling matters — clients being taken away, her father's investment deadlock — weighed on her mind. She had no desire to celebrate and simply took a screenshot of the score report and saved it.

subevent.name: Log in to the CFP exam inquiry system
subevent.description: On the morning of November 2, 2025, Yu Xiaowei sat alone in front of her computer in the study of her home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong. She entered her candidate number and password for the CFP investment planning exam, logged in to the official score inquiry system, and prepared to check her exam results. She felt a little nervous because this was the test of the results of her long-term persistent study.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Check the results and pass the exam.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei clicked into the results page in the inquiry system and saw that her CFP investment planning module result was 'Pass'. She confirmed that all subjects had reached the passing line, marking the completion of the first-stage learning goal. But thinking of recent worries such as clients being poached and her father's investment deadlock, she did not smile and just silently stared at the screen for a few seconds.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Took a screenshot of the score and decided not to celebrate
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei used her phone to photograph the score page on the computer screen and also took a screenshot, saving it to her phone's album for future reference. She would normally have invited friends or family to celebrate, but recent work and family pressure left her with no interest. She closed the computer, took a deep breath, and decided to go to work as usual to handle client matters, keeping the news of passing the exam to herself for now.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

name: Huang Wenhui's Birthday Video Dispels a Best Friend's Suspicions
description: On November 3, Huang Wenhui's birthday, Yu Xiaowei prepared in advance at home for a WeChat video call, thinking about how to start the conversation to dispel the doubts caused by a conversation she had accidentally overheard in Shenzhen earlier. She then proactively initiated the video call, wished Huang Wenhui a happy birthday, and frankly mentioned her concerns. Huang Wenhui explained that she had been discussing family investment matters with Zhou Minyi at the time and that there was nothing hidden. The two communicated openly, and the suspicions dissipated. At the end of the call, they agreed to meet in Shenzhen next month. Yu Xiaowei added a memo in her phone calendar and sent a birthday red packet.

subevent.name: Preparing for a video call with Huang Wenhui
subevent.description: On November 3, Huang Wenhui's birthday, Yu Xiaowei was in the living room at home. She took out her phone and thought about how to start the conversation. Recalling the conversation she had accidentally overheard in Shenzhen earlier, she decided to communicate honestly to clear up doubts. She adjusted the camera and network in advance and waited for the right moment to initiate a video call.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Had a frank video call with Huang Wenhui.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei proactively initiated a video call with Huang Wenhui via WeChat, first congratulating her on her birthday, then candidly mentioning the conversation she had inadvertently overheard in Shenzhen earlier and the doubts it had raised in her. Huang Wenhui patiently explained that she had been discussing family investment matters with Zhou Minyi at the time, and there was no hidden agenda. The two communicated openly and honestly, dispelling Yu Xiaowei's suspicions, and their relationship returned to its former state.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Arranged to meet in Shenzhen next month and noted it in the schedule.
subevent.description: At the end of the video call, Yu Xiaowei and Huang Wenhui agreed to meet in Shenzhen next month, with the exact time to be coordinated between them. After the call, Yu Xiaowei added a memo to her phone calendar: "Plan to go to Shenzhen in December to see Huang Wenhui," feeling happy and relaxed, and sent Huang Wenhui a birthday red packet.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home bedroom

name: Lin Jiaxin passed the insurance intermediary exam on her own and did not seek celebration. Yu Xiaowei liked the post and reflected on her possessiveness.
description: On October 15, Lin Jiaxin posted her insurance intermediary qualification exam score report in the close friends group with the caption "I did it on my own," but did not privately message Yu Xiaowei to invite her to celebrate. Yu Xiaowei was startled for a moment, silently gave a like, and felt a wave of disappointment, then immediately reflected on herself: "This is my possessiveness acting up, isn't it?" She realized Jiaxin was moving toward independence, and their relationship was quietly changing.

subevent.name: Saw the news that Lin Jiaxin passed the exam.
subevent.description: On October 15, 2025, Yu Xiaowei was resting at her desk in the AIA office in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, when she opened her phone to check WhatsApp group messages and saw her best friend Lin Jiaxin posting her insurance intermediary qualification exam score report in their best friends group, with the caption 'Achieved it on my own.' Yu Xiaowei froze for a moment when she saw it, and a wave of disappointment welled up inside her.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Liked Lin Jiaxin's grades.
subevent.description: After her disappointment, Yu Xiaowei quickly adjusted her emotions and liked the message about Lin Jiaxin's report card in the close-friends group, as a gesture of encouragement and recognition. Simple as the like was, it could not hide the complicated feelings inside her.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Self-reflection on possessiveness
subevent.description: After liking the post, Yu Xiaowei sat alone in her office seat and began to reflect on her emotional fluctuation. She realized that her feeling of loss came from "possessiveness" — she had expected Lin Jiaxin to privately share the joy with her first, but Lin Jiaxin had chosen to announce it publicly in the group chat rather than tell her alone. She reproached herself: "It's my possessiveness at play, I suppose." And she realized that Lin Jiaxin was moving toward independence, and their relationship was quietly changing.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: She had a long video chat with Zhou Minyi, during which Zhou "casually" mentioned high-end clients in Shenzhen and proactively offered to make an introduction. After the call, she recorded the lead.

She then said eagerly, 'I can try to make an introduction for you. With your professionalism, the client will surely trust you.' Yu Xiaowei thanked her sincerely, not noticing the calculation behind her smile. After the call, Yu Xiaowei briefly wrote down the client's information in her notebook and planned to follow up.

name: Completed client visits and policy renewal signings for Hong Kong high-net-worth clients.
description: From September 9 to 12, 2025, according to her monthly plan, Yu Xiaowei visited two local high-net-worth clients, Chen Meiling (a homemaker) and Wang Qiming (CTO of a technology company), in succession. For Chen Meiling, she completed the annual review of her family insurance policies and recommended a new savings insurance plan for her children's education planning, and Chen Meiling signed on the spot. For Wang Qiming, she introduced the latest cross-border high-end medical insurance plan, and Wang Qiming said he would consider arranging it for the senior executives on his team. These visits strengthened the foundation of her local business in Hong Kong and eased her supervisor Liang Zhenhua's concerns about her focusing too much on clients in Shenzhen.

subevent.name: Visit client Chen Meiling and complete the renewal contract signing.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei went to the home of her client Chen Meiling at Taikoo Shing, Golden Palace Terrace, Eastern District, Hong Kong at the agreed time. She first gave Chen Meiling a detailed explanation of the annual returns and coverage changes of all the family's policies. Then, in light of the future overseas education plans of Chen Meiling's children, she recommended a new high-return savings insurance product. Through comparative illustrations and patient answers, Yu Xiaowei gained Chen Meiling's approval, and on the spot helped her fill out and sign the insurance application form and related documents, completing the on-site signing. The entire visit lasted about two hours and the atmosphere was pleasant.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Eastern District, Taikoo Shing, King's Terrace, at client Chen Meiling's home.

subevent.name: Visited client Wang Qiming to introduce cross-border medical insurance
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei went to a quiet café in Central to meet with client Wang Qiming, who was in Hong Kong on business. She gave Wang Qiming a detailed introduction to AIA's latest cross-border high-end medical insurance plan, highlighting its direct billing services at top hospitals in Hong Kong, the mainland, and overseas, its expert appointment channel, and group enrollment discounts. Wang Qiming said the plan met the protection needs of his company's executives, but he needed to discuss the budget and headcount with his partners, and promised to give a clear reply within a week. After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei sent Wang Qiming the electronic version of the product materials.
subevent.location: A café in Central, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Organized the contract signing documents and followed up with Wang Qiming
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the AIA Hong Kong office on Gloucester Road in Wan Chai District, submitted the insurance application signed by Chen Meiling to the company's underwriting department, and entered it into the client's electronic file. At the same time, based on her communication with Wang Qiming, she prepared a customized team insurance proposal and sent it to Wang Qiming in a follow-up email, attaching specific case examples and answers to frequently asked questions to encourage him to make a decision as soon as possible.
subevent.location: AIA Building office, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Report the results of the visit to the supervisor
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei proactively approached her superior Liang Zhenhua and reported in the office the results of visiting two high-net-worth clients this week. She showed Chen Meiling's newly signed contract and explained Wang Qiming's high-intent feedback and follow-up plan. Yu Xiaowei took the opportunity to express her determination to deeply cultivate Hong Kong's local business, effectively easing Liang Zhenhua's previous concern that she focused too much on Shenzhen clients. Liang Zhenhua affirmed her execution ability and encouraged her to continue maintaining good local client relationships.
subevent.location: AIA Building office, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Huang Wenhui comforted her over video, a best friend's long-distance warmth.
description: On the evening of October 14, her close friend Huang Wenhui called via video from Shenzhen. It turned out she had learned from Lin Jiaxin that Yu Xiaowei had been feeling down lately. Huang Wenhui rationally analyzed Zhou Minyi's character and advised Yu Xiaowei to focus her energy on existing clients and family, and she also shared her own experience of turning things around after having a deal poached at work. She encouraged Yu Xiaowei: “Your greatest weapons are your sincerity and professionalism, not those tricks.” The call lasted more than an hour. Yu Xiaowei's mindset improved, and they agreed that she would go to Shenzhen to have tea with her after the Guangzhou Marathon at the end of the month.

Yu Xiaowei answered the call at her home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong. Huang Wenhui first asked with concern how she was doing, then rationally analyzed Zhou Minyi's character (another friend of Yu Xiaowei's), and suggested that she focus her energy on existing clients and family. Huang Wenhui also shared her personal experience of having a client snatched away at work and turning the situation around through sincerity and professionalism, encouraging Yu Xiaowei to stay confident. The call lasted about an hour, and Yu Xiaowei's mood clearly improved. During the call, they also agreed that after the Guangzhou Marathon at the end of the month, Yu Xiaowei would go to Shenzhen to have tea with Huang Wenhui.
subevent.location: Shenzhen - Nanshan District - Huang Wenhui's home

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowei composed herself after the video call.

She sat alone for a while, savoring Huang Wenhui's encouragement, and decided to adjust her mindset and channel her energy back into work, family, and the upcoming Guangzhou Marathon training. She also briefly noted the key points of the call in her diary and her plan to go to Shenzhen to see Huang Wenhui at the end of the month.

description: Over the weekend, Yu Xiaowei went home to visit her parents, bringing a Chilean red wine purchased from a wine-tasting workshop to share a few drinks with her father Yu Guoqiang. During the meal, she proactively brought up recent work updates. Although her father was still upset about the last investment being rejected, the alcohol helped ease the tension, and her mother also helped smooth things over, creating a turning point in the father-daughter relationship. After dinner, her father rarely asked about her marathon training, making her feel a long-missed sense of care.

subevent.name: Bring red wine home
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei took out a Chilean red wine she had bought at the wine tasting workshop, planning to share a few glasses with her father over dinner with her parents that evening to ease the earlier conflict over investment issues.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Have dinner with parents and taste wine
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and her parents sat around the dining table at home for dinner. She took the initiative to open a bottle of red wine and poured a glass for her father, Yu Guoqiang. During the meal, she talked about her recent work performance and clients. Although her father still grumbled about the investment rejection last time, with the alcohol and her mother Chen Meiling smoothing things over, the atmosphere gradually became relaxed.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: After dinner, father and daughter had an in-depth conversation.
subevent.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei and her father Yu Guoqiang continued to enjoy wine and chat in the living room. Her father took the initiative to ask about her recent marathon training. Yu Xiaowei shared her preparation plan and performance goals. Her father expressed concern and support, and the father-daughter relationship took a positive turn.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

name: Experiencing radiofrequency skin-tightening treatment
description: On October 24, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan went to a medical aesthetics center in Causeway Bay for radio-frequency skin-tightening treatment. After examining her skin, the beautician performed the treatment for about an hour, and when it was done, her skin was firm and glowing. When she got home, her husband joked asking whether she had been replaced by someone else, and she proudly showed it off. This experience was an investment in herself and a way to relax amid her high-pressure life.

subevent.name: Go to the medical aesthetics center.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 24, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan set out from their respective homes, met at Causeway Bay MTR station, and walked to the Causeway Bay Medical Aesthetic Centre to receive radiofrequency skin-tightening treatment.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Causeway Bay - streets and medical beauty center

subevent.name: Undergoing radiofrequency skin-tightening treatment
subevent.description: In a treatment room at Causeway Bay Medical Aesthetics Centre, the professional beautician first used a skin analyzer to check Yu Xiaowei's skin condition and assess her skin type and degree of aging, then performed about one hour of radiofrequency skin-tightening treatment. During the procedure, Yu Xiaowei felt warm and comfortable; after it ended, her facial skin appeared tight and radiant.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Causeway Bay - Medical Aesthetics Center Treatment Room

subevent.name: Returned home and showed the family the result.
subevent.description: That evening, Yu Xiaowei returned to her home in Kowloon City District. Her husband Zhang Weiming noticed the change in her face and jokingly asked if she had been replaced by someone else. Yu Xiaowei proudly showed off her firm and glowing skin and shared with her husband the experience of the radiofrequency treatment and the package she had purchased, earning his encouragement and praise.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

name: The whole family pitched in to support their daughter's ballet competition
description: On the evening of November 6, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming, together with their son Zhang Zixuan, helped their daughter Zhang Yuxin pack for the Guangzhou ballet competition, in the living room of their home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong. Their son helped check the dance shoes, her husband packed the thermos and snacks, and her mother Chen Meiling gave reminders. The family sat together in the living room, and the daughter excitedly showed off her newly learned spin. Yu Xiaowei recorded a video with her phone, saying she would send it to her grandmother. The warm pre-competition encouragement boosted the daughter's confidence and strengthened family cohesion.

subevent.name: Family gathers for pre-race preparations.
subevent.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowei, her husband Zhang Weiming, son Zhang Zixuan, daughter Zhang Yuxin, and mother Chen Meiling gathered in the living room of their home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, and began packing for Zhang Yuxin's ballet competition in Guangzhou. The family sat around the sofa in the living room and spread the suitcases on the floor, creating a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Son checks dance shoes; husband packs snacks
subevent.description: Zhang Zixuan squatted on the floor and carefully checked Zhang Yuxin's ballet shoes to make sure there was no wear or looseness. Meanwhile, Zhang Weiming loaded the thermos and snacks he had brought from the kitchen into the side pocket of the suitcase, confirming there was enough water and that Zhang Yuxin's favorite cookies were packed. Chen Meiling sat to one side watching and occasionally interjecting reminders.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Mother Reminds About Competition Precautions
subevent.description: Chen Meiling patiently reminded her daughter Zhang Yuxin about the things to note for the competition, including not being nervous on stage, following instructions, and warming up before the event. Zhang Yuxin nodded seriously in response, while Yu Xiaowei listened with a smile nearby. The family atmosphere was harmonious.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Daughter demonstrating spin moves and recording a video
subevent.description: Zhang Yuxin excitedly showed off her newly learned ballet pirouette in the middle of the living room, with graceful posture. Yu Xiaowei took out her phone and recorded the video, saying as she recorded that she would send it to Grandma. Zhang Weiming and Zhang Zixuan applauded and cheered, and the family atmosphere was lively and warm.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Started the initial draft of the Shenzhen customer win-back plan.
description: After work on November 28, Yu Xiaowei stayed at her desk to work overtime, drawing up a detailed win-back plan for the Shenzhen clients previously taken by competitors. She categorized the clients into three types: those dissatisfied with service, those lost through price comparison, and those whose needs were not met, and drafted follow-up scripts and discount plans for each. She planned to visit three key clients in Shenzhen in person in the middle of next month, and asked her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng to help arrange dinner invitations. After writing the plan, she took a photo and sent it to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua for feedback, and received a prompt reply.

subevent.name: Work overtime to devise a client win-back plan.
subevent.description: After work on November 28, 2025, Yu Xiaowei stayed at her desk in the AIA Building at 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, to work overtime. In response to the list of Shenzhen clients previously taken away by competitors, she began to formulate a detailed framework for a win-back plan.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Analyze customer types and develop sales scripts and promotional plans.
subevent.description: At her workstation, Yu Xiaowei carefully analyzed the Shenzhen client list and categorized clients into three types: those dissatisfied with service, those lost due to price comparison, and those whose needs were unmet. She drafted follow-up scripts and discount plans for each type's characteristics, forming a complete written plan.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Contact her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng to ask for help arranging a dinner gathering.
subevent.description: While making her plan, Yu Xiaowei contacted her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng, who works at Tencent in Shenzhen, via WeChat voice message. She explained that she planned to visit three key clients in Shenzhen in the middle of next month and asked Yu Xiaofeng to help arrange a dinner gathering so she could communicate with the clients in depth in a relaxed setting. Yu Xiaofeng said he was willing to help and initially confirmed the time he could coordinate.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Take a photo of the plan and send it to my supervisor, Liang Zhenhua.
subevent.description: After completing the draft plan, Yu Xiaowei used her phone to take photos of the paper plan document and convert it into images. She sent it to regional sales director Liang Zhenhua through the company’s internal communication software, attaching a text briefly explaining the core content of the plan and the planned visit in the middle of next month, and asked her supervisor for guidance.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Receive and review Liang Zhenhua's written instruction
subevent.description: Shortly after sending the plan, Yu Xiaowei received a timely reply from her superior Liang Zhenhua. Liang Zhenhua expressed approval of the plan via a messaging app and suggested fine-tuning adjustments to some customer follow-up strategies. Yu Xiaowei immediately recorded the key points of his response at her desk, confirmed that she would optimize the plan according to the suggestions, and then formally executed it.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went to watch daughter's ballet performance and was moved to tears
description: On the afternoon of December 20, Yu Xiaowei brought the Cantonese-embroidered handkerchief she had embroidered herself and set off from home to the Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten Hall to watch her daughter Zhang Yuxin's year-end ballet performance. Although her daughter was not the lead dancer, she performed with great dedication and seriousness. Yu Xiaowei was deeply moved and could not help wiping away tears with the Cantonese-embroidered handkerchief, her heart full of pride and relief.

subevent.name: Going to the venue of her daughter's ballet performance
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowei set out from her home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, carrying a Cantonese-embroidered handkerchief she had made herself, and walked or took a ride to the hall of Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten, ready to watch her daughter Zhang Yuxin's year-end ballet performance. She deliberately arrived early to get a good seat and cheer her daughter on.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten Hall

subevent.name: Watched her daughter's ballet performance and was moved to tears.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei sat in the audience, watching her daughter Zhang Yuxin's year-end ballet performance with focus. Although her daughter was not the lead dancer, she performed with commitment and serious movements. Yu Xiaowei was deeply moved by her daughter's concentration and joy. She took out the Cantonese-embroidered handkerchief she had made herself to wipe her tears of emotion, feeling proud and warm inside.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten Hall

name: Family party for daughter's fifth birthday, personally presenting a Cantonese embroidery ornament
description: Sunday, March 9. Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming held a small birthday party at home for their daughter, inviting only close relatives. Yu Xiaowei gave her a Cantonese embroidery pendant themed on the daughter's zodiac sign, which had taken two weeks to embroider. The daughter happily hung it on her schoolbag. The party was warm; her mother-in-law helped prepare traditional red eggs, and her son sang “Happy Birthday” to his younger sister. The family atmosphere was harmonious.

subevent.name: Decorate the living room and set up party decorations
subevent.description: On the morning of March 9, 2025, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming hung balloons, ribbons, and a Happy Birthday banner together in the living room of their home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, to create a warm atmosphere for their daughter Zhang Yuxin's fifth birthday party. Their son Zhang Zixuan also helped pass decorations, and the whole family was joyful.
subevent.location: Home living room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Mother-in-law prepares traditional red eggs and birthday meal
subevent.description: On the morning of March 9, 2025, Yu Xiaowei's mother-in-law Li Shufen came from Kwun Tong District to the home in Kowloon City District, boiled red eggs in the kitchen using the traditional method, and helped prepare the birthday lunch. She used edible red food coloring to dye the eggs red, symbolizing festivity and good fortune, and also cooked dishes that her daughter Zhang Yuxin liked. Yu Xiaowei's mother Chen Meiling also helped nearby by sorting the dishes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - 328 Prince Edward Road West, home kitchen

subevent.name: Birthday party key moments: singing the birthday song and cutting the cake.
subevent.description: At noon on March 9, 2025, the whole family gathered around the dining table in the living room. After lighting the birthday candles, son Zhang Zixuan took the lead in singing the birthday song for his younger sister Zhang Yuxin, with Yu Xiaowei, Zhang Weiming, Chen Meiling, Li Shufen, and Yu Guoqiang (her father) joining in. Zhang Yuxin happily made a wish and blew out the candles, then cut the cake with her mother. Everyone shared the cake and the red eggs prepared by grandmother.
subevent.location: Home living room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowei personally gave a Cantonese embroidery hanging ornament
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 9, 2025, during the birthday party, Yu Xiaowei brought out a Cantonese embroidery pendant she had spent two weeks carefully stitching, themed on her daughter Zhang Yuxin's zodiac sign (the Dog). The stitching was delicate and the design vivid. She gave the pendant to her daughter with her own hands and told her it was made stitch by stitch by Mom. Zhang Yuxin loved it and immediately hung it on her little schoolbag, unable to put it down.
subevent.location: Home living room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Take a family photo to commemorate
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 9, 2025, Yu Xiaowei took photos of her family with her phone. First, she took individual photos of her daughter Zhang Yuxin, recording her adorable look as she carried a schoolbag with a Cantonese embroidery pendant. Then the whole family posed for a group photo in front of the living room backdrop, including Yu Xiaowei, Zhang Weiming, Zhang Zixuan, Zhang Yuxin, Chen Meiling, Yu Guoqiang, and Li Shufen. Everyone smiled brightly, capturing a warm moment.
subevent.location: Home living room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Family birthday dinner get-together.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 9, 2025, Yu Xiaowei sat around the dining table with her family, enjoying a hearty dinner prepared by her mother-in-law and her own mother. The table was filled with her daughter's favorite dishes and red eggs. Everyone ate and chatted, reminiscing about Zhang Yuxin's growing-up moments. Her husband Zhang Weiming poured drinks for everyone and raised a toast wishing their daughter health and happiness. The dinner had a warm and harmonious atmosphere and lasted about an hour.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home dining room, 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: Short family trip to Macau
description: From August 4 to 6, Yu Xiaowei took her family by boat to Macau for her mid-year vacation. They stayed at a family hotel in Cotai and visited the Ruins of St. Paul's, the Macau Museum, and the Venetian Macao, tasting authentic Portuguese egg tarts and pork chop buns. Her son was thrilled by the Grand Prix Museum, while her daughter danced her own impromptu ballet by the canals of the Venetian. Yu Xiaowei and her husband had a rare chat on the hotel balcony overlooking the night view. She remarked that it had been a long time since she felt such pure relaxation and secretly resolved to make an in-depth Japan trip happen next year. Though the trip was short, it recharged and energized her for the busy second half of the year.

subevent.name: Pre-trip preparation
subevent.description: On the night before departure, Yu Xiaowei packed luggage for the whole family of four with her husband Zhang Weiming, including sunscreen, swimsuits, change of clothes, and common medicines for the children. She confirmed the ferry tickets and hotel reservation on her phone, and notified her mother Chen Meiling in the family group chat to help take care of the pet cat at home. In the meantime, she planned a rough three-day itinerary to ensure both the adults' and children's interests were covered.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Arrive in Macau by ferry and check into the hotel
subevent.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowei's family departed from the Hong Kong-Macau Ferry Terminal on a TurboJET to the Macau Taipa Ferry Terminal. The voyage took about 1 hour. After arriving, they took the hotel shuttle bus to the Galaxy Hotel in Cotai (family-themed floor). After checking in, the whole family played in the hotel's children's pool and playroom. In the evening, the group walked to The Venetian Macao, strolled along the canal, and her daughter Zhang Yuxin improvised a self-choreographed ballet by the canal, drawing praise from tourists. At night, the family tasted authentic Portuguese egg tarts and pork chop buns in the Venetian's food court. After returning to the hotel, Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming sat on the balcony drinking coffee, looking at the night view and chatting, enjoying their rare time together.
subevent.location: Macao Special Administrative Region - Galaxy Hotel, Cotai and The Venetian Macao Resort

subevent.name: Macau Peninsula cultural exploration
subevent.description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei's family took a taxi to the Macau Peninsula. First, they visited the Ruins of St. Paul's and took a group photo in front of the facade. Then they entered the adjacent Museum of Sacred Art and Crypt. Next, they walked to the nearby Macao Museum to learn about Macau's history. At noon, they had a meal at a tea restaurant near Rua do Cunha, tasting authentic pork chop buns and wonton noodles. In the afternoon, at the attraction her son Zhang Zixuan had most looked forward to—the Grand Prix Museum—Yu Xiaowei accompanied him to try the racing simulator inside, and both father and son were thrilled. In the evening, they returned to the Cotai hotel to rest.
subevent.location: Macao Special Administrative Region - Ruins of St. Paul's, Macao Museum, Macao Grand Prix Museum

subevent.name: Free time and return trip
subevent.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowei's family enjoyed the last half day of free time at the hotel. Zhang Weiming took their son to the hotel's water park to play, while Yu Xiaowei accompanied their daughter to the hotel craft workshop to make balloon animals. After checking out at noon, they left their luggage and went to the Venetian Macao shopping mall, where they bought Portuguese egg tarts and souvenirs. At 3 p.m., they took the hotel shuttle bus to Taipa Ferry Terminal and took a ferry back to Hong Kong. They arrived at their Hong Kong home in the evening. As she was organizing the photos, Yu Xiaowei remarked that this had been a recharging trip and secretly resolved to complete an in-depth tour of Japan next year. The trip ended perfectly.
subevent.location: Macao Special Administrative Region - Galaxy Hotel in Cotai and The Venetian Macao shopping center

name: Start a health management plan after the annual physical examination
description: On December 27, Yu Xiaowei had her annual check-up at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital. Her family doctor, Zhou Wenbin, pointed out that long-term stress and sleep deprivation had led to elevated cortisol and early symptoms of excessive stomach acid. He advised reducing caffeine, increasing aerobic exercise, and getting 7 hours of sleep. Yu Xiaowei immediately drafted a health improvement checklist, resolving to systematically adjust her diet, exercise, and daily routine. Afterwards, she bought healthy ingredients on the way home and organized her exercise gear, officially starting her health management plan the next day.

subevent.name: Go to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital for the annual physical examination
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei went to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital as scheduled for her annual health check-up, including routine blood tests, blood pressure, electrocardiogram, and other items, lasting about two hours in total.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital

subevent.name: Discuss physical exam results with the family doctor
subevent.description: After the physical exam, Yu Xiaowei had a one-on-one consultation with family doctor Zhou Wenbin in the consultation room about the physical examination report. Dr. Zhou said that her cortisol was elevated due to long-term high stress and insufficient sleep, and that she had early symptoms of excessive stomach acid. He advised reducing caffeine, increasing aerobic exercise, and ensuring 7 hours of sleep.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital consulting room

subevent.name: Drafted a health improvement checklist
subevent.description: After listening to the doctor's advice, Yu Xiaowei drafted a health improvement checklist on her phone in the consultation room and on the way home, including: reduce coffee to one cup a day, have dinner before 7 p.m., run in the morning or do yoga three times a week, go to sleep before 11 p.m. every night, and set phone reminders.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital and journey

subevent.name: Prepare healthy meals and exercise equipment
subevent.description: After returning home from Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, Yu Xiaowei stopped by a nearby supermarket on the way to buy healthy ingredients such as whole wheat bread, oatmeal, fresh vegetables and fruit, and laid out her yoga mat and running shoes in preparation for the health plan starting the next day.
subevent.location: Supermarket and home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Officially launched the health management plan
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei began following the health improvement checklist she had made the day before: she replaced the pineapple bun with oatmeal for breakfast, drank only one cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea at noon, left work early to go home for a 30-minute yoga session, and went to bed before 11 p.m.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Home and Office

name: Received the first commission and performance bonus for September.
description: On September 5, 2025, Yu Xiaowei received at the company the notice of her first commission payment for September and the performance bonus for signing a high-end medical insurance policy in Shenzhen, totaling about HK$58,000. After confirming the receipt through the bank app, she transferred HK$30,000 of it into the family savings account and planned the remaining funds: HK$20,000 reserved as dedicated expenses for her children's ballet and extracurricular classes, and HK$8,000 as personal spending and a budget for updating training equipment.

subevent.name: Received notice from the company about commission and bonus payment
subevent.description: On September 5, 2025, during the day, Yu Xiaowei was in her office at AIA Hong Kong in the AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District. When she opened the company's internal system, she saw the Finance Department's notice about the release of September's first commission and Shenzhen high-end medical insurance performance bonus, confirming total income of about HK$58,000. She then used the banking app on her phone to check the actual amount received.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

subevent.name: Transfer 30,000 yuan to the family savings account.
subevent.description: After confirming the money arrived, Yu Xiaowei used the same banking app to transfer 30,000 Hong Kong dollars from her personal account to the family savings account she shared with her husband Zhang Weiming, for daily household expenses and future savings. After the transfer, she took a screenshot and saved the transaction record.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Plan special expenses for children and personal budget
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei recorded the allocation of the remaining funds in her phone memo: 20,000 Hong Kong dollars were reserved as special expenses for her daughter Zhang Yuxin's ballet lessons and her son Zhang Zixuan's extracurricular classes, and 8,000 Hong Kong dollars were set aside as her personal spending for the month and as a budget for updating running training gear (such as running shoes and sports watches). She then told her husband Zhang Weiming about this plan, and the two confirmed the family financial arrangements.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home bedroom

name: Arranged to meet Zhou Minyi to confront her about the client being poached; the superficially harmonious relationship broke down.
description: On December 15, Yu Xiaowei proactively invited Zhou Minyi for coffee and directly asked whether she knew that Manager Wang later signed with another company. Zhou Minyi's expression changed slightly, and she argued that the client had compared several options and she couldn't control it. Yu Xiaowei did not pry further, but both knew that the trust was broken. When Zhou Minyi left, she quietly said that it was not her intention, but Yu Xiaowei did not turn around. Afterward, the two maintained surface harmony, but their interactions decreased sharply.

subevent.name: Arrange to meet Zhou Minyi.
subevent.description: On the morning of December 15, Yu Xiaowei sent a message to Zhou Minyi via WeChat, inviting her to meet at a café near Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City District at 3 p.m., using the excuse that she wanted to catch up. Zhou Minyi replied and agreed.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home (Yu Xiaowei's home)

subevent.name: Went to the agreed-upon coffee shop
subevent.description: At 2:40 p.m., Yu Xiaowei left home and walked to Pacific Coffee on Prince Edward Road West. She arrived early and chose a window seat. She ordered two cups of Hong Kong-style milk tea and then waited for Zhou Minyi to arrive.
