name: Reflecting on the balcony at home on New Year's Eve, and posting on Moments to look forward to the new year.
description: On the evening of December 31, Yu Xiaowei turned down all parties and sat quietly with her husband on the balcony of their home on Prince Edward Road West, each drinking hot milk. She browsed the photos on her phone and saw clumsy pictures of herself learning to make coffee at the beginning of the year, and sighed, 'This year has felt like three years.' When the midnight bell rang, she sent herself a WeChat message: '2026: full marathon, craft exhibition, Japan trip, and less sadness.' Among the unread group messages, Zhou Minyi had sent a New Year's greeting animation, but she did not open it. She then posted an old photo of a dessert shop on her Moments with the caption, 'There are sweet and bitter moments; I'll keep running next year,' and received a like and a blowing kiss from her running friend Shen Peiwen in Shanghai.

subevent.name: Sitting quietly with her husband on the balcony, drinking hot milk
subevent.description: On the evening of December 31, 2025, Yu Xiaowei turned down all parties and sat quietly with her husband Zhang Weiming on the balcony of their home on Prince Edward Road West, each drinking a glass of hot milk, enjoying the peaceful moment of New Year's Eve.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - balcony of home, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Look through the phone album and reflect on the year.
subevent.description: While sitting quietly on the balcony, Yu Xiaowei browsed through her phone album and saw clumsy photos of herself learning to brew coffee at the beginning of the year. She sighed that this year felt like three years, and her heart was full of reflection on the past year.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - balcony of home, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District

subevent.name: After the midnight bell, write down New Year goals.
subevent.description: When the clock struck midnight on New Year's Eve, Yu Xiaowei opened WeChat and sent a message to herself, writing down three goals for 2026: complete a full marathon, hold a Cantonese embroidery craft exhibition, take her family on an in-depth trip to Japan, and tell herself to be less sad.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - balcony of home, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District

Based on Mrs. Chen's conservative needs, she recommended a savings plan with additional medical insurance and signed the policy on the spot. Mrs. Chen was very satisfied, praised her as the "most trustworthy advisor," and immediately referred a neighbor friend. The next day, Yu Xiaowei called this potential client from her Wan Chai office and scheduled a visit. This service strengthened her professional reputation and reinforced her career conviction.

name: Yu Xiaowei consulted on and finalized a wealth management plan for the family's idle funds.
description: From September 25 to 26, 2025, Yu Xiaowei carried out financial planning to optimize the family's asset allocation, targeting approximately HK$300,000 in idle funds. On the morning of the 25th, she organized the family's financial documents. During her lunch break, she called Li Guodong, senior manager at HSBC, for advice, and received recommendations for two conservative wealth management products. That evening, after discussing with her husband Zhang Weiming, they decided to invest HK$200,000 in a principal-guaranteed structured deposit and HK$100,000 in a short-term bond fund. On the morning of the 26th, Yu Xiaowei called Li Guodong again to confirm the plan and made an appointment to sign the contract at the branch on October 8.

subevent.name: Organize family financial records
subevent.description: On the morning of September 25, 2025, Yu Xiaowei sorted out the details of the family's idle funds and recent income and expense records in her home study, listed about HK$300,000 in available funds, and noted current bank deposit rates and past wealth management history, planning to consult a bank wealth manager during her lunch break about conservative wealth management products.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home study

subevent.name: Phone consultation with Li Guodong
subevent.description: During the lunch break on September 25, 2025 (around 12:30), Yu Xiaowei called Li Guodong, senior manager of the Wealth Management Department at HSBC, from her desk at the Hong Kong office of AIA Insurance on her mobile phone, to consult about a conservative wealth management plan for 300,000 Hong Kong dollars of idle family funds. Li Guodong recommended a short-term bond fund with an annualized return of 3.2% and a two-year capital-protected structured deposit. Yu Xiaowei carefully noted details such as the risk levels, minimum investment amounts, and redemption rules of the two products, and made an appointment to go to HSBC's Central Branch after the National Day holiday (October 8, 2025) to sign the agreement. The call lasted about 25 minutes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

subevent.name: Discuss the financial plan with her husband.
subevent.description: At around 20:00 on the evening of September 25, 2025, Yu Xiaowei discussed the two wealth management products she had consulted about that morning with her husband Zhang Weiming in the living room at home. She explained in detail the differences in returns and risks between the short-term bond fund and the principal-protected structured deposit, and asked for her husband's opinion. Zhang Weiming suggested choosing the safer principal-protected structured deposit, but Yu Xiaowei preferred the short-term bond fund to maintain liquidity. After about 30 minutes of discussion, they decided to invest part of the funds (200,000 Hong Kong dollars) in the structured deposit and the remaining 100,000 Hong Kong dollars in the short-term bond fund, planning to confirm the final ratio when signing the contract.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - living room at home

subevent.name: Notify the wealth manager and confirm the signing time
subevent.description: On the morning of September 26, 2025, Yu Xiaowei called Li Guodong again from the AIA insurance office to inform him of the family's decision after discussion: to buy a HKD 100,000 short-term bond fund and a HKD 200,000 capital-protected structured deposit. Both parties confirmed meeting at the HSBC Central Branch at 14:00 on the afternoon of the first working day after the National Day holiday (October 8, 2025) to sign the agreement, and reminded Yu Xiaowei to bring her ID card, bank card, and proof of funds documents. After the call, Yu Xiaowei set a reminder on her calendar.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

Yu Xiaowei took out Christmas decorations and colorful lights purchased years ago. The children excitedly hung stars and baubles, while her mother placed homemade gingerbread men nearby. The whole family took photos in front of the Christmas tree, and Yu Xiaowei felt the long-lost warmth of family reunion, temporarily forgetting the pressures of work and finances.

The children excitedly hung the star ornament on the top of the tree and then took turns hanging colorful baubles and ribbons. Mother Chen Meiling stood nearby, handing over decorations and guiding the children on where to place them. Gradually the Christmas tree became colorful, and the living room was filled with a festive atmosphere.

subevent.location: Home living room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Used the year-end bonus to buy a high-end massage chair to improve family health.
description: On the morning of December 21, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming went to a large home appliance store in Sha Tin and used the remaining year-end bonus plus some family savings to choose a high-end massage chair as a Christmas gift for the whole family. She valued the zero-gravity mode and heating function. She paid 12,000 yuan by card. Although it was expensive, considering her long-term sitting and her mother-in-law's joint discomfort, she thought it was a worthwhile health investment. After delivery, the whole family took turns using it every night. Her husband joked, 'This chair understands your back pain better than I do,' and she made a private resolution to pay more attention to balancing assets and health in the future.

subevent.name: Go to the Sha Tin home appliance store to choose a massage chair
subevent.description: On the morning of December 21, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming went to a large home appliance store in Sha Tin District, Hong Kong, and compared the functions and prices of massage chairs at several brand counters. Yu Xiaowei focused on trying out the zero-gravity mode and the heating function, and finally chose a high-end massage chair. Considering her long hours of desk work and her mother-in-law's joint discomfort, she felt it was a worthwhile investment in health.
subevent.location: Sha Tin District, Hong Kong - large home appliance store

That evening, Yu Xiaowei, her husband Zhang Weiming, her mother-in-law Chen Meiling, her son Zhang Zixuan, and her daughter Zhang Yuxin took turns trying the massage chair. Yu Xiaowei first let her mother-in-law, who had long been troubled by joint discomfort, try it, and she felt comfortable and satisfied. Her husband Zhang Weiming joked, 'This chair understands your back pain better than I do.' The whole family experienced the massage chair's functions in a warm and happy atmosphere. Yu Xiaowei secretly resolved to pay more attention to balancing assets and health in the future.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - living room at home

name: Afternoon tea with best friend Lin Jiaxin, having an honest conversation about career boundaries
description: On the afternoon of December 23, Yu Xiaowei met her close friend Lin Jiaxin at a café in Mong Kok. She congratulated Lin Jiaxin on officially entering the wealth management industry soon, and proactively brought up the possibility that the two might become peers in the same industry, hoping they could communicate transparently about client resources and not let competition affect their friendship. Lin Jiaxin understood and agreed. The two agreed to keep in touch and shared Christmas plans. Their laughter lasted two hours, which lifted a weight off Yu Xiaowei's mind and fulfilled an important social commitment from November.

She first congratulated Lin Jiaxin on officially joining the wealth management industry, then proactively brought up that the two might have a coopetition relationship regarding client resources in the future, hoping that they could maintain transparent communication and not let competition affect their friendship of more than thirty years. Lin Jiaxin said she fully understood and agreed. The two also shared their respective Christmas plans. The entire conversation lasted about two hours, filled with laughter. Yu Xiaowei thus let go of the concerns in her heart and fulfilled the social commitment she had made to herself in November.

They loaded them into the car, returned home, and temporarily stacked the materials in a corner of the living room.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Mong Kok Building Materials Market.

subevent.name: Painting the wall (first coat)
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming used painter's tape to protect the baseboards and door frames in the storage room, sanded down uneven spots on the walls with sandpaper, and then applied primer. After the primer dried, they used a roller to apply the first coat of white latex paint, paying special attention to corners and ceiling seams. When the work was done, they opened the windows for ventilation and waited for the wall to dry.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home storage room at 328 Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: Painting the wall (second coat and touch-ups)
subevent.description: After Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming checked that the first coat of paint was completely dry, they applied a second coat of white latex paint with a roller to ensure the color was even and free of brush marks; they touched up the corners with a brush, removed the masking tape, installed and cleaned the switch panels, and after finishing the wall work, opened the windows to continue airing out the smell.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home storage room at 328 Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: Install the wall-mounted bracket and the foldable workbench
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming used a power drill to make holes at marked positions on the wall, installed expansion anchors and load-bearing brackets, and fixed the pre-purchased solid wood wall shelf at the preset height. Then they assembled the foldable workbench, hinged it to the other side of the wall, and tested that the folding and unfolding functions worked smoothly. Finally, they checked the firmness of all the fixtures.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home storage room at 328 Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: Install light fixtures and arrange seating
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming installed high color rendering eye-protective lights on the storage room ceiling, connected the wiring, and tested brightness and color temperature; placed ergonomic comfortable chairs in front of the workbench, adjusted their height and position; arranged Cantonese embroidery tools, a yoga mat, and handmade storage boxes on the wall-mounted shelf, completing the initial layout of the space.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home storage room at 328 Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: Space Use Acceptance and Decoration Finishing
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei practiced Cantonese embroidery and yoga stretching exercises on her own in the newly renovated space, testing the workbench height, lighting comfort, and seat support. Zhang Weiming also came by to try the convenience of the foldable workbench. Together they hung small decorative paintings on the storage room wall and laid anti-slip mats on the floor, finally completing the multifunctional space transformation.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home storage room at 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: Follow up on the corporate insurance renewal for Shenzhen client Wang Qiming.
description: On November 4, 2025, in her office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, Yu Xiaowei prepared the renewal materials for Shenzhen client Wang Qiming in advance, designed two framework options for group high-end medical insurance plans, and made a list of questions. On the morning of November 5, she communicated with President Wang via WeChat video call and explained in detail the coverage adjustments needed due to the new department. President Wang was interested in Option 2, and both parties agreed to go to Shenzhen in early December to sign in person. After the video call, she immediately organized the meeting minutes, updated the customer management system, sent follow-up emails, and reported progress to her direct supervisor. The whole process made her reflect on the challenges and opportunities of cross-city service.

subevent.name: Preparing renewal materials for Wang Qiming's corporate insurance policy
subevent.description: On November 4, 2025, at her office in the AIA Building in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, Yu Xiaowei prepared in advance for the next day's video call with Shenzhen client Wang Qiming. She pulled up the old policy of Wang Qiming's technology company, analyzed the current number of employees and coverage scope, reviewed industry risk materials for the company's new department (suspected to be R&D), and initially drafted two adjusted framework options for the group high-end medical insurance plan. She also compiled a list of detailed questions to confirm with Wang Qiming to ensure the call would be efficient.
subevent.location: AIA Building office, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Video call with Wang Qiming to discuss the renewal plan
subevent.description: On the morning of November 5, 2025, Yu Xiaowei contacted Wang Qiming (Mr. Wang) in his office in Nanshan District, Shenzhen, via WeChat video from her office at the AIA Building. She first asked about Mr. Wang's health and the company's recent situation, then moved on to the topic of policy renewal, explaining in detail the need to adjust the coverage because of the newly added department, and presented two options: Option 1 was to add headcount for the new department under the original plan; Option 2 was to upgrade to a higher sum insured tier and include dental benefits. Mr. Wang was interested in Option 2 but needed to discuss it with his finance colleagues. In the end, the two agreed that Yu Xiaowei would travel to Shenzhen early next month (early December) to sign the contract with Mr. Wang in person. The call lasted about 40 minutes and the atmosphere was professional and friendly.
subevent.location: Office at AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong (video link to Shenzhen)

subevent.name: Organize meeting minutes and update the system
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Yu Xiaowei immediately organized the meeting notes in her office at AIA Tower. She entered General Manager Wang's feedback (his inclination toward Option 2 and items to be confirmed), the key adjustments for both plans, and the agreed in-person signing time (a trip to Shenzhen in early December) into the customer management system. She also sent General Manager Wang a formal follow-up email with detailed PDFs of both plans attached, and made a note of the Shenzhen business trip early next month. When she finished, she briefly reported the renewal progress to her direct supervisor, Liang Zhenhua, and gained his support. The whole process took about an hour.
subevent.location: AIA Building office, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: In the year-end review, frankly admitted shortcomings, suspended cross-border business, and established client protection procedures
description: On December 9, Yu Xiaowei gave her year-end performance review. The team achieved 112% of its annual performance target and ranked fourth in the region, missing the top three. She frankly admitted the oversights in the Shenzhen market strategy and the possibility of internal clients being poached. Her supervisor, Liang Zhenhua, said the regional manager selection would be postponed until mid-next year, giving her a chance to prove herself again. After the review, she reflected quietly and realized that the cross-border business required company resource support. She decided to suspend the Shenzhen business and focus on strengthening her local Hong Kong foundation. In the following week, she led the establishment of stricter client reporting and follow-up processes, and publicly shared them at the morning meeting on December 12, gaining the understanding and support of team member Su Lishan and the new hires. She learned to use rules to protect the team's interests.

subevent.name: Year-end performance review meeting
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei delivered her 2025 year-end performance review to regional sales director Liang Zhenhua at the AIA Hong Kong office in Wan Chai, reporting that the team achieved 112% of its annual target, ranking fourth in the region and missing the top three. She candidly acknowledged the oversight in Shenzhen market layout and the risk of internal clients being poached. Liang Zhenhua said the regional manager selection has been postponed to mid-2026, giving her time to prove herself again.
subevent.location: Office in AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Reflection and decision-making after the performance report
subevent.description: After the work report, Yu Xiaowei quietly reflected alone in the office. She realized that the cross-border business required company resource support and that the timing was not yet right, so she decided to suspend the Shenzhen business and shift her work focus back to deeply cultivating the Hong Kong local market.
subevent.location: Office in AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Drafting the client reporting and follow-up process
subevent.description: In her office at AIA Building, Yu Xiaowei drafted a client registration and follow-up process proposal, aiming to avoid client conflicts and poaching. The designed rules included registering clients within 24 hours after first contact, regularly updating follow-up records, and requiring mutual consent for cross-team collaboration.
subevent.location: Office in AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

subevent.name: Discuss and refine the process with the team.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei gathered team members Su Lishan and newcomer Li Xiaoming in the meeting room at AIA Building to discuss the draft client reporting process. After listening to their opinions, she made detailed revisions and finalized it. The process clarified reporting deadlines, violation penalties, and arbitration mechanisms, and received basic approval from the team members.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR, Wan Chai District - AIA Building Meeting Room

subevent.name: Share the new process at the morning meeting
subevent.description: At the team morning meeting in the AIA Building office, Yu Xiaowei formally shared the newly established client reporting and follow-up process with all team members, emphasizing the use of rules to protect team interests. Su Lishan and the new hires expressed understanding and support for the process. Yu Xiaowei learned to use rules to safeguard team interests.
subevent.location: Office in AIA Building, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Communicating about the annual plan and promotion path, and formulating a quarterly plan
description: To discuss the annual plan with her superior Liang Zhenhua, Yu Xiaowei prepared briefing materials at the AIA Building on December 22 and booked a meeting for the next morning. On the morning of December 23, she had an in-depth conversation with Liang Zhenhua in the conference room. She frankly admitted her misjudgment of the Shenzhen business and reported on the suspension of the cross-border business and the effectiveness of the customer protection process. Liang Zhenhua affirmed her execution ability, suggested focusing on high-end local clients in Hong Kong, and specified the key indicators for the regional manager selection. After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei returned to her home study, organized the meeting minutes, and based on the indicator requirements, drafted a preliminary work plan for the next quarter.

subevent.name: Prepare communication materials and schedule a meeting
subevent.description: At her desk in AIA Building, Yu Xiaowei organized the feedback received after her year-end performance review, compiled effectiveness data on suspending cross-border business and establishing customer protection processes, and drafted a report outline. She then used the company's internal messaging software to schedule a one-on-one meeting with her supervisor Liang Zhenhua for the morning of December 23, confirming the meeting room and time.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Building

subevent.name: Discussion with Liang Zhenhua on annual planning and promotion pathway
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei had a face-to-face meeting with her supervisor Liang Zhenhua in the AIA Building conference room. She candidly admitted her misjudgment of the Shenzhen business expansion at the beginning of the year and reported in detail the measures she had taken: suspending the cross-border business and establishing a customer protection process, noting that the process had initially curbed attrition. Liang Zhenhua affirmed her quick execution, advised her to shift her focus entirely back to expanding high-end local clients in Hong Kong, and specified three key indicators for the regional manager selection next mid-year: total annual new policy premiums, customer renewal rate, and team collaboration score. Yu Xiaowei carefully recorded every requirement and said she would formulate a detailed quarterly plan accordingly.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Building meeting room

subevent.name: Organized meeting notes and made the quarterly plan
subevent.description: After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei returned to the study at home and organized, item by item, the suggestions and evaluation criteria put forward by Liang Zhenhua during the meeting into an electronic document. Referring to her current client structure and performance data, she drafted the work priorities for the next quarter: focus on high-net-worth family clients in Kowloon City and Eastern District, plan to organize a high-end client salon every two weeks, and regularly review the renewal rate. After completing the full quarterly plan framework, she prepared to refine it the next day and submit it to Liang Zhenhua for review.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

name: Picked up the framed Cantonese embroidery and hung it in the living room. Her husband was moved that Xiaowei missed her father.
description: On October 25, her husband Zhang Weiming picked up the small Cantonese embroidery piece embroidered by Yu Xiaowei and her mother Chen Meiling from the framing shop, and hung it in a prominent spot in the living room. He remarked how nice it was to have such a family. Yu Xiaowei looked at the embroidery and thought of her father, with whom she was still in a cold war. Her heart ached, and she wished even more to resolve their father-daughter conflict soon.

subevent.name: Zhang Weiming picked up the framed embroidery
subevent.description: On the morning of October 25, 2025, her husband Zhang Weiming went to a framing shop in Kowloon City District to pick up a small Cantonese embroidery piece, jointly embroidered by Yu Xiaowei and her mother Chen Meiling, that had been sent in for framing a few days earlier.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - a picture framing shop

subevent.name: Zhang Weiming hung the embroidery piece in the living room at home.
subevent.description: After Zhang Weiming returned home, he carefully hung the Cantonese embroidery piece he had picked up in a prominent spot in the living room, with Yu Xiaowei watching nearby. Location: Yu Xiaowei's home living room (328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District).
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

name: Initial communication with Shenzhen client Wang Qiming about the cross-border group insurance framework; drafting the proposal had to be postponed because her mother-in-law was injured.
description: On the afternoon of April 11, 2025, Yu Xiaowei called her client Wang Qiming, who runs a startup in Shenzhen, to discuss the intention to cooperate on cross-border group insurance reached at the March sharing session. Wang Qiming asked Yu Xiaowei to first draft a protection framework covering his Hong Kong and mainland employees. Just as she hung up and was about to look up information, her mother-in-law accidentally sprained her ankle that evening, so she had to put the drafting on hold. After that, she only briefly told Wang Qiming via WeChat that things had changed and that she would move forward as soon as family matters were settled. The plan remained stalled until the end of the month.

subevent.name: Talked with client Wang Qiming by phone about the cross-border group insurance framework.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 11, 2025, Yu Xiaowei called Wang Qiming, co-founder of Shenzhen Zhiyun Technology, from her office at AIA in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong to have an initial discussion about the cross-border group insurance cooperation intention reached at the March sharing session. Wang Qiming asked Yu Xiaowei to first draft a protection framework covering his Hong Kong and mainland employees.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

subevent.name: Handle family matters and shelve the drafting of the plan
subevent.description: From April 13 to 18, 2025, Yu Xiaowei devoted her main energy to caring for her injured mother-in-law Li Shufen, including accompanying her to follow-up appointments, buying daily necessities, and helping with housework, while also taking care of her two children, including picking them up and dropping them off. The drafting of the cross-border group insurance plan was completely shelved and never resumed.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region-Kwun Tong District-mother-in-law's home and Kowloon City District-Yu Xiaowei's home

subevent.name: Accompany mother-in-law to physical therapy and purchase rehabilitation supplies
subevent.description: On the morning of April 16, 2025, Yu Xiaowei had her husband Zhang Weiming take the two children to school, while she took her mother-in-law to the community physiotherapy center in Kwun Tong District for her first physical therapy session, based on the doctor's earlier recommendation. The therapist massaged her mother-in-law, applied hot compresses, and taught her simple home rehabilitation exercises. Yu Xiaowei stayed by her side throughout and carefully wrote down the key care points. In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei went to a pharmacy and a department store in Kowloon City District and bought rehabilitation aids for her mother-in-law, including a walking cane, elastic bandages, and thermal knee pads. After returning to her mother-in-law's home, Yu Xiaowei created a safe walking route for her, removed obstacles such as rugs, and taught her how to use the cane correctly. In the evening, Yu Xiaowei picked up her daughter and took soup to her mother-in-law's home, then came back home to help her son with his homework.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kwun Tong District - community physiotherapy center; Kowloon City District - pharmacy, department store, Li Shufen's home

subevent.name: The whole family went to Kwun Tong to visit her mother-in-law.
subevent.description: At 8 a.m., Yu Xiaowei, her husband Zhang Weiming, and their son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin set off from their home on Prince Edward Road West and took a bus to the mother-in-law's residence in Kwun Tong. Before leaving, she picked up the latest issue of Hong Kong Runner magazine from the downstairs mailbox, intending to bring it to her mother-in-law to pass the time. At 10 a.m., Zhang Weiming bustled in the kitchen at the mother-in-law's home, with Yu Xiaowei assisting. They simmered the mother-in-law's favorite pork bone soup with green and red radishes, and also steamed pork ribs and stir-fried choy sum. Smelling the soup, the mother-in-law was in a good mood, and the swelling in her ankle had subsided somewhat. At 1 p.m., after lunch, Yu Xiaowei had her mother-in-law sit on the sofa and read magazines, while she began organizing the messy wardrobe, packing away winter clothes and hanging spring everyday clothes within easy reach. She also changed and washed the bed sheets and pillowcases, and wiped the bedside table and remote control with disinfectant wipes. At 3 p.m., Zhang Weiming noticed an old chandelier in the living room flickering, so he immediately went downstairs to buy a new ballast and replace it, and took the opportunity to check all the sockets and switches throughout the house. At 4:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei checked her mother-in-law's ankle and found that the swelling had basically subsided. She looked up simple ankle circles and toe curling exercises on her phone, taught them to her mother-in-law hand over hand, and encouraged her to do them three times a day, five minutes each time. At 6 p.m., Yu Xiaowei reheated the leftovers from lunch, and the family sat around and ate. Before leaving, she divided her mother-in-law's medication for the next three days into morning, noon, and evening compartments in a pillbox, and asked the neighbor, Mrs. Ho, to keep an eye on her. At 7:30 p.m., they took the bus home, and the children, exhausted, fell asleep on the bus. At 9 p.m., after returning home, Yu Xiaowei called her mother Chen Meiling and reported that her mother-in-law was recovering well.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kwun Tong District - Li Shufen's home, Kowloon City District - Yu Xiaowei's home

subevent.name: Accompany her mother-in-law to her final follow-up visit and hand over the care plan
subevent.description: On the morning of April 18, 2025, Yu Xiaowei again accompanied her mother-in-law to a follow-up appointment at the orthopedic department of United Christian Hospital. After the examination, the doctor confirmed that her mother-in-law's ankle had recovered well and that she could gradually return to normal walking, but needed to avoid strenuous exercise. Yu Xiaowei asked in detail about the follow-up precautions and scheduled the last physical therapy session. After leaving the hospital, Yu Xiaowei took her mother-in-law to a cha chaan teng in Kwun Tong District for morning tea to celebrate her basically complete recovery. In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei returned to her mother-in-law's home, organized the week's medication and care points into a list, and gave it to her husband Zhang Weiming. They discussed Zhang Weiming visiting in the coming days after work whenever he could. Yu Xiaowei also contacted her mother-in-law's neighbors and asked them to keep an eye on her and help during the day. In the evening, Yu Xiaowei returned to her own home, began clearing up pending work matters, checked unanswered client messages, and planned to resume drafting proposals the next day.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kwun Tong District - United Christian Hospital, tea restaurant, Li Shufen's home, Kowloon City District - Yu Xiaowei's home

name: After the family meeting, the whole family adjusted the budget and started preparing for the Japan trip
description: On the evening of December 18, 2025, Yu Xiaowei held a family meeting with her husband Zhang Weiming and their children. Because her father's investment losses meant the Japan trip budget had to be cut, her husband promised to take on more school runs so that she could take on a part-time job to supplement their income. From after the meeting until the 20th, Yu Xiaowei searched for part-time insurance orders and drew up a new budget plan, Zhang Weiming adjusted the pick-up and drop-off arrangements, and the children excitedly looked up travel tips. The whole family worked together on the travel plan.

subevent.name: Family meeting to discuss Japan trip plans and budget adjustment.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 18, 2025, Yu Xiaowei, her husband Zhang Weiming, son Zhang Zixuan (8 years old), and daughter Zhang Yuxin (5 years old) held a family meeting in the living room of their home in Kowloon City District. The meeting mainly discussed specific plans for the whole family to travel to Japan during the 2026 summer vacation. However, because Yu Xiaowei's father Yu Guoqiang had recently suffered investment losses, the family needed to cut the original travel budget. At the meeting, Yu Xiaowei proposed an adjustment plan, and her husband Zhang Weiming voluntarily promised to take on more of the school drop-off and pick-up tasks so that Yu Xiaowei could use the saved commuting time to take on part-time insurance policies to help support the family. The children excitedly talked about wanting to visit Tokyo Disneyland, Mount Fuji, and other attractions. Yu Xiaowei felt mixed emotions, worried about financial pressure but also warmed by the family's support.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowei began searching for part-time insurance orders.
subevent.description: The day after the family meeting (December 19), Yu Xiaowei used her lunch break and after-work time to search for potential clients in the AIA internal system and client WeChat groups, planning to subsidize the Japan trip budget by taking on more small insurance policies. She first organized her existing client list, marked clients who had recently expressed interest in renewing or increasing coverage, and made a simple client follow-up plan, preparing to call each one over the next week.
subevent.location: AIA Building Office, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Zhang Weiming adjusts the task arrangement for picking up and dropping off the children.
subevent.description: On December 19, Zhang Weiming, according to the division of responsibilities agreed at the family meeting, replanned his daily route and schedule for picking up and dropping off the children. He communicated in advance with the primary school his son Zhang Zixuan attends (Kowloon Tong Government Primary School) and the kindergarten his daughter Zhang Yuxin attends (Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten) to confirm dismissal times, and discussed new commuting handover details with his wife Yu Xiaowei, ensuring that starting next Monday he would be fully responsible for morning and evening pickups, allowing Yu Xiaowei to save about 40 minutes of commuting time each day to contact part-time clients.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - at home and around the school

subevent.name: The children looked up Japan travel guides
subevent.description: After school on the afternoon of December 19, Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin used a tablet at home to search for Japan travel guides, especially information about Tokyo Disneyland, Mount Fuji, and Universal Studios. Zhang Zixuan also drew a Japan travel route map during his crafts class at school, planning to show it to his mother. The children were full of anticipation for the trip, which gave Yu Xiaowei motivation.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - children's room at home

subevent.name: Yu Xiaowei initially drafted a new budget plan for the Japan trip
subevent.description: On December 20 (weekend), Yu Xiaowei organized the family finances at home. Based on her father's actual situation after his losses, she recalculated the upper budget limit for the Japan trip. She compared travel agency quotes and independent travel costs, and referred to online travel guides to draft a streamlined itinerary, planning to further discuss and confirm it with her husband the next day.
subevent.location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District - home study

name: Carry out the evening running training plan to prepare for the March half marathon
description: To prepare for the half marathon in the second half of the year, Yu Xiaowei officially started training in March. As planned, she did night running training at Kowloon Tsai Park at 9 pm every Monday, Wednesday and Friday, with the distance gradually increasing from 5 kilometers for the first run to 10 kilometers, and her pace steadily improved. She used a sports watch to record data and regularly shared it with her coach Zhao Zhiming for feedback. This phase of regular training not only strengthened her cardiorespiratory function but also helped her relieve work pressure.

subevent.name: First night run training
subevent.description: Following the training plan, Yu Xiaowei did her first night run at Kowloon Tsai Park at 9 p.m. on Monday, March 3, 2025. The actual running distance was 5 kilometers, and she kept the pace at 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. She used her sports watch to record all the data, and after the run sent screenshots of the data to her coach Zhao Zhiming via WhatsApp, receiving initial feedback on cadence and heart rate.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Regular night running training on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays
subevent.description: In March, except for the first training session, Yu Xiaowei did regular night running training at Kowloon Tsai Park every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 9 p.m. The distance of each run gradually increased from 5 km to 10 km, and her pace improved steadily. She used a sports watch to record data each time, and regularly (after every two training sessions) shared the summary data with coach Zhao Zhiming to get feedback on intensity adjustments and recovery recommendations.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Kowloon Tsai Park

name: Take her children to visit the Hong Kong Science Museum
description: On Saturday afternoon, August 2, 2025, after finishing her morning run training, Yu Xiaowei took her son and daughter to the Hong Kong Science Museum in Tsim Sha Tsui. In the “Children's Gallery” they played with the construction site simulator and watched a high-voltage discharge show. Her son was fascinated by the maglev train model, while her daughter liked the light-and-shadow painting area. Yu Xiaowei took many photos with her phone, planning to print some for display at her son's birthday next month. In the evening, the three of them took the Star Ferry home, the sea breeze blowing away the week's fatigue.

subevent.name: Do morning run training
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, August 2, 2025, Yu Xiaowei did her regular morning run training at Kowloon Tsai Park in Kowloon City District, preparing for the upcoming half marathon. After running about 10 kilometers, she finished the workout and went home to shower and change.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Took her children to the Hong Kong Science Museum.
subevent.description: At around 1 p.m., Yu Xiaowei set out from home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, with her son Zhang Zixuan (8 years old) and daughter Zhang Yuxin (5 years old), taking the MTR to the Hong Kong Science Museum in Tsim Sha Tsui. Along the way, she reminded the children to pay attention to safety and good manners.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Yau Tsim Mong District - Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong Science Museum

subevent.name: Experience the building simulator in the Kids' World
subevent.description: At about 1:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and her two children arrived at the Hong Kong Science Museum and first entered the 'Children's World' exhibition area. Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin took turns using the construction site simulator, experiencing the fun of operating the crane arm and moving bricks, while Yu Xiaowei watched over them and shot videos.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Yau Tsim Mong District - Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong Science Museum

subevent.name: Watch a high-voltage discharge performance.
subevent.description: At about 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei took the children to the Energy Theatre at the Science Museum to watch the spectacular high-voltage discharge show. Zhang Zixuan was very curious about the principles of lightning and kept asking questions; Yu Xiaowei answered patiently. Zhang Yuxin was a little scared and stayed in her mother's arms watching.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Yau Tsim Mong District - Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong Science Museum

subevent.name: Visit the maglev train model and the light-and-shadow painting area.
subevent.description: At around 2:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei led the children to visit the transportation technology exhibition area. Zhang Zixuan studied the maglev train model for a long time and took photos to record the details; then they moved to the light and shadow painting area, where Zhang Yuxin used a digital brush to doodle freely on the screen. Yu Xiaowei and the two children completed a rainbow painting together.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Yau Tsim Mong District - Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong Science Museum

subevent.name: Took photos during the visit and planned to have them printed
subevent.description: During the visit, Yu Xiaowei used her phone to take many photos, including moments of the children playing, close-ups of the science exhibits, and group photos of the mother and two children. After the visit, she looked through the photos in the museum lobby and picked out more than a dozen satisfying photos, planning to have them printed before her son's birthday next month for the birthday display.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Yau Tsim Mong District - Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong Science Museum

subevent.name: Take the Star Ferry home
subevent.description: At about 5 p.m., Yu Xiaowei took the children on a walk from the Hong Kong Science Museum to the Tsim Sha Tsui Star Ferry Pier, took the Star Ferry across Victoria Harbour to Hung Hom Ferry Pier, and then walked back to their home on Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City District. With the sea breeze blowing, the three chatted along the way. The children excitedly shared what they had seen and done that day, and Yu Xiaowei felt the fatigue of the week ease away.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Victoria Harbour - Star Ferry

name: Assist father with switching to low-risk wealth management products
description: On December 11, Yu Xiaowei called the HSBC Mong Kok branch in advance to schedule a wealth management conversion appointment, and at home collected her father Yu Guoqiang's account information and prepared materials explaining principal-protected wealth management products. On December 12, she accompanied her father to the bank. With the help of client manager Li Guodong, they converted some highly volatile funds into money market funds and time deposits. She explained the principal-protected features to her father, and signed a power of attorney for future management. After the procedures, the two returned home. Yu Xiaowei organized and filed the confirmation and the power of attorney, and agreed with her father to review the investment portfolio regularly. That evening, she briefly explained the situation to her mother Chen Meiling via WeChat.

subevent.name: Book a bank appointment and prepare wealth management conversion materials
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei called HSBC's Mong Kok Branch in advance to schedule a meeting on December 12 with account manager Li Guodong to handle a wealth management conversion. At home, she gathered her father Yu Guoqiang's account information and existing fund documents, and prepared simple explanatory materials on principal-guaranteed wealth management to make it easier to explain to her father.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Accompanying her father to the HSBC Mong Kok branch
subevent.description: On the weekend morning of December 12, Yu Xiaowei accompanied her father Yu Guoqiang from their home in Kowloon City District, taking the MTR to the HSBC branch in Mong Kok. On the way, Yu Xiaowei again talked with her father about the business they were about to handle and eased his concerns. After arriving, they met with the account manager Li Guodong, and the three of them entered the wealth management room.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Mong Kok - HSBC Mong Kok Branch

subevent.name: Handle fund conversion and sign the power of attorney
subevent.description: With the assistance of account manager Li Guodong, Yu Xiaowei and her father Yu Guoqiang converted some high-volatility funds into money market funds and time deposits to reduce the risk of losses. Yu Xiaowei patiently explained the principal-guaranteed features of the new products to her father and helped him understand the terms. At the same time, she signed a power of attorney so that she could manage part of the financial operations on his behalf in the future. Her father looked relieved and promised to discuss future investments with his daughter.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Mong Kok - HSBC Mong Kok Branch

subevent.name: Return home and organize files
subevent.description: After completing the wealth management transfer, Yu Xiaowei left the bank with her father and took the MTR back home in Kowloon City District. She organized and filed the new investment confirmation and a copy of the authorization letter, and agreed with her father to regularly review the investment portfolio going forward. In the evening, Yu Xiaowei briefly explained the day's investment transfer to her mother, Chen Meiling, via WeChat.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

name: On Chung Yeung Festival, hiking up Victoria Peak; father opened up and entrusted his estate, and Xiaowei began planning
description: On October 29, the Chung Yeung Festival, Yu Xiaowei organized the whole family to climb Victoria Peak, and her father agreed for the first time. She prepared supplies and, along the way, tentatively brought up investment and financial planning; her father remained silent and did not respond. After reaching the summit, her father unexpectedly said frankly, "The one I trust is you, Xiaowei," and expressed his willingness to leave the assets to them. On the way down the mountain, her father proactively asked about her work and asked her to bring product materials home. That evening at the family dinner, her father explained his asset situation in detail and formally asked her to create a prudent succession plan. The next day, Xiaowei organized the information, began to formulate a plan, and planned to consult her colleague Guo Junwei and discuss it with her husband.

subevent.name: Preparations before hiking.
subevent.description: On the morning of the Double Ninth Festival, Yu Xiaowei announced the hiking plan to the whole family, prepared supplies such as drinking water, snacks, and sunscreen for the hike, confirmed the meeting time with her husband Zhang Weiming, and reminded her father Yu Guoqiang to bring hiking poles and her mother Chen Meiling to have the children's jackets ready. The whole family completed their pre-departure preparations at home in Kowloon City.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home

subevent.name: Discussing investment matters with her father during the hike
subevent.description: During the hike, Yu Xiaowei, seeing that her father Yu Guoqiang was in good form, cautiously brought up the family investment and financial planning advice they had discussed before, hoping he would consider allocating some savings to insurance products to preserve and grow their value. Her father was silent for a moment, did not respond, and continued on his way. Yu Xiaowei felt a little disappointed but understood her father's personality, so she did not press further and quietly accompanied him on the hike.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Central and Western District - The Peak Hiking Trail

subevent.name: Summit group photo and father's expression of trust
subevent.description: After the family reached the top of Victoria Peak, Yu Xiaowei took photos at the inspection deck of Peak Tower for everyone. While her husband Zhang Weiming was taking a solo photo of her father, her father Yu Guoqiang suddenly turned around and said to his daughter and son-in-law, "I'm old. I want to leave my money to you, but I don't trust those products. I trust you, Xiaowei." Yu Xiaowei's eyes instantly welled up, the long-standing knot in her heart seemed to loosen, and she hugged her father emotionally. Her mother and the children also gathered around; it was a moving scene.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Central and Western District - The Peak Tower observation deck, Victoria Peak

subevent.name: Walked down the mountain and returned home
subevent.description: The whole family stayed and played at Victoria Peak for about an hour, then walked down along Mount Austin Road and took the private car back home in Kowloon City. On the way back, her father chatted happily with Yu Xiaowei, proactively asked about her recent work, and told her to bring some product materials home to look at when she had time. Yu Xiaowei felt warmth surge in her heart, sensing support from her father that she had never felt before.
subevent.location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - home

subevent.name: Family dinner and heart-to-heart talk between father and daughter.
subevent.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowei personally cooked a family feast for the Double Ninth Festival, and the whole family sat around the dining table enjoying the meal. During the meal, she deliberately offered her father a cup of tea to thank him for his trust. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei talked with her father alone in the living room. Her father described his assets and thoughts on inheritance in detail, and hoped that Yu Xiaowei would help him formulate a solid plan. Yu Xiaowei listened carefully and promised to handle it with dedication.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District - living room at home.

subevent.name: Preliminary thoughts on future financial planning
subevent.description: The next day, Yu Xiaowei organized the asset information her father had provided in the home study, recalled the previous evening's conversation, and began drafting an initial asset inheritance plan. She planned to consult her colleague Guo Junwei from the company's product department to learn about insurance products suitable for steady appreciation for the elderly, and after discussing with her husband Zhang Weiming, she would further discuss the details with her father.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District - home study room.

name: Marathon preparation and race
description: In early October, Yu Xiaowei started a strict diet control plan, gave up milk tea, and her family adjusted the menu to cooperate. On October 4, she did a 20-kilometer training run and was criticized by her coach for unstable pacing. She then carried out taper training under the coach's guidance, but her training was affected by anxiety. On October 26, she took part in a full marathon, with her husband and children cheering her on, and finally overcame her anxiety to finish the race.

subevent.name: 20-kilometer long-distance training run
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei did a 20-kilometer long-distance training run at the sports ground in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong ahead of the half marathon. Because recent anxiety caused her pace to fluctuate between fast and slow, she was harshly criticized by her coach, Zhao Zhiming. After the run, the coach gave detailed adjustment suggestions and required her to train strictly according to the plan for the remaining time.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - sports ground.

subevent.name: Strict diet control and training adjustments before the race.
subevent.description: To prepare for the full marathon on October 26, Yu Xiaowei began strictly controlling her diet from early October, giving up her favorite Hong Kong-style milk tea, and consuming high-carb, low-fat, high-protein food daily. Her family (mother Chen Meiling, husband Zhang Weiming) adjusted the family menu accordingly, with dinners mainly consisting of chicken breast, vegetables, and whole wheat bread. At the same time, she did tapering runs according to the coach's plan, but anxiety still affected her training results.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Start the pre-race diet control plan.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 1, Yu Xiaowei held a family meeting in the living room of her home in Kowloon City with her mother Chen Meiling and her husband Zhang Weiming, officially announcing the start of a strict 25-day diet control plan. She explained in detail the specific requirements: she needed to give up Hong Kong-style milk tea and consume high-carbohydrate, low-fat, high-protein foods daily. She also discussed menu adjustments with her family. Afterwards, she went with her mother to a nearby wet market and supermarket, where they bought a large quantity of healthy ingredients such as chicken breast, whole-wheat bread, and vegetables, making full material preparations for the upcoming diet control.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home and nearby street market

subevent.name: Perform the first reduced-volume training session
subevent.description: Following the pre-race taper run plan set by coach Zhao Zhiming, Yu Xiaowei got up at 6 a.m. on October 5, changed into her running gear, and went to Kowloon Tsai Park for an 8 km easy run. During the run, she deliberately kept her pace at 6:30/km, paid attention to how her body felt, and recorded her heart rate. After the workout, she stretched for 10 minutes on a park bench, then checked in on the running app with her phone and synced the data to her coach.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Adjusting the family dinner menu
subevent.description: In the afternoon of October 10, her mother Chen Meiling began adjusting the dinner menu as planned and cooked steamed chicken breast, garlic broccoli, and brown rice. When Yu Xiaowei came home from work and saw the healthy dinner on the table, she felt relieved, but at the same time became anxious because she could not eat her favorite roast meat double combo and Hong Kong-style milk tea. Sitting at the dining table with her husband Zhang Weiming, she talked about the pressure before the competition, and Zhang Weiming comforted and encouraged her to keep going.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home dining room

subevent.name: Discuss training adjustments with the coach
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 15, during her lunch break at AIA Insurance, Yu Xiaowei contacted her coach Zhao Zhiming via WhatsApp video to report on her training and diet adherence over the past 10 days. She mentioned that in the last two days her legs had felt heavy while running and her pace had dropped. Coach Zhao analyzed that it might be a normal response during the tapering period as the body adjusts, and suggested changing the originally planned 10-kilometer easy run to 6 kilometers and increasing the frequency of stretching and foam roller recovery. The call lasted 15 minutes, and Yu Xiaowei adjusted her training plan according to the new arrangement.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Building office

subevent.name: Adjusting the menu again and easing anxiety
subevent.description: On October 20, Yu Xiaowei's mother Chen Meiling noticed that her daughter had been losing her appetite recently. After returning home that evening, she discussed it with Zhang Weiming and adjusted the dinner menu, adding a small serving of her daughter's favorite pineapple bun with butter as an emotional comfort. When Yu Xiaowei came home from work and saw the change her family had specially prepared for her, she was touched and also realized that she had been over-anxious. After dinner, she talked with her husband in the living room for half an hour. Zhang Weiming expressed understanding and promised to take the children all the way to the finish line to wait for her on race day, which noticeably lifted her mood.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Relaxation and Preparation on the Last Day Before the Race
subevent.description: On October 25, the day before the race, Yu Xiaowei followed her coach's plan and did her final easy run, running only 3 kilometers to maintain muscle memory. Afterwards, she returned home and carefully prepared the race-day supplies: energy gels, salt tablets, and a bottle of mineral water. In the evening, she had dinner with the whole family, and her mother cooked her favorite wonton noodles as a pre-race carbohydrate boost. After dinner, she took a hot bath, laid out her race gear (running shoes, race bib, quick-dry shirt), and went to bed right at 9 p.m.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Full marathon race
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei participated in the full marathon held in Hong Kong on October 26, 2025. She set off in the early morning; her husband, Zhang Weiming, and the children cheered from the sidelines, and her mother, Chen Meiling, prepared supplies at home. During the race, Yu Xiaowei overcame her anxiety and completed the race at the planned pace. Afterward, she briefly discussed her results with coach Zhao Zhiming and took photos to mark the occasion.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District to Hong Kong Island - marathon course

name: Set a personal best in the autumn half marathon and focus on post-race recovery.
description: On the evening of November 14, Yu Xiaowei prepared her race equipment in advance and rested. On the morning of November 16, she completed her warm-up and went to the starting point in Tsim Sha Tsui to participate in the autumn half marathon, setting a new personal best of 1 hour 55 minutes. After the race, she immediately stretched, applied cold packs, and replenished energy. After returning home, she continued to promote recovery through showers, massage, and rest, demonstrating systematic health management.

subevent.name: Pre-race equipment preparation and rest
subevent.description: The night before the race, Yu Xiaowei organized and checked her race gear, including running shoes, race bib, timing chip, energy gels, salt tablets, and other supplies, and set up her sports watch to make sure it had enough battery. She ensured all items were ready, then rested early to get enough sleep and build up energy for the next day's race.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Race day morning warm-up and departure
subevent.description: On the early morning of November 16, Yu Xiaowei got up and had a light breakfast (such as a banana and whole-wheat bread), then did about 20 minutes of dynamic stretching and a light jog to warm up and activate her muscles. She then picked up her supplies and took the MTR to the marathon starting point in Tsim Sha Tsui, where she did final mental preparation in the assembly area, waiting for the starting gun.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Tsim Sha Tsui - Victoria Park (start point)

subevent.name: Half marathon race and setting a new record.
subevent.description: At exactly 8:00 a.m., Yu Xiaowei started from the Tsim Sha Tsui starting point, along the course via West Kowloon Corridor, Mong Kok, and Sham Shui Po, returning to the Tsim Sha Tsui finish line. She maintained a steady pace of about 5 minutes 28 seconds per kilometer throughout, stopped at water stations as planned to hydrate, and took an energy gel at the 10 km mark. She crossed the finish line in 1 hour 55 minutes, setting a new personal best in the half marathon, demonstrating excellent athletic ability and race strategy.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Marathon course (Tsim Sha Tsui to Kowloon City District and back)

subevent.name: Immediate post-race stretching and cold compress recovery
subevent.description: After crossing the finish line, Yu Xiaowei collected the finisher medal and refreshment pack, then did about 15 minutes of static stretching in the recovery area near the finish line, focusing on relaxing the thigh, calf, and hip muscles. At the same time, she used her own ice pack to cold-compress her knees and ankles to reduce inflammation, drank her own electrolyte drink and ate a protein bar to quickly replenish energy, systematically managing her body's recovery.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Tsim Sha Tsui - Victoria Park (finish recovery area)

subevent.name: Recovery and relaxation at home after the race.
subevent.description: Returning home in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowei took a warm shower to clean off, then changed into loose clothes and lay down to rest, continuing to hydrate and eat nutritious meals such as lean pork congee and vegetable salad. In the evening, she used a foam roller for a light massage to relax tense muscles and went to bed early, ensuring her body fully recovered and laying the foundation for her upcoming daily training and healthy lifestyle.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home

name: Take Bailey, the family cat, to get annual vaccinations
description: Yu Xiaowei called the nearby pet clinic in advance on October 9 to make an appointment. On the morning of October 11, she and her daughter Zhang Yuxin took the family cat Bailey to the clinic for the annual vaccination. Bailey was a stray cat Yu Xiaowei had found two years ago and had now become part of the family. Her daughter held the cat carrier tightly the whole time, while Yu Xiaowei discussed Bailey's diet and exercise with the veterinarian. After the vaccination, they went home, and her daughter posted a photo of Bailey wearing an Elizabethan collar in the family group chat, making the whole family laugh.

subevent.name: Make an appointment at the pet clinic.
subevent.description: Two days in advance, Yu Xiaowei called the pet clinic near Prince Edward Road in Kowloon City District to make an appointment for the family cat Bailey’s annual vaccination on the morning of October 9, confirming the time and noting the precautions.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Prepare travel supplies
subevent.description: At around 8 a.m. on October 9, Yu Xiaowei and her daughter Zhang Yuxin prepared the items for taking Beili out: they took out the cat carrier, put in a soft cushion, brought Beili's vaccination record and some snacks, and coaxed Beili into the carrier in a soothing tone.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home, 328 Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: On the way to the clinic.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Yuxin walked with the cat carrier containing Bailey from home to the pet clinic about 800 meters away, a journey of about 10 minutes. Zhang Yuxin held the cat carrier tightly throughout, while Yu Xiaowei confirmed the appointment time beside her.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Prince Edward Road West to the clinic street

subevent.name: Getting vaccinated at the clinic
subevent.description: After arriving at the pet clinic, Zhang Yuxin waited nearby holding the cat carrier, while Yu Xiaowei discussed Bailey's recent diet, exercise, and bowel movements with the veterinarian Dr. Chen. Dr. Chen performed a basic check-up (temperature, heartbeat, etc.), and after confirming that Bailey was healthy, administered the annual core vaccines. After vaccination, Yu Xiaowei paid the fee (about 300 HKD) and received the vaccination reminder card for the next year.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - Xiaohui Pet Clinic

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: After the vaccination, Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Yuxin left the clinic with Bailey and walked home. On the way, Zhang Yuxin still carefully held the cat carrier, and Yu Xiaowei observed that Bailey was in good spirits with no abnormal reactions. They arrived home about 10 minutes later.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home, 328 Prince Edward Road West

subevent.name: Put an Elizabethan collar on Bailey and share
subevent.description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei put an Elizabethan collar on Bailey to keep it from licking the injection site. Zhang Yuxin thought Bailey looked very cute wearing the collar, so she took photos with her phone and uploaded them to the family WeChat group with the caption, "Bailey got a shot today, like a little trumpet," making the whole family laugh. Yu Xiaowei then watched Bailey for half an hour and fed him normally after confirming there were no abnormalities.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Kowloon City District - home, 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: A family of four cycling in autumn
description: On Sunday, October 19, Yu Xiaowei's family rented bicycles in Tai Wai and rode to Tai Mei Tuk, about 3 hours in total. The son led the way, and the daughter sat on the back of her husband's bike. They picnicked beside Plover Cove Reservoir with homemade sandwiches and fruit. Facing the autumn breeze, Yu Xiaowei felt a long-lost sense of relaxation and decided to arrange a family outdoor cycling trip once every quarter.

subevent.name: Preparing supplies for a family outing
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on October 19, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming prepared picnic food in the kitchen and living room at home: they made ham and cheese sandwiches and egg sandwiches, washed apples, oranges, and grapes, and packed them into insulated bags. They also checked the cycling gear, making sure the children's helmets and the bicycle rear child seat were in good condition, and prepared a first-aid kit and sunscreen. At around 7:30, they woke the children for breakfast and set off for Tai Wai at about 8 o'clock.
subevent.location: Home in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Cycling from Tai Wai to Tai Mei Tuk
subevent.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowei's family arrived at the bike rental shop near the entrance to the Tai Wai cycling path. Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming each rented a mountain bike, and installed a child seat at the back for their daughter Zhang Yuxin. Their son Zhang Zixuan rode his own children's mountain bike. After adjusting the seats, with Zhang Zixuan leading, they rode along the cycling path toward Tai Mei Tuk. Yu Xiaowei controlled the pace in the middle of the group, while Zhang Weiming followed closely carrying their daughter. Along the way they enjoyed the scenery of Tolo Harbour. The whole trip took about 3 hours.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Tai Wai Cycling Track, Sha Tin District, to Tai Mei Tuk Cycling Track, Tai Po District

subevent.name: Picnic at Plover Cove Reservoir
subevent.description: Around 12:00 noon, they arrived at the shore of Plover Cove Reservoir in Tai Mei Tuk. The family spread a picnic mat on the grass under a tree shade and enjoyed homemade sandwiches and fruit. Yu Xiaowei and her husband admired the lake and mountain scenery while eating, and the two children chased each other and played nearby. In the autumn breeze, Yu Xiaowei felt relaxed in both body and mind, and discussed with her husband arranging a family outdoor activity every quarter. The picnic lasted about 1.5 hours.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - Plover Cove Reservoir lakeside, Tai Po District

subevent.name: Riding back and returning the bicycle
subevent.description: Around 2 p.m., they packed up the picnic items and the family cycled back along the same route to Tai Wai. On the return trip, they slowed down. Yu Xiaowei and her husband paid attention to the children's energy levels to ensure safety. At 4 p.m., they returned to the bike rental shop in Tai Wai, returned the bicycles, and completed the full ride. Yu Xiaowei felt especially refreshed on the way back.
subevent.location: Tai Wai cycling track and bike rental shop, Sha Tin District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Family activity planning
subevent.description: Back home in the evening, Yu Xiaowei gathered her family in the living room for a brief review meeting. She proposed making family outdoor activities a quarterly tradition, and her husband and children agreed. They discussed the next activity (suggesting mountain hiking in autumn or camping in spring), and Yu Xiaowei noted down the “Quarterly Family Outdoor Activity Plan” in her phone memo, deciding that the next activity would take place in January next year.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - living room at home in Kowloon City District

name: Christmas: exchanging thoughtful gifts, and father sending old Hong Kong banknotes to show his feelings
description: On December 20, Yu Xiaowei customized a pour-over kettle as a Christmas gift; on the 21st, her father Yu Guoqiang mailed a box of old Hong Kong dollar notes with an attached note. On December 25, Christmas Day, Yu Xiaowei gave her husband the pour-over kettle; her husband gave her a massage gun and a card in return; her mother sent gingerbread; her mother-in-law sent a video greeting. In the afternoon, she received her father's package, and the old banknotes evoked memories and guilt.

subevent.name: Customized pour-over kettle as a gift
subevent.description: At home, Yu Xiaowei customized a pour-over coffee kettle through an e-commerce platform as a Christmas gift for her husband Zhang Weiming. She chose the minimalist style he liked and had it engraved with their initials and wedding anniversary.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Father sent out the old Hong Kong dollars.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei's father, Yu Guoqiang, sorted through old Hong Kong banknotes he had collected in his youth at his home in Kowloon City District, packed them into a cardboard box, and attached a note saying it was for the children to see. He sent the package to Yu Xiaowei by courier.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Father's home

subevent.name: Gave her husband a customized pour-over coffee kettle.
subevent.description: On Christmas morning, in the living room of their home in Kowloon City District, Yu Xiaowei gave her husband Zhang Weiming a custom pour-over kettle as a gift and expressed her gratitude for his quiet dedication to the family. Zhang Weiming opened the package in surprise and said he loved the gift.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Husband gave a massage gun and a card in return.
subevent.description: Zhang Weiming then took out the Christmas gift he had prepared — a massage gun and a handwritten card. The card read, "We're all tired, but walking together makes it easier." He personally handed the massage gun to Yu Xiaowei in front of her and hugged her, expressing his understanding and support for the dual pressure she faced from work and family.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Mother sent gingerbread.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei's mother, Chen Meiling, baked gingerbread in the kitchen and brought it to the living room after breakfast for the whole family to enjoy. Gingerbread is a traditional Christmas dessert, and Chen Meiling specially prepared the icing to suit the children's favorite tastes. Yu Xiaowei, Zhang Weiming, and the two children, Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin, sat together and enjoyed it.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home dining room

subevent.name: Mother-in-law's video blessing
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei's mother-in-law, Li Shufen, contacted Yu Xiaowei's family via a mobile video call from her home in Kwun Tong District. During the video, she sent Christmas greetings to her son, daughter-in-law, and two grandchildren, and asked how they had been doing recently. The whole family greeted one another through the screen in a warm and harmonious atmosphere. The call lasted about 15 minutes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home living room (Yu Xiaowei's home) and Kwun Tong District - Li Shufen's home

subevent.name: Received old Hong Kong dollars sent by father
subevent.description: In the afternoon, a courier delivered a package sent by Yu Guoqiang. Yu Xiaowei opened the cardboard box in the living room and saw neatly arranged old Hong Kong dollar banknotes inside, along with a note from her father: “Show these to the kids.” She looked through the old notes, remembering how her father had collected them in his younger days, and also thought of his recent investment losses. She felt both moved and guilty. She placed the box on the table, planning to enjoy it together with the children when they came home from school.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: When alone, she was preoccupied with her father's losses.
subevent.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowei was alone in the bedroom, thinking back to her father's investment losses. Although today's family atmosphere was warm, she still felt worried and guilty about her father's financial situation, feeling that as a daughter she had not been able to help. She decided to find an opportunity later to discuss with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng whether they could together provide some support for their father.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home bedroom

name: Learned that her father had lost money in private investments, had a frank conversation, and reached a reconciliation.
description: On the evening of November 18, her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng video-called to congratulate Yu Xiaowei on her marathon result. She proactively asked about their father's investment activities, and her brother told her that their father had privately asked someone to buy high-risk products and had suffered losses. Yu Xiaowei was shocked and called her brother the next day for details about the losses. On November 20, she made an appointment to meet her father on the weekend. On the afternoon of Saturday, November 29, the two had a candid conversation at a tea restaurant. Her father admitted that he had trusted an old friend's recommendation to avoid troubling his daughter, which led to the losses. Yu Xiaowei did not blame him and said she would help handle it, and the two reconciled. Still, she felt self-blame inside.

subevent.name: Learned that her father suffered investment losses
subevent.description: On the evening of November 18, her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng congratulated Yu Xiaowei on her marathon results via video call. When Yu Xiaowei asked about her father's investment moves, her brother was silent for a moment before telling her that their father had privately asked someone to buy high-risk products and had suffered losses. Yu Xiaowei felt shocked and heavy-hearted, realizing that her father may have invested on his own because he did not want to trouble her.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - living room at home

subevent.name: Ask my younger brother about the details of my father's investment.
subevent.description: The next day (November 19), Yu Xiaowei contacted her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng by phone and asked in detail about the specific amount, product type, and extent of loss of her father's investment.
