Her brother told her that her father had bought a non-principal-protected structured product through an old friend in the neighborhood, and it had lost about 30%. Yu Xiaowei noted down the key information and prepared to communicate with her father when they met.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

subevent.name: Arranged to meet her father on the weekend.
subevent.description: After learning about the situation, Yu Xiaowei called her father Yu Guoqiang on November 20 and, in a gentle tone, invited him to go for tea at their usual cha chaan teng on the weekend, saying it had been a while since they last met and she wanted to talk. Her father agreed to meet on Saturday (November 30). Yu Xiaowei did not mention the investment on the phone, to avoid making her father nervous.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home

subevent.name: Weekend heart-to-heart with her father
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Saturday, November 30, Yu Xiaowei met her father Yu Guoqiang at their usual cha chaan teng in Kowloon City District. At first they chatted about family matters, then Yu Xiaowei brought up the topic of investing. Her father finally admitted that, not wanting to trouble her, he had followed an old friend's recommendation and bought a high-risk product, which led to losses. Yu Xiaowei did not blame him. She held his hand, said she would help handle the follow-up, and promised to plan the family finances together in the future. The deadlock between father and daughter was resolved, but Yu Xiaowei still felt guilty inside.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - a tea restaurant

name: Early promotion team management building: goal setting, first weekly meeting, new-hire coaching, and process drafting
description: On May 12, the day of her promotion, after communicating with her supervisor Liang Zhenhua, Yu Xiaowei formulated a plan to break down the team's quarterly sales targets; on May 13, she held the team's first Monday regular meeting, assigned sales tasks, and analyzed client cases; on May 14, she provided one-on-one coaching to the newly hired sales assistant; on May 18, she drafted a team sales collaboration process document at home, laying the foundation for the team's standardized operations.

subevent.name: Chair the Monday team meeting and assign sales tasks.
subevent.description: Every Monday morning, Yu Xiaowei chairs the weekly team meeting in the conference room of AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, AIA Hong Kong headquarters, assigns weekly sales tasks to team members (including Su Lishan and other insurance consultants), and jointly analyzes recent client cases to summarize successful experiences and points for improvement.
subevent.location: Hong Kong SAR - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Meeting Room

subevent.name: New colleague onboarding training and one-on-one coaching (A)
subevent.description: At her office in AIA Building, Yu Xiaowei provided one-on-one coaching to a newly hired sales assistant, focusing on insurance product knowledge, internal system operating procedures, and client communication skills, and arranged mock drills.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

subevent.name: Establish a team sales collaboration workflow.
subevent.description: On Sunday, Yu Xiaowei used the study at home to draft and refine a document on the team's internal sales collaboration process, including customer information sharing, cross-referral mechanisms, and team performance statistics methods, laying the foundation for the next quarter's work.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - Home Study

subevent.name: Develop a quarterly sales target breakdown plan
subevent.description: On the day of her promotion, after communicating with her supervisor Liang Zhenhua in the office, Yu Xiaowei formulated a sales target breakdown plan for each team member based on the company's quarterly goals and wrote it into her personal performance contract.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Wan Chai District - AIA Insurance Office

name: Celebrate father Yu Guoqiang's 66th birthday
description: On December 4, Yu Xiaowei chose a warm scarf and a red envelope for her father. On December 5, she held a family birthday dinner at a long-established restaurant in Kowloon City. Her husband, two children, and mother attended. She gave the gift and discussed a low-risk wealth management switch with her father, easing family tension.

subevent.name: Buy birthday gifts and prepare red envelopes.
subevent.description: After work on December 4, Yu Xiaowei went to a shopping center near Kowloon City and carefully picked out a warm scarf as a birthday gift for her father, Yu Guoqiang, and also prepared a red envelope with cash. After returning home, she wrapped the gift and confirmed the arrangements for the next day's birthday dinner with her husband, Zhang Weiming.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - shopping mall in Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Go to a long-established restaurant in Kowloon City
subevent.description: On the evening of December 5, Yu Xiaowei, her husband Zhang Weiming, their two children Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin, and her mother Chen Meiling went together to a long-established restaurant in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to celebrate the 66th birthday of her father Yu Guoqiang. The family chatted and laughed, and the atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - a long-established restaurant in Kowloon City District

subevent.name: Held a family birthday dinner and gave gifts.
subevent.description: In a private room at the restaurant, Yu Xiaowei's family celebrated her father Yu Guoqiang's 66th birthday. The dining table was filled with dishes her father loved, and the grandchildren laughed and played around him. Yu Xiaowei personally put a warm scarf on her father and gave him a red envelope, wishing him health and longevity. Although her father Yu Guoqiang still blamed himself for the previous investment losses, seeing the family together and the grandchildren's laughter brought a gratified smile to his face.
subevent.location: Private room at a long-established restaurant in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Committed to helping her father switch to low-risk wealth management.
subevent.description: During the birthday banquet, Yu Xiaowei noticed that her father Yu Guoqiang was still blaming himself for his investment losses, so she took the initiative to promise to help him complete the switch to low-risk wealth management products before the Spring Festival and assist him in asset restructuring. After hearing this, her father looked much more relaxed and said he was willing to accept his daughter's suggestion. This conversation eased the previous tension in the family.
subevent.location: Private room at a long-established restaurant in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

subevent.name: Return home after the birthday banquet
subevent.description: At around 9 p.m., the birthday dinner ended and Yu Xiaowei's family said goodbye to her parents. Yu Xiaowei and her husband drove back home with their two children to their home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City, while her mother Chen Meiling and father Yu Guoqiang went home together. The whole family had a warm evening.
subevent.location: Hong Kong - from a long-established restaurant in Kowloon City District to home

name: Follow the half-marathon training plan.
description: Starting July 6, Yu Xiaowei began morning run training three times a week to prepare for the Hong Kong Half Marathon at the end of the year. Each session included 5-10 km of interval running and core strength exercises at Kowloon Tsai Park. She used a sports app to record her pace and scheduled weekend LSD long runs with her running buddy Shen Peiwen. By the end of the month, her best 5 km pace improved from 6:30 to 6:10 per kilometer, and her fitness had clearly improved.

subevent.name: Half-marathon training preparation.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei prepared her gear for the upcoming half marathon training: she checked the condition of her running shoes, washed her sportswear, and got her water bottle and running belt ready. She set up a training plan on the fitness app on her phone (three morning runs per week plus one weekend LSD), and notified her running partner Shen Peiwen to confirm the meeting time for the weekend LSD. She also looked up running routes in Kowloon Tsai Park and planned areas for interval runs and core strength exercises.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Week 1 Training (July 7 to July 12)
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei followed the plan for the first week of training, with three morning runs this week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday), each time doing 5-10 km variable-speed runs and core strength exercises at Kowloon Tsai Park. On the weekend (Saturday, July 12) morning, she met her running partner Shen Peiwen at Kowloon Tsai Park for a long slow distance (LSD) run of about 15 km, with the pace controlled at about 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. After the training, the two stretched together and exchanged experiences. This week, Yu Xiaowei adapted to the training rhythm and her physical fitness improved.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Monday morning run training.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei followed the first week's training plan and went to Kowloon Tsai Park at 6:30 a.m. for a morning run. She first did a 10-minute dynamic warm-up, including high knees, jumping jacks, and joint rotations, then started a 5-10 km fartlek run, alternating between 5:30 and 6:30 per kilometer. After the fartlek run, she did 20 minutes of core strength exercises on the park lawn, including planks, crunches, Russian twists, and glute bridges, 15 reps per set for 3 sets. After training, she did 10 minutes of static stretching to relax her leg muscles.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Wednesday morning training run.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei went to Kowloon Tsai Park again at 6:30 a.m. for her Wednesday training. She first warmed up for 10 minutes, then did a 5-10 km variable-speed run, focusing on practicing lactate threshold pace (about 5 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer). After sustaining it for 3 km, she slowed to a recovery run for 2 km, and repeated the set twice. After the speed run, she did core strength training, including supine scissor kicks, bicycle crunches, side planks and bird dogs, 15 reps per exercise for 3 sets. After training, she stretched for 10 minutes and recorded heart rate data to assess recovery.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Friday morning running workout
subevent.description: On Friday morning at 6:30, Yu Xiaowei did her third morning run of the week at Kowloon Tsai Park. After a 10-minute warm-up, she did a 5-10 km variable-pace run, switching to uphill interval training mode: sprinting 200 meters at full effort on the park's gentle uphill section, then jogging 400 meters to recover, repeating 8 times. Afterwards, she completed a 2 km easy jog on flat ground. The strength-training portion focused mainly on her core and lower body, with squat jumps, lunges, and lying leg raises, 15 reps each for 3 sets. Before finishing, she walked slowly for 5 minutes to cool down and replenished fluids and electrolytes.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Weekend long slow distance run (LSD)
subevent.description: At 7 a.m. on Saturday, Yu Xiaowei met her running partner Shen Peiwen at Kowloon Tsai Park for the week's 15 km long slow distance (LSD) run. The two first did a 15-minute dynamic warm-up together, then completed 15 km along the park track at a steady pace of 6:40/km. During the run, they kept up a conversational pace and talked about their recent training and physical condition. At the halfway point, at 7.5 km, they hydrated and took a short 2-minute break. After finishing the long run, they did a 20-minute group stretch together, focusing on the iliotibial bands, calf muscles, and hamstrings, and then discussed their running gear and next week's training plan.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Second week of training (July 14-July 19).
subevent.description: In the second week, training intensity increased slightly. Yu Xiaowei kept up her three morning runs per week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday), completing 5–10 km of varied-pace runs and core strength exercises in Kowloon Tsai Park. On the weekend (July 19), she did another LSD run with Shen Peiwen, extending the distance to 18 km with a steady pace of 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Yu Xiaowei paid attention to hydration and logged her training data.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Monday morning run: interval runs and core training.
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei got up at 6:00 a.m., changed into her running gear, and walked to Kowloon Tsai Park. On the park's loop track, she started training. First, she did a 1 km jog as a warm-up, then a 5 km variable-pace run with per-km paces of 5:30, 6:00, 5:45, 6:15, and 5:50, feeling the speed changes. After the variable-pace run, she did 15 minutes of core strength training on the lawn at the center of the park, including planks (3 sets, 1 minute each), crunches (3 sets, 20 reps each), and Russian twists (3 sets, 15 reps each). Finally, she did 10 minutes of static stretching, recorded the training data on her phone, rehydrated, and walked home.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Wednesday morning run: interval runs and core training
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei got up at 6:00 in the morning and went to Kowloon Tsai Park for her second morning run of the week. She first jogged 1 kilometer to warm up, then did a 7-kilometer varied-pace run with the following pace plan: 6:00 for the 1st kilometer, 5:45 for the 2nd, 6:10 for the 3rd, 5:30 for the 4th, 5:50 for the 5th, 6:00 for the 6th, and 5:40 for the 7th. After the varied-pace run, she did core strength training on the track, including lying leg raises (3 sets of 15 reps), push-ups (3 sets of 12 reps), and side planks (3 sets of 30 seconds per side). After training, she did a full-body stretch, recorded the data on her phone, rehydrated, and returned home.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Friday morning variable-pace run and core training
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei got up at 6 a.m. and went to Kowloon Tsai Park. She started with a 1 km slow jog to warm up, then did a 10 km variable-pace run. The pace plan was: 6:00 per km for the first 2 km, 5:40 for km 3-4, 6:15 for km 5-6, 5:30 for km 7-8, and 5:50 for km 9-10. After the variable-pace run, she did core strength training in the park's fitness area, including Y bent-over raises (3 sets of 12 reps), bird-dog (3 sets of 12 per side), and dead bug (3 sets of 20 reps). Finally, she did 15 minutes of stretching to cool down, recorded the training data on her phone, drank some water, and walked home.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Weekend 18 km LSD training with Shen Peiwen
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei got up at 5:30 a.m. and met her running partner Shen Peiwen at the entrance of Kowloon Tsai Park. Together they did a long slow distance (LSD) run with a target distance of 18 kilometers and a steady pace of 6:30 per kilometer. They ran along the street route around the perimeter of Kowloon Tsai Park, passing sections such as Junction Road and Tung Po Road. Every 5 kilometers, they paused for hydration and energy gels. Throughout the run, Yu Xiaowei wore a sports watch to monitor her heart rate and pace, and chatted with Shen Peiwen about breathing rhythm and knee protection tips. They slightly accelerated for the last 2 kilometers, and after completing 18 kilometers, did group stretching on the park lawn, encouraged each other, and took a photo to record the occasion. Yu Xiaowei carefully recorded the training data on her phone, including distance, time, average pace, and heart rate zones, to prepare for next week's high-intensity training.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Week 3 Training (July 20 - July 26)
subevent.description: In the third week of training, Yu Xiaowei did three morning runs at Kowloon Tsai Park, one of which was interval training to improve speed. On the weekend (July 26), she did an LSD run with Shen Peiwen, covering 20 kilometers at a pace of about 6:20 per kilometer. Yu Xiaowei felt her fitness had improved significantly, and she increased the number of sets in her core strength exercises.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Wednesday interval run training
subevent.description: Arrived at Kowloon Tsai Park at 5:30 in the morning, warmed up for 10 minutes, and started interval running training. Ran 800 meters at a pace of 4 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, then jogged 400 meters to recover, repeating 6 sets. During rest between sets, drank a little water by the track. After running, did core strength exercises, including planks, Russian twists (20 each side), and bicycle crunches (30 seconds per set, 3 sets), with more sets than before. Finally jogged 5 minutes to cool down and stretched.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Regular early morning run and core training.
subevent.description: At 5:30 a.m., I left for Kowloon Tsai Park. After a 10-minute warm-up, I completed a 10 km run at a pace of 5 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer. I accelerated slightly on the last kilometer and felt my fitness had clearly improved. After the run, I did core exercises in the park's strength area: plank for 3 sets (70 seconds each), lying leg raises for 2 sets (12 reps each), and superman for 2 sets (15 seconds per side). After stretching and relaxing, I returned home.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Saturday LSD long-distance run with running friends
subevent.description: At 6:00 a.m., she met her running buddy Shen Peiwen at Kowloon Tsai Park for a 20 km long slow distance (LSD) run. They warmed up together for 15 minutes, including dynamic stretching and jogging. Then they ran along the park track and surrounding routes at a target pace of 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer, replenishing water and energy gels at aid stations every 5 kilometers. They maintained a steady pace throughout. Yu Xiaowei felt her stamina had noticeably improved, and she exchanged training insights with Shen Peiwen while running. After finishing the 20 km, they did 15 minutes of deep stretching together and agreed to continue training together next week.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Week 4 training and end-of-month test (July 27-July 31)
subevent.description: The fourth week was the training wrap-up week. Yu Xiaowei went for morning runs on July 27 (Monday) and July 29 (Wednesday), and on the morning of July 31 (Thursday) she did a 5-kilometer test run, achieving a best pace of 6 minutes 10 seconds, 20 seconds faster than at the beginning of the month. After the test she recorded the data and shared her training results with Shen Peiwen. No weekend LSD was scheduled this week, focusing mainly on recovery.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Week 4 Monday morning run
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei went for a morning run at Kowloon Tsai Park according to her training plan, about 5 kilometers, with a pace of around 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, maintaining a steady rhythm. After running, she stretched and relaxed, and recorded the day's training data.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: Week 4 Wednesday morning run
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei did her second morning run at Kowloon Tsai Park, covering about 5 km, maintaining a pace of around 6:20 per kilometer, adjusting breathing and cadence in preparation for the end-of-month test. After running, she stretched and recorded her pace, heart rate, and how her body felt.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

subevent.name: End-of-month 5K test run and sharing
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei did a 5-kilometer test run in Kowloon Tsai Park in the morning, pushing hard the whole way and achieving a best pace of 6 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer, 20 seconds faster than at the beginning of the month. After the test, she recorded in detail data such as time, pace, heart rate, and subjective feelings, and shared the training results with her running friend Shen Peiwen by phone or voice message on WeChat, discussing the test performance and subsequent training plan.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon Tsai Park

name: Create and implement a winter diet adjustment plan
description: On December 20, based on her annual physical exam and skin issues, Yu Xiaowei resolved to adjust her diet. She kept a daily food diary, cut Hong Kong-style milk tea from two cups a day to three times a week, increased her intake of vegetables, fruits, and water, and bought vitamin supplements. By the end of the month, the red patches on her skin had improved significantly, her sleep quality had increased, and she felt more energetic.

subevent.name: Develop a winter diet adjustment plan.
subevent.description: Based on her annual physical exam results and the skin redness issue, Yu Xiaowei made up her mind at home to adjust her eating habits. She drew up a preliminary diet plan, which included reducing her daily two cups of Hong Kong-style milk tea to three times a week, increasing her daily intake of vegetables, fruit, and water, and starting a daily food diary.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District - home

subevent.name: Buy vitamin supplements
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei went to a pharmacy near her residence, selected and bought a bottle of multivitamin supplement to support dietary adjustments and improve her skin and overall health.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District pharmacy

subevent.name: Implementing winter dietary adjustments
subevent.description: From December 20 to December 30, Yu Xiaowei followed a winter diet adjustment: adding at least one serving of vegetables and one serving of fruit to both lunch and dinner every day, drinking 8 cups of water per day, and cutting her daily two cups of Hong Kong-style milk tea to three times a week. At the same time, she took vitamin supplements as prescribed and continued to keep a daily food diary to monitor her body's reactions.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District, home and workplace

subevent.name: Implemented the winter dietary adjustment (Phase 1).
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei strictly followed the winter diet adjustment plan: adding at least one serving of vegetables and one serving of fruit to both lunch and dinner each day, and drinking 8 cups of water per day; reducing Hong Kong-style milk tea from two cups a day to three times a week, with 3 occasions scheduled this week (on December 21, 23, and 25); taking vitamin supplements daily as prescribed; and continuing to keep a daily diet log, recording in detail the contents of each meal, water intake, and bodily sensations, and monitoring her body's responses.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District, home and workplace

subevent.name: Implement winter diet adjustments (Phase 2)
subevent.description: Yu Xiaowei continued to strictly follow the winter diet adjustment plan: add at least one serving of vegetables and one serving of fruit to both lunch and dinner each day, and drink 8 glasses of water daily; this week, schedule Hong Kong-style milk tea 3 times (on December 26, 28, and 30), and not at other times; take vitamin supplements daily as prescribed; keep a daily food diary, monitor the body's responses, and review and summarize the effects of the previous week's adjustments.
subevent.location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Kowloon City District, home and workplace
